items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 소매 전력의 준규제(‘규제완화’) 시장에서 공공관리자가 개방적 경쟁을 유지하면서 소비자 부주의와 불완전 경쟁 등 시장실패, 조직·관리·법적 집행 문제를 어떻게 조정·감독해야 하는지 검토한다. 문헌 검토와 소비자 형평성에 관한 실증 사례를 통해 이러한 행정적 선택이 효율성과 소비자 형평성에 영향을 미치며, 두 목표를 함께 다루기 위한 정책 선택지를 논의한다.
items.title: Public Management of Deregulated Systems: Challenges and Opportunities in the Public Management of Retail Energy Markets

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Kettl argues public administration faces a crisis rooted in widening gaps between scholars and practitioners and between the field's core ideas and current governance issues. We identify a critical example: artificial intelligence (AI) adoption in government. AI fundamentally transforms public organizations, redistributing tasks and discretion between humans and algorithms, embedding instrumental rationality into administrative processes, and reconfiguring authority structures. These developments challenge three longstanding pillars of public administration: bureaucratic neutrality, the politics‐administration dichotomy, and democratic governance. We argue that any proposed “Fourth Way” must center democratic resilience and technological stewardship, incorporating algorithmic transparency requirements and participatory governance structures that preserve public—and especially democratic—values.

Jack Baldwin: Maxwell School Syracuse University Syracuse New York USA
Tina Nabatchi: Maxwell School Syracuse University Syracuse New York USA

items.summary_ko: 인공지능의 정부 도입이 인간과 알고리즘 간 과업·재량을 재분배하고 권위 구조를 재편해 관료적 중립성, 정치·행정 이원론, 민주적 거버넌스에 도전하는 양상을 개념적으로 논의한다. 이에 대응하는 ‘제4의 길’은 민주적 회복탄력성과 기술 관리 책무를 중심에 두고, 알고리즘 투명성과 참여적 거버넌스를 통해 공적·민주적 가치를 보존해야 한다고 주장한다.
items.title: Reply to Kettl: Beyond Bureaucracy: Why AI Demands a Fourth Way in Public Administration

items.abstract: Extreme weather events are increasing globally, yet research on how public leadership messaging and the level of government delivering crisis communications influence public compliance and institutional trust remains limited. Drawing on public leadership theory and federalism research, we employ a 2 × 3 survey experiment embedded in the 2023 US Cooperative Election Study (N = 409) to examine how messaging style (authoritarian versus democratic) and the level of government agency (federal, state, or local) influence evacuation intent and agency trust. We find that messaging from the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) increases evacuation intent, despite local governments being legally responsible for issuing evacuation orders. Democratic, or collective, messaging is associated with greater trust in agency. However, trust is more strongly associated with pre-existing individual orientations, public service motivation, and political ideology, than with one-time communication cues. Findings have implications for crisis communication strategy, public leadership, and intergovernmental coordination in emergency management.

Colt Jensen: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
Jaclyn Piatak: The University of North Carolina at Charlotte

items.summary_ko: 2023년 미국 협력 선거연구에 포함된 2×3 설문실험(N=409)을 통해, 권위주의적·민주적 메시지와 연방·주·지방 정부 기관의 전달 수준이 대피 의향과 기관 신뢰에 미치는 영향을 분석했다. FEMA의 메시지는 대피 의향을 높였고, 집합적 메시지는 기관 신뢰와 관련되었지만 신뢰는 일회성 소통 단서보다 개인의 기존 성향, 공공봉사동기, 정치 이념과 더 강하게 연관되었다.
items.title: Does level of government and messaging influence public evacuations? Examining public compliance and agency trust

items.abstract: While strategic planning facilitates public sector digital transformation, it remains unclear why public sectors engage in shaping strategic plans for digital adoption. This study employs the 3Ps framework (People–Process–Plan) to construct an adapted explanatory model of these driving factors. Adopting a longitudinal case study (2019–2024), it investigates a Chinese local government’s digital anti-corruption strategizing based on 28 interviews. Findings extend the 3Ps framework by conceptualizing People as multiple stakeholders, differentiating Process into mutually evolving constructive and conflictual processes, revealing the moderating role of resource accessibility, and demonstrating the feedback effect of implementation outcomes on ongoing Strategic Plans, ultimately advancing digital strategizing from static compliance to a purposeful, dynamic closed-loop system.
items.summary_ko: 공공부문이 디지털 기술 도입을 위한 전략계획을 수립하는 동인과 메커니즘을 규명하기 위해, 중국 지방정부의 디지털 반부패 전략화를 2019~2024년 28건의 인터뷰에 기반한 종단 사례연구로 분석했다. 분석 결과, People은 복수 이해관계자로 확장되고 Process는 상호 진화하는 건설적·갈등적 과정으로 구분되며, 자원 접근성이 이를 조절하고 실행 결과가 후속 전략계획에 환류되어 디지털 전략화를 정적 순응에서 목적지향적·동태적 폐쇄루프로 전환하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Strategic planning for digital technology adoption: drivers and mechanisms in the public sector

items.abstract: This study examines how systemic creativity manifests empirically in the public sector using Csikszentmihalyi’s systemic model operationalized through 15 empirically grounded categories. By analyzing 60 Brazilian cases from the OECD Observatory of Public Sector Innovation, findings reveal that the most decisive enabling conditions are intangible: trust, psychological safety, shared purpose, and relational dynamics. A consistent pattern of frugal innovation emerges, with resource scarcity activating systemic mechanisms that substitute material resources. Theoretically, the study operationalizes an abstract model of creativity in organizational contexts. Empirically, it expands insights beyond Global North settings. Practically, it offers public managers a lens for rendering visible innovation's invisible infrastructure.
items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 Csikszentmihalyi의 체계적 창의성 모형을 15개 범주로 조작화해 브라질의 OECD 공공부문 혁신 사례 60건을 분석함으로써 공공부문에서 체계적 창의성이 어떻게 나타나는지 살폈다. 신뢰, 심리적 안전, 공유된 목적, 관계적 역학 같은 무형 조건이 핵심 촉진 요인이며, 자원 부족이 물질적 자원을 대체하는 체계적 메커니즘을 작동시키는 절약형 혁신이 일관되게 나타났다.
items.title: Unveiling the intangible: a systemic perspective for creativity and innovation in public organizations

items.abstract: Research on burden tolerance suggests that people who previously faced burdens tend to be less accepting of administrative burdens more generally. However, the empirical focus has been on program-specific burdens and in particular social welfare programs. Thus, it remains an open question whether and how more general, everyday engagement with administrative tasks—and the emotional experiences involved—may influence burden tolerance. To better understand the relationship between administrative engagement, emotions, and burden tolerance, we survey residents in the United States, Mexico, the United Kingdom, and Denmark. We find that frequent engagement with administrative tasks is positively associated with burden tolerance in all countries, except Denmark, and that residents with more positive emotional experiences tend to be more tolerant of burdens. While correlational, we interpret these findings as suggesting that engagement with everyday administrative tasks builds capability for managing administrative burdens, which in turn fosters burden tolerance.

Lucie Martin: Economic and Social Research Institute Ireland

items.summary_ko: 미국·멕시코·영국·덴마크 주민 설문을 통해 일상적 행정업무 참여와 감정 경험이 행정부담 수용성에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 분석했다. 행정업무 참여 빈도가 높을수록 덴마크를 제외한 모든 국가에서 부담 수용성이 높았고, 긍정적 감정 경험이 많을수록 부담 수용성도 높았으며, 이는 일상적 행정업무 경험이 부담 관리 역량과 수용성을 높일 가능성을 시사한다.
items.title: Building tolerance through experience: administrative engagement and burden tolerance across four countries

items.abstract: Governments are increasingly deploying AI-based self-service technologies (AI-based SSTs) to improve government-to-business (G2B) services, yet little is known about why business users switch from human-assisted G2B services to AI-based SSTs. Drawing on the push–pull–mooring (PPM) framework, this study examines how negative incumbent service experiences, perceived benefits of AI-based SSTs, and status quo biases jointly shape switching intention. Using survey data from 461 business users in Chinese government service agencies and PLS-SEM, we find that perceived intelligence, shaped by responsiveness, personalization, and autonomy, together with physical attractiveness, procedural fairness, and structural assurance, generates pull effects toward AI-based SSTs. Switching costs, habit, and desire for human interaction strengthen inertia, which directly reduces switching intention and weakens the effects of both push and pull factors. The study extends the PPM framework to digital government service delivery and offers guidance for reducing inertia and promoting migration to AI-enabled self-service channels.

Hehui Yuan: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
Wenshan Guo: University of Science and Technology of China

items.summary_ko: 중국 정부기관의 기업 서비스 이용자 461명을 대상으로 PLS-SEM 설문분석을 실시해, 인간 지원 서비스에서 AI 기반 셀프서비스로 전환하려는 의도를 설명하는 요인을 PPM 프레임워크로 분석했다. AI 셀프서비스의 지각된 지능·매력·절차적 공정성·구조적 보장은 전환을 촉진했지만, 전환비용·습관·인간 상호작용 욕구에 따른 현상유지 편향은 전환의도를 낮추고 이러한 촉진 효과도 약화했다.
items.title: From human touch to aI-based self-service: antecedents of business users’ switching intention in government-to-business services

items.abstract: This study examines how merit appointments and bureaucratic autonomy influence corruption in African governments, and whether the independence and capability of anti-corruption institutions condition these relationships. Using two-way fixed effects regression to analyze a panel of 486 African countries from 2013–2021, we find that bureaucratic autonomy is negatively associated with corruption, while the relationship between merit appointments and corruption depends on the capability of anti-corruption institutions: where such institutions lack the capability to hold politicians and bureaucrats accountable, merit appointments are positively associated with corruption; as the capability of anti-corruption institutions increases, this relationship weakens and can eventually reverse. Neither the independence nor the capability of anti-corruption institutions is independently associated with corruption. These findings suggest that professionalizing civil service hiring without corresponding investments to bolster the capability of anti-corruption institutions can backfire and point to the conditions under which anti-corruption reforms are likely to succeed.

Faisal S. Cheema: Indiana University Bloomington, O’Neill School of Public and Environmental Affairs
Sergio Fernandez: Indiana University Bloomington, O’Neill School of Public and Environmental Affairs, Extraordinary Professor, University of Pretoria, School of Public Management and Administration

items.summary_ko: 아프리카 정부에서 능력주의 임용과 관료적 자율성이 부패에 미치는 영향, 그리고 반부패 기관의 독립성과 역량이 이를 조절하는지를 2013~2021년 아프리카 국가 패널에 대한 양방향 고정효과 회귀로 분석했다. 관료적 자율성은 부패와 음의 관련을 보였으며, 반부패 기관의 역량이 낮을 때 능력주의 임용은 부패와 양의 관련을 보였지만 역량이 높아질수록 그 관계가 약화되고 역전될 수 있었다.
items.title: Merit, autonomy, and corruption: the moderating role of anti-corruption institutions in Africa

items.abstract: Abstract How do international audiences psychologically engage with prolonged geopolitical conflicts on social media? Drawing on 1.2+ million English‐language tweets posted during the first 10 months of the Russia–Ukraine war, this study examines temporal shifts in engagement, emotion, existential concern, cognition, and psychological distance reflected through language. Results identified a clear psychological arc across the conflict. Discourse in the earliest phase was characterized by strong active engagement, heightened negative emotion, increased focus on death, conflict, and morality, and greater cognitive effort aimed at making sense of unfolding events. As the war persisted, these indicators declined and were replaced by shorter posts, fewer retweets, reduced existential focus, and simpler emotional and cognitive expression, consistent with attention fatigue and chronic crisis adaptation. Unexpectedly, psychological distance decreased over time, suggesting that users expressed themselves in more personal, spontaneous ways as the conflict became an enduring part of the digital environment. This challenges the view that declining engagement signals general disengagement and instead reveals a shift toward more grounded, personally meaningful forms of involvement. Findings illuminate the dynamic psychological processes through which publics respond to sustained conflict and highlight implications for political communication, humanitarian outreach, and crisis messaging strategies across the lifespan of international crises.

A. Burcu Bayram: Department of Political Science, Fulbright College of Arts and Sciences University of Arkansas Fayetteville Arkansas USA
Vivian P. Ta‐Johnson: Department of Psychology, College of Health, Community, and Policy University of Texas at San Antonio San Antonio Texas USA

items.summary_ko: 러시아·우크라이나 전쟁 초기 10개월 동안 영어 트윗 120만 건 이상을 분석해, 장기화된 지정학적 분쟁에서 국제적 연대에 대한 심리적 관여가 시간에 따라 어떻게 변화하는지 살폈다. 초기에는 적극적 관여와 부정적 감정, 죽음·갈등·도덕성 및 의미 해석에 대한 관심이 높았으나, 시간이 지나며 주의 피로와 만성적 위기 적응에 부합하는 표현의 단순화가 나타났고, 동시에 심리적 거리는 감소해 보다 개인적이고 자발적인 관여로 이동했다.
items.title: A complex arc of engagement: Shifting psychological trajectories of international solidarity during sustained geopolitical conflict

items.abstract: Abstract Intergroup contact programs worldwide strive to combat prejudice by promoting encounters between socially advantaged and disadvantaged groups. Despite their prevalence, little is known about how disadvantaged group members experience participation in such programs. We present qualitative field data from the German contact program Meet a Jew . In this program, Jewish volunteers engage in dialogue with attendees and share insights into their Jewish life to address antisemitism. Drawing on N = 450 volunteer responses (age range: 16–77 years) collected over five years (2020–2025), we examine the positive and negative experiences of volunteers with the arranged encounters. A qualitative content analysis shows that volunteers experienced contact as positive when their engagement and perspectives were met with interest, their efforts were socially recognized, and they perceived their engagement as effective in contributing to social change. However, volunteers also reported negative experiences, including disinterest from attendees, interference by authorities, and various conflicts. By providing the perspective of Jewish individuals who are both targets of prejudice and actors of prejudice reduction, we address the understudied perspective of disadvantaged group members who engage in contact interventions as agents of collective action. We discuss how our work contributes to contact theory and advances research on social change.

Dana Ionescu: Leibniz School of Education Leibniz Universität Hannover Hannover Germany
Fiona Kazarovytska: Department of Psychology RPTU University Kaiserslautern‐Landau Landau Germany
Micha Hilbert: Department of Psychology University of Münster, Institute of Psychology Münster Germany

items.summary_ko: 독일의 반유대주의 대응 프로그램 ‘Meet a Jew’에 참여한 유대인 자원봉사자들이 마련된 만남을 어떻게 경험하는지 질적 자료로 분석했다. 450명의 응답에 대한 질적 내용분석 결과, 관심·사회적 인정·사회변화에 기여한다는 인식은 긍정적 경험과, 참석자의 무관심·당국의 개입·갈등은 부정적 경험과 관련되었다.
items.title: Contact as collective action: Positive and negative contact experiences of disadvantaged group members

items.abstract: ABSTRACT As artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly transforms public administration, understanding its impact on perceived legitimacy becomes paramount, particularly, in high‐stakes areas such as policing. While existing research offers mixed evidence on whether government AI use enhances or undermines citizens' perceptions of fairness and trust, the conditions moderating these effects remain underexplored. Drawing on representative bureaucracy theory, this study uses a survey experiment to investigate how gender representation moderates the effect of AI use on citizens' perceived fairness and trust in domestic violence units (DVUs). Results show that female representation positively moderates the legitimacy impact of a DVU's AI use; whereas AI use decreases female respondents' perceived fairness and trust in male‐dominated DVUs, these negative effects disappear in female‐dominated DVUs. Our findings identify representation as a key context shaping citizens' responses to government AI use, extending representative bureaucracy theory by demonstrating its indirect symbolic effects.

Canyu Gao: School of Public Affairs and Administration, Rutgers University‐Newark Newark New Jersey USA
Norma M. Riccucci: School of Public Affairs and Administration, Rutgers University‐Newark Newark New Jersey USA

items.summary_ko: 가정폭력 전담부서에서 인공지능(AI) 사용이 시민의 공정성 인식과 신뢰에 미치는 영향을 성별 대표성이 어떻게 조절하는지 설문 실험으로 분석했다. AI 사용은 남성 중심 부서에서 여성 응답자의 공정성 인식과 신뢰를 낮췄지만, 여성 중심 부서에서는 이러한 부정적 효과가 나타나지 않았다.
items.title: Artificial Intelligence in Policing and Perceived Legitimacy: Does Gender Representation Make a Difference?

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Job advertisements play a crucial role in attracting applicants, yet little is known about how closely they reflect the values citizens expect from public servants. Drawing on signaling theory and prior research on citizens' normative expectations of ideal public servants, this study employs a large language model to analyze 1825 job advertisements from health and transportation departments across seven U.S. states. Compared to the values citizens associate with ideal public servants in previous research, job advertisements predominantly emphasize values, such as expertise and dedication, while undersignaling relational values like serviceability, responsiveness, and honesty. Our findings suggest a misalignment between the values signaled in recruitment practices and those citizens associate with the ideal public servant. By adopting a citizen‐driven perspective, this study prompts scholars and public managers to question recruitment practices that may underemphasize values citizens prioritize in public servants, potentially limiting public administrations' ability to attract qualified candidates.

Dominik Vogel: Harz University of Applied Sciences Halberstadt Germany

items.summary_ko: 시민들이 이상적인 공무원에게 기대하는 가치와 공공기관 채용공고가 전달하는 가치가 얼마나 일치하는지를 분석하기 위해, 연구진은 신호이론과 기존 시민 기대 연구를 바탕으로 7개 주(州) 보건·교통 부처의 채용공고 1,825건을 대규모 언어모델로 분석했다. 채용공고는 전문성과 헌신을 주로 강조한 반면, 시민들이 중시하는 봉사성·응답성·정직성과 같은 관계적 가치는 상대적으로 덜 제시해 양자 간 불일치가 나타났다.
items.title: Citizens' Expectations vs. Recruitment Signals: Are Public Administrations Trying to Attract the Ideal Public Servant?

items.abstract: This article examines how multilevel policymaking influences strategic public management. Multilevel governance arrangements are nowadays a recurrent feature in the public sector; the ability of public authorities to design and implement coherent and effective frameworks is affected by the interaction across multiple levels of government. The research was carried out through a case study focusing on gambling regulation in the Friuli Venezia Giulia Region in Italy. Data have been gathered combining the analysis of documents, interviews and surveys within a few mixed-method research projects (2018–2024). By appreciating gambling policy as a legitimacy-driven and institutionally embedded field, the research allows to see beyond well-known implementation challenges of multilevel policymaking. It shows how incoherent policies and stalemate are not necessarily the result of policy failures but could be due to deliberate decoupling strategic responses. Moreover, the study contributes novel insights on how decoupling operates across governance levels and in multiple directions.
items.summary_ko: 다층적 정책결정이 전략적 공공관리와 도박 규제에 어떤 영향을 미치는지, 이탈리아 프리울리베네치아줄리아주의 사례를 문서 분석·인터뷰·설문을 결합한 혼합방법으로 분석했다. 정책의 불일치와 교착은 반드시 정책 실패가 아니라 의도적인 전략적 디커플링의 결과일 수 있으며, 디커플링은 거버넌스 수준을 가로질러 여러 방향으로 작동하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Policymaking in a multilevel setting: perverse effects on regulating gambling

items.abstract: We examine the cross-national comparability of expert placements of political partieson the economic left-right dimension using a novel dataset combining data from Europe, Latin America, Australia, Israel, Canada, and the United States. Using anchoring vignettes and Bayesian Aldrich-McKelvey Scaling (BAM), we assess evidence of geographic and expert-level differential item functioning (DIF) in how experts interpret the left-right scale. We find statistically significant but substantively small variations in how experts perceive party positions cross-nationally, particularly in terms of directional bias and the spread of their ideological placements. While the correlation between “raw” survey scores and DIF-corrected estimates is high (0.992), we observe meaningful deviations for individual parties, with larger discrepancies between rather than within regions. These results indicate that the economic left-right dimension exhibits broad consistency in expert understanding across countries, yet researchers should still exercise caution when making cross-national comparisons, particularly across regions where expert perceptions show greater variation.
items.summary_ko: 국가와 전문가에 따라 경제적 좌우파 정당 배치를 해석하는 방식이 다른지, 앵커링 비네트와 베이지안 Aldrich–McKelvey 척도화(BAM)를 결합한 자료로 분석했다. 전문가 인식의 국가 간 차이는 통계적으로 유의했지만 실질적으로 작았고, 원자료와 DIF 보정 추정치의 상관은 매우 높았으며, 지역 간 비교에서는 개별 정당의 차이에 주의가 필요했다.
items.title: A Global Scale of Economic Left–Right Party Positions: Cross-National and Cross-Expert Perceptions of Party Placements

items.abstract: Encouraging citizens to apply pressure on underperforming service providers has emerged as a prominent response to the failure of states to provide needed services. We outline three theoretical mechanisms through which bottom-up citizen pressure campaigns may affect service provision and investigate them via a large-scale field experiment in the Ugandan health sector. While we find modest positive impacts on health provider behavior, we find no effects on citizen pressure, utilization rates, or bottom-line health outcomes. Our findings cast doubt on the power of outside actors to generate improvements in development outcomes by mobilizing bottom-up pressure—at least under conditions similar to those in our study setting. Our results also underscore the importance of baseline health conditions for the success of bottom-up, citizen-oriented pressure campaigns. Such conditions shape outcomes both across countries and within countries over time, with the latter finding holding important implications for countries undergoing rapid socioeconomic change.
items.summary_ko: 우간다 보건 부문에서 대규모 현장실험을 실시해 시민이 저성과 서비스 제공자에게 압력을 가하도록 유도하는 캠페인이 서비스 제공을 개선할 수 있는지 검토했다. 서비스 제공자의 행동에는 소폭의 긍정적 효과가 있었지만 시민 압력, 이용률, 최종적인 건강 성과에는 효과가 없었으며, 기초 건강 여건이 캠페인 성과를 좌우하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Can Citizen Pressure Be Induced to Improve Public Service Provision?

items.abstract: How does the level of sophistication in political messages affect citizens? While research has examined how politicians use this element to distinguish themselves, little is known about how it resonates with citizens. We theorize that using simple language in political communication can increase citizens’ political knowledge and influence their beliefs about politicians. In a study conducted in Germany using preregistered and large-scale survey experiments, respondents were shown political statements that varied in linguistic sophistication and other factors. The results indicate that simplicity improves citizens’ political knowledge and helps them fill in gaps in information about politicians’ socioeconomic backgrounds. Additionally, simple language has no direct impact in the electoral arena but was found to moderate the effect of politicians’ policy positions. Our findings suggest that linguistic styles can be a powerful tool in contemporary political campaigns.

Daniel Bischof: University of Münster and Aarhus University

items.summary_ko: 정치적 메시지의 언어적 단순성이 시민의 정치 지식과 정치인에 대한 믿음에 어떤 영향을 미치는지, 독일에서 사전등록된 대규모 설문 실험으로 분석했다. 단순한 언어는 정치 지식을 높이고 정치인의 사회경제적 배경에 관한 정보 공백을 보완했으며, 선거에 직접적인 영향은 없지만 정치인의 정책 입장 효과를 조절했다.
items.title: Can Simple Language Affect Voters’ Political Knowledge and Their Beliefs About Politicians?

items.abstract: This study leverages a two-stage response-adaptive experimental design to explore how tailored digital messaging can influence public attitudes toward health interventions, with broader implications for political communication. In public health settings, quickly scaling effective communication is critical; adaptive designs enable efficient learning of relevant treatments. For this study, we recruited 22,052 Facebook users in Kenya and Nigeria to engage in conversations on Messenger about their concerns regarding COVID-19 vaccines. We optimized messaging using an adaptive algorithm, then experimentally evaluated the concern-addressing messaging. We found that the tailored messaging increased COVID-19 vaccine intentions and willingness by 4% to 5% compared to a control condition, and by 3% to 4% compared to a public service announcement. We observed the largest effects among those most vaccine hesitant at baseline. Personalized digital messaging interventions offer a scalable communication tool to encourage compliance with public health programs.
items.summary_ko: 케냐와 나이지리아의 페이스북 이용자 22,052명을 대상으로, 코로나19 백신에 대한 우려를 대화형으로 다루는 맞춤형 메시지가 백신 접종 의향과 수용 의사에 미치는 영향을 순차적 반응적응 실험으로 검증했다. 맞춤형 메시지는 통제조건보다 4~5%, 공익광고보다 3~4% 의향과 수용 의사를 높였으며, 기초 백신 주저 수준이 높은 사람들에게 효과가 가장 컸다.
items.title: Conversations with a Concern-Addressing Chatbot Increased COVID-19 Vaccination Intentions Among Social Media Users in Kenya and Nigeria

items.abstract: Some studies show that voters punish parties for violence, while others find that violence can benefit politicians. We argue that core and swing voters support rather than punish violence by co-partisans under some conditions. Parties aim to benefit from violence by portraying it as a response to a threat, provocation, or injustice by an out-group or rival party. Once legitimized by politicians, voters support violence by co-partisans and punish them for peaceful responses. We test our argument with preregistered vignette experiments in a representative survey during the 2022 elections in Uttar Pradesh, India. Our findings support expectations; respondents are more likely to support violence and approve of parties involved in it when it is legitimized. These effects are driven by Hindus as the majority group, in particular core supporters of the incumbent party. Our study establishes the micro-foundations of support for violence in democracies.

Ursula Daxecker: University of Amsterdam and Max Planck Institute for Political and Social Science

items.summary_ko: 정당이 폭력을 위협·도발·부당함에 대한 대응으로 정당화할 때 유권자들이 동료 정당원의 폭력을 지지하고 평화적 대응을 한 정당을 처벌하는지, 2022년 인도 우타르프라데시주 대표성 설문에 포함한 사전등록 비네트 실험으로 검증했다. 폭력이 정당화된 경우 폭력 지지와 관련 정당에 대한 승인이 높아졌으며, 이러한 효과는 다수 집단인 힌두교도, 특히 집권당 핵심 지지자에게서 두드러졌다.
items.title: Demanding Violence, Punishing Peace: Support for Party Violence in India

items.abstract: Growing evidence suggests that voters reward politicians for spending on disaster relief but not disaster preparedness. Yet, we know little about the mechanisms that underpin this pattern. Is it because voters generally value relief over preparedness? Or is it because voters expect preparedness policies to be less effective compared to relief policies? I test both mechanisms using a conjoint experiment in rural Malawi in which participants choose between two hypothetical candidates randomly varying attributes about their preparedness and relief policies. I find that respondents reward relief efforts over preparedness efforts, but they value effective preparedness similarly to effective relief. Additionally, respondents are more likely to reward preparedness efforts if they repeatedly observe that they are effective in mitigating disaster damages. Taken together, the evidence suggests that voters have pessimistic expectations about the effectiveness of preparedness policies but would reward preparedness similarly to relief if it is known to be effective.
items.summary_ko: 말라위 농촌 유권자들이 재난 구호보다 대비 정책을 덜 보상하는 이유가 선호 차이인지 효과성 기대 차이인지 검토하기 위해, 대비·구호 정책의 속성을 무작위로 조합한 선택형 실험을 실시했다. 응답자들은 구호를 더 높게 평가했지만, 효과적인 대비는 효과적인 구호와 비슷하게 평가했으며 대비 정책의 효과를 반복적으로 관찰할수록 이를 보상할 가능성이 높아졌다.
items.title: Do Voters Value Relief over Preparedness? Evidence from Disaster Policies in Malawi

items.abstract: Are campaign donors simply affluent people who happen to give to campaigns, or do donors and the affluent differ in their policy views? To investigate this, we surveyed verified 2017–2018 donors, affluent individuals, and the general public. Comparing copartisans shows that donors in both parties hold more ideologically extreme positions on domestic policy than either the affluent or the general public. On international issues, Democratic donors are more pro-internationalist than their affluent and general-public counterparts, while Republican donors resemble affluent copartisans. These patterns cannot be explained by demographic differences or levels of political interest. Examining variation across donor types, we find that some donors are more prone to extreme positions than others, yet donors remain distinct from the affluent whether they contributed out of state, donated small amounts, or recently supported a presidential candidate.
items.summary_ko: 정치 캠페인 기부자가 단순히 기부하는 부유층과 정책 견해에서 다른지를 검증된 2017~2018년 기부자·부유층·일반 대중 설문으로 비교했다. 양당의 기부자는 국내 정책에서 부유층과 일반 대중보다 이념적으로 더 극단적이었고, 국제 이슈에서는 민주당 기부자가 더 국제주의적이었으며 이러한 차이는 인구학적 특성이나 정치적 관심 수준으로 설명되지 않았다.
items.title: Donors and Dollars: Comparing the Policy Views of Donors and the Affluent

Sina Chen: GESIS - Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences

items.summary_ko: 초록에 내용이 제공되지 않아 연구 질문, 접근법, 주요 발견을 확인할 수 없다.
items.title: Electoral Predictors of Polling Errors

items.abstract: Members of Congress face consistent pressure—and ample opportunity—to express their ideological positions. The most commonly measured outlet is congressional floor votes, but it is not the only one. This research develops three novel ideal point measures across different ideological expressions—votes, floor speeches, and tweets—to capture the understudied interaction between ideology, communication style, and audience. We find that legislators use speech and tweets to convey nuance in their ideological positions and to differentiate themselves from other members of their party in ways that voting does not allow. In general, Republicans use text-based opportunities, particularly Twitter, to express more conservative positions, while Democratic positioning is dependent on a legislator’s district and personal attributes. In both theory and methods, this work engages the considerable literature on the measurement of ideology and congressional representation. This research contributes to our understanding of legislator behavior and ideological positioning and introduces three replicable ideal point models to measure the ideology of members of the US Congress.
items.summary_ko: 미국 의원들이 투표·본회의 연설·트위터라는 서로 다른 이념 표현과 청중을 통해 이념적 입장을 어떻게 드러내는지, 세 가지 이상점수 모형으로 분석한다. 연설과 트위터는 투표보다 이념적 뉘앙스와 당내 차별화를 가능하게 하며, 공화당 의원은 특히 트위터에서 더 보수적인 입장을 표현하는 반면 민주당 의원의 입장은 지역구와 개인 특성에 따라 달라진다.
items.title: Express Yourself (Ideologically): Legislators’ Ideal Points Across Audiences

items.abstract: Policies interact with underlying social organizations, which can deflect their intended goals. One example is legislation aimed at curbing business influence. Can campaign finance regulation reduce the political power of economic actors? We identify a factor that may hinder its effectiveness: the social structure of organizations. We argue that such regulation generates cooperation dilemmas within firms’ leadership and propose that a specific organizational feature—family ties—can help resolve them. We evaluate this argument by studying a ban on corporate contributions in Brazil, using granular data on family ties in publicly traded firms. We show that, following the ban, members of firms’ controlling families substituted individual for corporate contributions. Moreover, we document peer effects in the contributions of family members, suggesting that family ties are a channel of political influence. These bifurcated effects illustrate how organizational structure can be a source of de facto power and offer a cautionary note to policymakers.
items.summary_ko: 브라질의 기업 기부 금지법과 상장기업의 가족관계 자료를 분석해, 기업 내부의 사회적 구조가 기업 영향력 규제의 효과를 어떻게 약화시키는지 검토했다. 금지 이후 지배가족 구성원들은 기업 명의 기부를 개인 기부로 대체했으며, 가족 구성원 간 기부의 동조 효과는 가족관계가 정치적 영향력의 통로임을 시사했다.
items.title: Family Ties as Corporate Power

items.abstract: Why do individual donors attend fundraising events, and, relatedly, why do candidates rely on events to finance their campaigns? Despite public concerns around this mode of donation, fundraising events have received little scholarly attention. We use campaign finance disclosures in four US states, which indicate event- and nonevent status of donations, linked to political candidates to examine two hypotheses. First, events help candidates draw on individual donors’ nonideological motivations, including material motivations. Second, events help candidates fundraise when ideological motivations are relatively low. We provide evidence that donors discount ideology when they attend events and link agenda powers of legislative incumbents to increases in event donations, including from individuals in related business sectors. Furthermore, we show that early donations from individuals are more likely to be made via events than later donations, especially for incumbents. Our results highlight implications of event fundraising for responsiveness, partisan polarization, and candidate selection.

Sebastian Thieme: Centre for European Studies and Comparative Politics, Sciences Po

items.summary_ko: 미국 4개 주의 선거자금 공개자료에서 행사·비행사 기부 여부를 식별해 후보자 자료와 연계하고, 모금행사 참여가 개인 기부자의 비이념적 동기와 이념적 동기가 낮은 상황의 모금을 촉진하는지 분석했다. 행사 기부에서는 이념의 중요성이 낮아지고 현직자의 의제설정 권한 및 초기 개인 기부와 행사 기부가 연관되는 결과가 나타났다.
items.title: Fundraising Events and Nonideological Donation Motivations

items.abstract: This paper argues that the way families were organized in premodern Europe exerts lasting consequences for women’s political engagement. In “stem families” cohabitation with mothers-in-law allowed adult women to share responsibility for domestic production and engage in paid employment. In “nuclear families” newlyweds created new households, forcing wives to specialize in domestic production. To examine the longterm effects of unequal gendered division of labor, we combine historical census data with municipality-level election data from Spain between 1978 and 2015. Although historical family types vanished in the twentieth century, former stem-family regions show higher female labor force participation, more progressive gender attitudes, and higher female political representation. We also investigate the way voluntary party quotas counteracted political discrimination against women in regions formerly populated by nuclear families. By focusing on historical family structure, we uncover an original cause of female political underrepresentation in Europe and shed light on both historical persistence and change. Word count: 11,720 (includes figures, tables, numbers and citations in the main text) ∗We thank Alba Huidobro, Júlia Diaz Collado, and Guillem Amatller for excellent research assistance. We also thank Manuel Bagues, Rachel Berhnard, Alice Evans, Marta Fraile, Varun Karekurve-Ramachandra, Frederick Solt, and seminar participants at the University of Barcelona, Bergen, Geneva, Hamburg, Konstanz, Rochester, Zurich, and the Trinity College Dublin, the Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich, and University College London, and APSA 2021 and EPSA 2022. The research leading to this paper has received financial support from the project “Local politicians: selection and performance (LEADERS)” (CSO201679569-P) funded by the Spanish Ministry for the Economy, Industry and Competitiveness and the project “How Technological Chance Reshapes Politics: Technology, Elections and Policies” (TECHNO), funded by the NORFACE programme of the European Union (PCI2020-112198) and the German Research Foundation under Germany‘s Excellence Strategy – EXC-2035/1 – 390681379.

Aina Gallego: University of Barcelona and Institut de Barcelona d’Estudis Internacionals

items.summary_ko: 근대 이전 유럽의 가족 유형이 여성의 정치 참여와 대표성에 장기적으로 영향을 미치는지 검토하기 위해, 스페인의 역사적 인구조사 자료와 1978~2015년 지방자치단체 선거자료를 결합해 분석했다. 줄기형 가족 지역은 여성 노동시장 참여, 진보적 성평등 태도, 여성 정치대표성이 더 높았으며, 자발적 정당 할당제가 핵가족 지역의 여성에 대한 정치적 차별을 완화했다.
items.title: Historical Family Types and Female Political Representation: Persistence and Change

items.abstract: Encouraging engagement with out-group perspectives is a popular strategy to improve intergroup relations. But in deeply divided societies, individuals often actively avoid out-group members. In a Facebook field experiment, we embedded Palestinian posts in Jewish Israelis’ Facebook timelines for a period of 14 days. We find no effect on attitudes toward the out-group and a modest decrease in subsequent consumption of out-group content, a pattern we attribute to participants’ avoidance of constructive engagement. To better understand this avoidance, we conducted a set of survey-embedded behavioral tasks. Results suggest that out-group avoidance online is widespread, associated with out-group prejudice, explained by feelings of discomfort, anger, mistrust in out-groups, and pessimism, and challenging to overcome. Our findings indicate that avoidance is a barrier to constructive intergroup engagement in naturalistic settings, rendering many interventions that may be effective in controlled environments difficult to implement or scale in practice.
items.summary_ko: 팔레스타인인의 관점을 유대계 이스라엘인의 페이스북 타임라인에 14일간 노출하고 후속 행동 과제를 실시해, 타집단 회피와 태도 변화를 조사했다. 타집단 콘텐츠 노출은 태도에 영향을 주지 않았고 이후 소비를 소폭 감소시켰으며, 온라인 회피는 널리 나타나고 편견·불편감·분노·불신·비관과 관련되어 건설적 상호작용을 제약했다.
items.title: Out-Group Avoidance

items.abstract: This study examines the extent to which Black female political elites face a unique combination of disadvantages in the American political arena on account of their dual race–gender identity. More precisely, this project considers whether respondents have more negative perceptions of Black female political elites relative to White female, White male, and Black male political elites. Using Crenshaw’s 1989 framework of intersectionality, hypotheses about the interactive (or “intersectional”) disadvantages faced by Black female political elites are tested using (1) a 1,000-respondent public opinion survey fielded with Cloud Research (Prime Panels) and (2) a 1,000-respondent survey experiment fielded with Dynata. This project offers one of the first empirical tests of intersectional claims common in the literature. Results suggest a complex story: There are nuanced circumstances under which Black female politicians suffer penalties among American respondents as a consequence of both race and gender.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 미국 정치에서 인종과 성별의 교차적 정체성 때문에 흑인 여성 정치 엘리트가 백인 여성·백인 남성·흑인 남성 정치 엘리트보다 더 부정적으로 평가되는지 검토한다. 두 개의 1,000명 표본 설문과 설문 실험을 통해 분석한 결과, 흑인 여성 정치인은 인종과 성별의 결합으로 인해 미국 응답자에게 불이익을 받지만 그 양상은 상황에 따라 복합적이었다.
items.title: Race, Gender, and Public Opinion Toward Black Female Political Elites

items.abstract: Associations that individuals make between a personality trait and its level of assumed masculinity or femininity are a prominent thread across the gender and politics literature. Yet, whether an attribute is categorized by scholars as “masculine” or “feminine” continues to be determined by studies that are decades old, and which often initially rested on scholarly assumptions rather than testing. Inaccurate assumptions may drive incorrect conclusions about the ways in which gendered associations influence voter and party decision-making, and contribute to ongoing gender bias in leadership evaluations. We use an original survey of 26 commonly-cited character traits associated with leadership, sampling 1,417 respondents in Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and the United States of America. We find evidence that scholarly categorization of the gendered associations diverges from how respondents rated many of those traits, and offer a modified list of gender-associated traits for researchers.
items.summary_ko: 연구는 리더십 관련 성격 특성의 남성성·여성성에 대한 학계의 분류가 실제 응답자의 인식과 일치하는지 묻는다. 호주·캐나다·뉴질랜드·영국·미국의 1,417명을 대상으로 26개 특성을 조사한 결과, 많은 특성에서 학계의 분류와 응답자의 성별 연상이 diverged하며, 연구자들이 사용할 수정된 성별 연관 특성 목록을 제시한다.
items.title: The Contemporary Landscape of Gendered Personality Traits

items.abstract: In electoral autocracies where election results significantly influence regime stability, new leaders need to gather public support despite their shaky political support base. To overcome this problem, autocracies often rely on tutelage, in which a former autocrat helps a new leader retain public support as a guardian. This article explores whether autocratic guardianship in fact boosts popular support by conducting survey experiments in Kazakhstan, where Kassym-Jomart Tokayev assumed the presidential position from the long-serving autocrat Nursultan Nazarbayev. By using the item count technique and endorsement experiment to elicit truthful responses, we find that the successor Tokayev is more popular than the guardian Nazarbayev, and thus Nazarbayev’s involvement in decision-making does not necessarily increase public support for policies. Our analysis suggests that, contrary to the proclaimed benefits of tutelage, whether tutelary power contributes to garnering popular support depends on the perceived quality of guardians.
items.summary_ko: 카자흐스탄의 권력승계에서 전임 독재자의 후견이 후임 지도자와 정책에 대한 대중 지지를 높이는지 설문 실험으로 검토했다. 익명 응답을 유도하는 항목수 기법과 지지자 표명 실험 결과, 후임자 토카예프가 후견인 나자르바예프보다 더 인기가 높았으며 후견의 효과는 후견인의 인식된 자질에 달려 있는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Tutelary Power and Autocratic Legitimacy: Experimental Evidence from Kazakhstan’s Diarchy

items.abstract: Using a lagged cross-sectional design, this study provides a historical cross-national assessment of whether Financial Management Information Systems (FMIS) condition the association between e-government development and perceived corruption. This study conceptualizes FMIS as a catalyst that strengthens the anti-corruption relevance of e-government. The analysis combines consolidated indicators of FMIS maturity and FMIS-related fiscal disclosure capacity finalized in 2017 with 2013–2017 averages of e-government development and control variables and subsequent corruption-perception outcomes for 2018–2023, covering up to 160 countries. Across multiple regression specifications, higher e-Government Development Index (EGDI) scores are associated with lower perceived corruption (CPI). More importantly, both FMIS maturity and fiscal information disclosure capacity significantly strengthen this relationship. These findings remain robust across additional specifications and when using the Control of Corruption Index (CCI) as an alternative dependent variable. Overall, the results suggest that e-government development can be more effective in improving corruption perceptions where FMIS are functionally mature and fiscal information is more broadly disclosed.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 e정부 발전과 부패 인식의 관계를 FMIS의 성숙도와 재정정보 공개 역량이 어떻게 조절하는지 국가 간 시차 횡단면 자료로 분석했다. 분석 결과, e정부 발전 수준이 높을수록 인지된 부패가 낮았으며, FMIS 성숙도와 재정정보 공개 역량이 높을 때 이 관계가 유의하게 강화되었다.
items.title: Strengthening e-government's impact on corruption perception: The moderating role of Financial Management Information Systems (FMIS)

items.abstract: Digital platforms are increasingly used to address regulatory fragmentation, yet evidence from actual regulatory behavior remains limited. This study examines how inspection coordination is organized under Nanjing's “181” integrated emergency management platform. Drawing on 37,876 inspection records from August 2023 to January 2025, we construct a 2-mode inspection network linking 719 inspection departments and 7934 regulated entities through 34,053 inspection ties, and estimate Exponential Random Graph Models (ERGMs). The results show that coordination is organized through three related patterns. Structurally, district-level departments occupy central positions, with the strongest cluster in Yuhuatai District. In terms of coordination coverage, inspection overlap is concentrated around selected regulated entities rather than evenly distributed, a pattern consistent with shared regulatory attention. In terms of coordination responsiveness, departments that identify hazards more often are more likely to form inspection ties. These findings show how platform-generated administrative records reveal the organization of regulatory coordination in a hierarchical administrative system through recorded activities, shared targets, and risk information.
items.summary_ko: 난징 ‘181’ 통합 응급관리 플랫폼에서 검사 조정이 어떻게 조직되는지, 2023년 8월부터 2025년 1월까지의 검사 기록 37,876건으로 2모드 검사 네트워크를 구축하고 ERGM을 추정해 분석했다. 분석 결과, 구 단위 부서의 중심성, 일부 피검사 대상에 집중된 검사 중복, 위험을 더 자주 발견하는 부서 간 검사 연결 가능성 증가라는 세 가지 조정 패턴이 나타났다.
items.title: Digital platforms and regulatory coordination patterns in China: Network evidence from Nanjing's “181” integrated emergency management system

items.abstract: Abstract Public administrators are increasingly called upon to create “generative spaces” that foster emergent processes of collaboration, learning and innovation. This article presents an inductive and ethnographically grounded study of one relatively novel but increasingly popular generative space—a regulatory sandbox. A regulatory sandbox is a controlled and defined space and set of processes that are established by regulators to work with innovators to collaboratively explore, test and learn about early-stage products and innovations and understand emerging regulatory implications. Investigating a sandbox to explore the regulation of new artificial intelligence technologies conducted by a national healthcare regulator, we identify the organizing practices of the sandbox that make it “generative” of collaboration, learning and innovation. An inductive analysis identified three key organizing practices: providing distinct and varied social spaces separated from normal regulatory demands (protection); enabling participants to collaboratively examine innovations and iteratively develop new knowledge and regulation (adaptation); and supporting focused and immersive examination of innovations from a diverse range of perspectives (participation). A theoretically-driven secondary analysis suggests that generative spaces can be understood as liminal experiences that foster detachment, equivalence and reconstruction.

Carl Macrae: University of Cambridge, Strangeways Research Laboratory Research Professor, THIS Institute (The Healthcare Improvement Studies Institute), , Cambridge CB1 8RN,

items.summary_ko: 규제 샌드박스가 협력·학습·혁신을 촉진하는 ‘생성적 공간’이 되는 조직화 관행을 탐색하기 위해, 국가 보건 규제기관의 신흥 인공지능 기술 규제 샌드박스를 대상으로 귀납적 민족지 연구를 수행했다. 분석 결과, 일상적 규제 요구와 분리된 보호, 혁신과 규제를 반복적으로 공동 개발하는 적응, 다양한 관점의 집중적 참여가 생성성을 형성했으며, 이 공간은 분리·동등화·재구성을 촉진하는 리미널 경험으로 해석될 수 있었다.
items.title: Generative Spaces: Collaboration, Learning and Innovation in a Regulatory Sandbox

items.abstract: ABSTRACT In Public Administration and the Crisis of American Democracy, Don Kettl asks why some federal agencies are great places to work while others are not, pointing to the persistent gap between NASA and the Department of Homeland Security. This essay argues that the answer may turn on how the legitimate role of public employees in democratic governance is construed. Drawing on three interpretive frames—bureaucracy, democracy, and pragmatism—it examines 2024 employee survey responses at NASA and DHS that map onto these frames. DHS appears dominated by the bureaucracy frame, positioning employees as implementers whose voice is risky and expertise underused. NASA blends all three frames, treating employees as contributors, stewards, and problem solvers. These frames offer a partial explanation for Kettl's puzzle and a conceptual tool for his “fourth way”: great government workplaces are built when public servants are recognized as legitimate contributors to democratic governance, not just cogs in a bureaucratic wheel.

Leisha DeHart‐Davis: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill Chapel Hill North Carolina USA

items.summary_ko: 이 글은 NASA와 국토안보부(DHS)가 일하기 좋은 직장으로 평가되는 정도가 다른 이유를 공공 employees의 민주적 거버넌스에서의 정당한 역할을 어떻게 이해하는지에 초점을 두고 검토한다. 2024년 직원 설문 응답을 관료제·민주주의·실용주의의 해석 틀에 대응시킨 결과, DHS는 직원을 주로 집행자로 보는 반면 NASA는 기여자·관리자·문제 해결자로 결합해 인식하며, 공공 servants를 민주적 거버넌스의 정당한 기여자로 인정하는 것이 ‘제4의 길’의 일부가 될 수 있다고 주장한다.
items.title: Reply to Kettl: Great Workplaces, Public Employee Legitimacy and the Fourth Way

items.abstract: ABSTRACT How do government attention and policy agendas shift when information constraints are relaxed through technological advancement? Punctuated equilibrium theory links agenda‐setting dynamics to governments' limited information‐processing capabilities, yet we know little about whether and how technology improvement such as artificial intelligence (AI) influences policy agendas. This article proposes a conditional digital punctuation framework to specify the conditions under which technological advancements drive agenda shifts. Using China's implementation of AI initiatives as a quasi‐natural experiment, we find that government attention exhibits a punctuated pattern. AI increases technology‐focused attention, signaling incremental changes, while having minimal impact on general government attention. This selective impact stems from AI's asymmetric effects on information processing. Specifically, AI significantly increases the procurement‐based indicator of information quantity, which is associated with greater attention to technology sectors; however, no significant change is observed in the corresponding indicator of information quality, consistent with its limited impact on general government attention.

items.summary_ko: 정보 제약이 기술 발전으로 완화될 때 정부의 관심과 정책 의제가 어떻게 변하는지 분석하기 위해, 중국의 AI 정책 시행을 준자연실험으로 활용했다. AI는 기술 분야에 대한 관심을 증가시켰지만 일반적 정부 관심에는 유의미한 영향을 거의 미치지 않았으며, 이는 정보량은 늘렸으나 정보의 질에는 유의미한 변화가 없었던 비대칭적 정보처리 효과와 일치한다.
items.title: Artificial Intelligence and Punctuated Equilibrium: Shaping Government Attention in the Digital Age

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Public servants often work under organizational constraints that hinder how they experience and carry out their work. Drawing on conservation of resources theory, this research examines how changes in these constraints affect public servants' perceptions that their work benefits others and, in turn, their well‐being and withdrawal behavior. Using data from two longitudinal studies conducted in the United States and France, the findings show that increases in organizational constraints are associated with declines in perceived prosocial impact, which in turn predict lower well‐being and greater withdrawal over time. These results identify perceived prosocial impact as a key psychological resource that links changing work conditions to employee functioning. By emphasizing the dynamic nature of organizational constraints, this study advances the understanding of how evolving administrative conditions can weaken the psychological foundations that sustain meaningful and effective public service.

Caroline Manville: University of Toulouse Capitole Toulouse France
Karim Mignonac: University of Toulouse Capitole Toulouse France

items.summary_ko: 미국과 프랑스에서 수행한 두 종단 연구를 통해, 조직적 제약의 증가가 공직자의 업무가 타인에게 미치는 긍정적 영향에 대한 인식을 낮추고, 이는 시간에 따른 웰빙 저하와 철회 행동 증가로 이어지는지를 분석했다. 분석 결과 조직적 제약이 증가할수록 지각된 친사회적 영향이 감소했으며, 이 감소가 낮은 웰빙과 더 큰 철회를 예측했다.
items.title: Hindered From Making a Difference: How Increasing Organizational Constraints Undermine Public Servants' Perceptions of Prosocial Impact and Why It Matters

items.abstract: Liberal democracy requires that minority groups be represented in politics. This article argues that minority representation can also generate headwinds for political inclusion by dividing the minority group and consolidating the dominant group. I study the combination of these processes, termed the representation trap, through a mixed-methods examination of Muslims in India. Analyses of election results and an original survey of Hindu and Muslim voters show that electing a Muslim representative divides Muslim votes across an increased share of coethnic candidates and consolidates Hindu votes for the majoritarian party in the subsequent election. Qualitative evidence and a vignette experiment trace these patterns to two mechanisms: sub-identity activation among Muslims and super-ordinate identity mobilization among Hindus. By showing how representation restructures elite and voter behavior within both minority and dominant groups, the article highlights the dynamic nature of ethnic politics and complicates the view of minorities as politically unified.
items.summary_ko: 이 글은 소수집단 대표의 선출이 정치적 포용을 촉진하기보다 소수집단 내부의 분열과 지배집단의 결집을 초래하는 ‘대표성의 함정’이 어떻게 나타나는지 인도의 무슬림을 대상으로 분석한다. 선거 결과 분석, 힌두교도·무슬림 유권자 대상 설문, 질적 증거와 비네트 실험을 결합해, 무슬림 대표 선출 이후 무슬림 표가 더 많은 동족 후보에게 분산되고 힌두 표가 다수주의 정당으로 결집하며, 그 배경에 하위 정체성 활성화와 상위 정체성 동원이 있음을 보인다.
items.title: The Representation Trap: How Minority Power Shapes Electoral Politics in India

items.abstract: Abstract This study explores how digital news use among young Europeans links to radical belief dispositions, particularly within gaming platforms and messengers, where socio‐affective dynamics shape engagement with political information. We argue that online groups are an overlooked locus for biased information processing and the normalization of extremist worldviews. The conflation of an increasingly fragmented online news space with the inherently politicized gaming cosmos can relate to amplified problematic worldviews based on shared activity, identity, and reality. Based on a cross‐country survey ( N = 1489; eight European countries), we compare (the use of) gaming, messenger apps, social media, and traditional media for news in terms of how they afford problematic forms of collectivity, particularly in relation to social, cynical, and radical epistemologies. We find a robust correlation between news use and a set of radical belief dispositions, prominently with messenger apps, but even more so in gaming‐related online environments—less so on social media and none with traditional news use. Notably, a mediation analysis suggests that shared meaning‐making exhibits a negative rather than a positive indirect association with radical belief dispositions. We discuss the complex interplay of how individual factors and platform architectures connect with news engagement utilizing a vulnerability‐affordance framework.

items.summary_ko: 유럽 8개국 청년 1,489명을 대상으로 게임 플랫폼, 메신저, 소셜미디어, 전통매체의 뉴스 이용과 급진적 신념 성향의 연관성을 비교한 설문 연구다. 급진적 신념 성향은 메신저에서 뚜렷하게, 게임 관련 온라인 환경에서 더 강하게 연관되었고 소셜미디어에서는 약하며 전통적 뉴스 이용에서는 나타나지 않았으며, 공유된 의미 형성의 간접효과는 오히려 부정적이었다.
items.title: Bad news for (young) gamers: Using gaming platforms as news sources is more intimately associated with radical belief dispositions than other online spaces

items.abstract: Abstract Previous research suggests that people who identify with global communities tend to show greater concern for global challenges. Using student samples from 44 countries across different cultural clusters ( N = 13,055), we examined whether (1) three forms of dispositional global social identification (GSI, with all humanity, citizens of the world, and people all over the world) are related to concern for global issues, (2) situational activation of these identifications increases such concern, (3) country‐level traditional and survival values are negatively associated with global concern, and (4) these values moderate the GSI–concern link. Both dispositional and situational GSIs positively predicted global concern. Situational activation showed inconsistent effects, whereas dispositional GSIs demonstrated moderate and consistent associations with global concern across the full sample and most countries. Overall, dispositional forms of GSI appeared more influential than situational ones. Contrary to expectations, traditional values (and survival values—marginally) were positively related to global concern and showed no evidence of moderating GSI–concern associations. Additional analyses showed the indices of GDP per capita, Human Development, Gini, and poverty as robust predictors of global concern. We discuss how these findings refine claims about the universality of global identification outcomes and highlight the importance of socio‐cultural context in shaping such concern.

items.summary_ko: 44개국 학생 표본(N=13,055)을 활용해 세 가지 성향적·상황적 글로벌 사회정체성이 세계적 쟁점에 대한 관심과 어떤 관련이 있는지, 국가 수준 가치와 사회경제적 지표가 이를 어떻게 설명·조절하는지 분석했다. 성향적 글로벌 사회정체성은 대부분의 국가에서 일관되게 세계적 관심을 예측했지만 상황적 활성화 효과는 일관되지 않았으며, 전통적 가치와 생존 가치는 예상과 달리 부적·조절 효과를 보이지 않았다.
items.title: From identity to caring: A 44‐country examination of the role of global social identifications in concern for global issues

items.abstract: ABSTRACT This commentary critically engages with Kettl's analysis of the crisis of public administration (PA) scholarship and its relationship with democratic decline. It argues that both phenomena should be understood within broader global developments rather than primarily as problems specific to the United States. While acknowledging the role of governance failures in facilitating autocratization, it questions the claim that autocratization results predominantly from the failures of PA scholarship and practice. Rather, it emphasizes that broader societal phenomena, such as the erosion of societal trust and the power‐consolidating objectives of authoritarian leaders play a key role. Drawing on Hungary's experience, the commentary illustrates how authoritarian governance may perpetuate administrative instability and institutional transformation long after the (perceived) failures of democratic governance have been addressed in the early phase of illiberal transformation. However, it also argues that poor governance and declining policy performance can eventually undermine authoritarian rule, as illustrated by Hungary's 2026 political transformation. The commentary thus highlights the complex and potentially self‐undermining relationship between authoritarianism and public governance.

György Hajnal: Corvinus University of Budapest Budapest Hungary
ELTE Centre for Social Sciences Budapest Hungary

items.summary_ko: 이 논평은 행정학 지식과 실천의 위기 및 민주주의 쇠퇴를 미국에 국한하지 않고 세계적 맥락에서 검토하며, 권위주의화가 주로 행정학의 실패에서 비롯된다는 주장에 의문을 제기한다. 헝가리 사례를 통해 사회적 신뢰 약화와 권위주의 지도자의 권력 집중이 중요한 요인이며, 권위주의적 통치가 행정 불안정을 지속시킬 수 있지만 저조한 거버넌스와 정책 성과가 궁극적으로 권위주의 통치를 약화시킬 수도 있음을 주장한다.
items.title: A Response to Don Kettl's Debate Article on the Future of Public Administration and Democracy

items.abstract: Electoral district borders regularly cross the borders of local governments. At the same time, legislatures allocate resources using transfers to local governments. Political parties may try to target these transfers in order to win elections, but can only do so imperfectly because of border mismatch. This border mismatch creates inequality: otherwise similar local governments receive different transfers depending on the district map. To show this, I incorporate border mismatch into a model of political competition and test the predictions using data on transfers from U.S. states to counties. The results demonstrate a novel link between redistricting and voter welfare. JEL Classification: D72, H77, K16
items.summary_ko: 선거구 경계와 지방정부 경계의 불일치가 주의 지방정부 이전금 배분과 유권자 후생에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 분석한다. 정치적 경쟁 모형에 경계 불일치를 통합하고 미국 주정부의 카운티 이전금 자료로 검증한 결과, 선거구 지도에 따라 유사한 지방정부가 서로 다른 이전금을 받는 불평등이 나타났다.
items.title: Crossing the District Line: Border Mismatch and Targeted Redistribution

items.abstract: Despite the increasing popularity of podcasts as a source of news for many Americans, little is known about their precise impact. We conduct a mobile field experiment that examines how consumption of trustworthy news via daily podcasts affects attitudes about politics and the media over a one-week period. Our treatment, deployed at the end of the first of two survey waves, asks subjects to subscribe to a specific high-quality daily news podcast, NPR’s _Up First_. In addition, treated subjects are asked to turn on mobile push notifications for the podcast. The intervention successfully increased participants’ consumption of news from the podcast, with minimal substitution from other programs. We find that podcast consumption significantly increased event knowledge (\(d = 0.29\)), but only for topics covered in that week’s episodes. Trust specifically in news from podcasts also increased (\(d = 0.09\)), but not in mainstream news more generally. Our results shed light on outcomes linked to the unique possibilities of this medium and, more broadly, on the malleability of attitudes toward the media.
items.summary_ko: 신뢰할 수 있는 뉴스 팟캐스트의 일일 청취가 일주일 동안 정치·미디어 태도와 신뢰에 미치는 영향을 모바일 현장실험으로 검토했다. NPR의 「Up First」 구독·푸시 알림 처치는 팟캐스트 청취와 해당 주제의 사건 지식을 늘렸고, 팟캐스트 뉴스에 대한 신뢰는 높였지만 주류 뉴스 전반에 대한 신뢰에는 유의한 영향을 주지 않았다.
items.title: Does Listening to Trustworthy News Affect Political Attitudes and Trust?

items.abstract: When do presidential candidates use populist communication, and does its prevalence vary across policy domains? We address these questions using an original dataset of 11,885 tweets from nine Brazilian presidential candidates during the 2022 elections. Drawing on the ideational approach, we operationalize populist discourse as the co-occurrence of people-centrism and anti-elitism, measured with fine-tuned BERT-based classifiers, and classify policy domains with the Comparative Agendas Project framework. Our findings reveal substantial heterogeneity across candidates, challenging expectations that populist communication uniformly intensifies during campaigns or systematically varies across policy domains according to ideology. Rather than increasing uniformly during the campaign, populist appeals escalate strategically for some candidates as elections approach, while remaining stable for others throughout the electoral year. We propose a typology distinguishing opportunistic from consistent populists. Across policy domains, government operations serve as a baseline facilitating populist framing. Left-wing candidates increase populist rhetoric in labor/employment, consistent with issue ownership expectations, but right-wing candidates reduce populist appeals in their traditionally owned domains of law and crime and civil rights, contrary to expectations. Overall, we show that populism is neither a universal campaign imperative nor a content-neutral communication style, but a flexible discursive frame shaped by candidate strategy, electoral context, and policy content.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 2022년 대선 후보 9명의 트윗 11,885건을 대상으로 BERT 기반 분류기와 비교의제프로젝트의 정책영역 분류를 활용해 포퓰리즘 커뮤니케이션이 언제, 어떤 정책영역에서 나타나는지 분석했다. 포퓰리즘 호소는 선거기간에 일률적으로 증가하지 않았으며 후보별로 전략적으로 증가하거나 안정적으로 유지되었고, 정책영역에 따라서도 차이를 보여 일관형과 기회주의형 포퓰리스트를 구분할 수 있었다.
items.title: When Populism? Consistent and Opportunistic Populist Communication in the 2022 Brazilian Presidential Elections

items.abstract: Mandated healthcare networks are introduced to achieve reform objectives through collaboration, yet imposed arrangements may not generate the social capital needed for collective action. We examine how governance mechanisms activate key sources of social capital (opportunity, ability, motivation) and shape its subsequent development. Using a longitudinal case study of a mandated hospital network governed by a Network Administrative Organization (NAO), we analyse 55 interviews along with documentary data. We find that while the NAO expanded opportunities for social capital development through network governance mechanisms, these were pseudo-opportunities that failed to enhance the ability and motivation of network members to collaborate. We contribute to theory by explaining how imposed governance can simultaneously appear to provide a key condition for social capital (interaction opportunities) and nevertheless inhibit successful collective action and generate disenchantment. The study highlights the need to distinguish between technical integration and meaningful collaboration in the implementation of governance mechanisms.
items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 의무화된 의료 네트워크에서 거버넌스 메커니즘이 사회적 자본의 기회·능력·동기를 어떻게 활성화하고 발전시키는지 종단적 사례연구로 분석했다. 네트워크 행정조직(NAO)은 상호작용 기회를 확대했지만 이를 의사소통 역량과 협력 동기로 전환하지 못해 형식적 기회에 그쳤고, 성공적 집합행동과 의미 있는 협력을 저해하며 환멸을 초래했다.
items.title: From reform to reality: governance mechanisms and social capital development in mandated healthcare networks

items.abstract: This research examines the conceptualization and measurement of interpretive leadership skill (ILS) in public service organizations. ILS is conceptualized as an individual leadership competency for meaning-making whose function is interactive: the leader’s capacity to read the working context, build shared understandings that promote coherent action for the organization, and revise those understandings as conditions change. This research reports three studies using two large-scale samples to validate the psychometric and predictive properties of ILS in the public service logic. Study 1 develops and validates a multidimensional measure of ILS and demonstrates its content validity. Study 2 establishes construct validity by situating ILS within a three-level model of leader development. Study 3 demonstrates criterion validity by showing ILS’s predictive property on organizational public service performance. Together, these studies validate ILS as the meaning-making competency of public service leaders and provide implications for leadership theory and practice across public and non-profit organizations.
items.summary_ko: 공공서비스 조직에서 의미 형성 역량으로서 해석적 리더십 기술(ILS)의 개념과 측정 타당성을 검토한다. 세 연구를 통해 다차원 척도의 내용 타당성, 리더 개발의 3수준 모형 내 구성 타당성, 조직의 공공서비스 성과에 대한 예측력을 확인했다.
items.title: Interpretive leadership skill as the meaning-making leadership competency in public service organizations: content, construct, and criterion validity

items.abstract: This study explores configurations of structural, process, and contextual conditions associated with high user-orientation in public service delivery networks. Drawing on Public Service Logic, we conceptualize user-orientation and connect it with interorganizational network research. We examine six conditions and apply fuzzy-set Qualitative Comparative Analysis to data from sixty networks. We identify five pathways. Across these pathways, collaboration intensity and organizational simplicity consistently emerge, underscoring the importance of process factors alongside structural conditions. Network size clarifies the distinct roles of centralization and density. One pathway combines high centralization and high density with high user-orientation, nuancing prevailing views about their simultaneous presence.

Antony Pemberton: Netherlands Institute for the Study of Crime and Law Enforcement

items.summary_ko: 공공서비스 전달 네트워크에서 높은 이용자 지향성과 관련된 구조적·과정적·맥락적 조건의 조합을 탐색하기 위해 60개 네트워크 자료에 퍼지집합 질적비교분석을 적용했다. 다섯 가지 경로를 확인했으며, 협력 강도와 조직적 단순성이 공통적으로 나타났고, 네트워크 규모에 따라 중앙집권화와 밀도의 역할이 달라졌으며 높은 중앙집권화와 밀도가 동시에 높은 경로도 발견되었다.
items.title: Explaining user-orientation in public service delivery networks: configurations of network structure, process, and context

items.abstract: Abstract Economic inequality shapes citizens' attitudes and democratic support, yet little is known about how perceived inequality influences political efficacy. This research examines the relationship between perceived economic inequality and political efficacy, testing institutional trust as a psychosocial mechanism underlying this link. Across two correlational and two experimental studies, we present converging evidence for this process. Study 1 ( N = 9985) revealed multilevel evidence of a negative association between perceived economic inequality and institutional trust, beyond the effect of objective inequality, using Latin American survey data. Study 2 ( N = 1536) replicated this finding with a Spanish quota sample, revealing an indirect effect of perceived inequality on political efficacy through institutional trust. Study 3 ( N = 168) involved the experimental manipulation of inequality. Participants in the high‐inequality condition reported lower institutional trust and political efficacy, and the indirect effect was replicated. Study 4 ( N = 638) employed a concurrent double‐randomization design to manipulate perceived inequality and institutional trust. In contexts of high institutional trust, political efficacy differed between highly and less unequal conditions, with lower political efficacy observed in the high‐inequality condition. Similar patterns emerged for collective action. Overall, perceived inequality undermines institutional trust, reducing political efficacy and democratic engagement.

Guillermo B. Willis: Department of Social Psychology University of Granada Granada Spain
Juan Diego García‐Castro: Instituto de Investigaciones Psicológicas University of Costa Rica San José Costa Rica
Sede de Occidente University of Costa Rica San Ramón Costa Rica
Mar Montoya‐Lozano: Department of Social Psychology University of Granada Granada Spain
Instituto de Investigaciones Psicológicas University of Costa Rica San José Costa Rica
Rosa Rodríguez‐Bailón: Department of Social Psychology University of Granada Granada Spain

items.summary_ko: 지각된 경제적 불평등이 정치적 효능감에 미치는 영향을 제도 신뢰가 매개하는지, 두 상관연구와 두 실험연구로 검증했다. 지각된 불평등은 제도 신뢰를 낮추고, 이를 통해 정치적 효능감과 민주적 참여를 약화시키는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: How perceived economic inequality shapes political efficacy: The mediating role of institutional trust

items.abstract: Community stakeholders play a pivotal role in shaping cities’ decisions about whether to measure local GHG emissions. Using survey data collected at two points in time, this study examines how varying levels of support from different types of stakeholder groups influence cities’ decisions to manage their GHG inventories. Notably, we find higher levels of performance measurement activity in cities where support from the public and environmental groups for climate initiatives is perceived as strong, as well as in cities that perceive opposition from business and neighborhood associations. Drawing on public management theories, we offer insights into stakeholder influence in local GHG emission measurement efforts and identify factors driving the advancement of these practices.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 다양한 지역사회 이해관계자 집단의 지지가 지방정부의 지역 온실가스 배출량을 측정·관리하는 결정에 어떤 영향을 미치는지, 두 시점의 설문자료를 통해 분석한다. 시민과 환경단체의 기후정책 지지가 강하다고 인식되거나 기업 및 지역주민단체의 반대가 크다고 인식되는 도시에서 성과 측정 활동이 더 활발했다.
items.title: How Do Community Stakeholder Groups Shape Local GHG Inventories? Evidence from U.S. Local Governments

items.abstract: Women consume less media than men and are more likely to avoid political news. This gender gap in media consumption is frequently attributed to women’s time constraints resulting from the combination of professional and caregiving responsibilities. One recent study documented the “child penalty” for women, but the dynamics linking childcare to reduced news consumption remain unexplored. We propose four potential dynamics: a threshold effect, a short-term effect, an extra burden, and a “building-up” effect. Fixed effects analysis of Dutch Longitudinal Internet Study for the Social Sciences panel data shows an immediate child penalty affecting women’s political media use, with additional cumulative effects as infants grow. This “building-up effect” appears for men only when children move toward their teens. Additionally, results suggest a shift in news consumption habits toward online sources, more evident for men. Finally, we find no support for the extra burden hypothesis, as the child penalty is independent of labor market participation.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 종단 패널 자료를 고정효과 분석해, 자녀 양육이 여성의 정치 뉴스 소비를 즉각적으로 감소시키고 영아의 성장과 함께 그 감소가 누적되는지 검토했다. 분석 결과 여성에게 즉각적이고 누적적인 ‘자녀 벌점’이 나타났으며, 남성에게는 자녀가 청소년기에 가까워질 때 누적 효과가 나타났고, 노동시장 참여와 무관했으며 온라인 뉴스로의 전환은 남성에게 더 뚜렷했다.
items.title: Making Time to Be Informed: The Child Penalty in Political News Consumption

items.abstract: Does exposure to crime mobilize or demobilize political participation? We report findings from a preregistered design, leveraging data from an original survey of 21 major U.S. cities and five waves of the Cooperative Election Study. We assess the relationships between direct victimization, local (ZCTA-level) crime rates, and perceived neighborhood safety and two outcomes: turnout (including validated turnout) and non-electoral participation. We find that direct victimization is significantly associated with more non-electoral engagement but lower turnout. The negative estimated effects of victimization on turnout exceed the magnitude of positive effects associated with common get-out-the-vote efforts. We find only limited evidence that crime rates are associated with participation. Perceived neighborhood safety is associated with higher rates of non-electoral, but not electoral, participation. Our findings offer new, comprehensive evidence on the relationship between crime exposure and political participation and illustrate the importance of distinguishing between types of exposure and forms of participation.
items.summary_ko: 범죄 노출이 정치참여를 동원하는지 약화하는지를 검토하기 위해, 21개 미국 주요 도시의 원자료 설문과 협력선거연구 5개 파를 활용해 직접 피해, 지역 범죄율, 주관적 동네 안전감과 투표·비선거 참여의 관계를 분석했다. 직접 피해는 비선거 참여 증가 및 투표율 감소와 유의하게 연관되었고, 범죄율과 참여의 연관성은 제한적이었으며, 주관적 안전감은 비선거 참여와만 정적으로 연관되었다.
items.title: Crime and Participation

items.title: Using Multilingual Language Technology to Classify Open-Ended Survey Responses: Conceptions of Democracy in a Cross-Cultural Survey Setting – CORRIGENDUM

items.abstract: A large body of empirical literature shows that politicians’ time horizons influence the level of corruption they engage in. However, some studies suggest that corruption follows a U-shaped pattern across a politician’s tenure, decreasing in the middle and rising again toward the end, while others find an inverse U-shape. We argue that these conflicting findings can be explained by distinguishing between two types of corruption based on whether the corrupt act is one-sided _(extraction)_ or mutually beneficial _(collusion)_. To test this hypothesis, we analyze provincial governors in Vietnam, leveraging 15 years of nationally representative firm-level data and biographical information on local leaders. Our findings provide strong support for a relationship between political tenure and extractive corruption, which follows a clear inverse U-shaped pattern. In contrast, we find little evidence of a systematic pattern in collusive corruption. This contrast underscores that while timing is a crucial determinant of corruption, its impact varies systematically with the nature of the corrupt act.
items.summary_ko: 정치인의 재임 기간과 부패의 관계가 부패 행위의 일방적 수탈과 상호이익적 공모에 따라 어떻게 달라지는지 검토하기 위해, 베트남 지방 지도자의 전기 자료와 15년간의 전국 대표 기업 수준 자료를 분석했다. 수탈형 부패는 재임 중반에 감소하고 말기에 다시 증가하는 역U자형을 보였지만, 공모형 부패에서는 체계적인 재임 기간 패턴이 거의 나타나지 않았다.
items.title: Decoding Corruption Cycles: Extractive versus Collusive Corruption

items.abstract: Abstract In recent years, observers have noted an apparent increase in racially progressive attitudes among White Democrats. Among journalists, this “great awokening” of White Democrats is practically taken as a political fact. However, what this consensus about the racial liberalism of White Democrats often overlooks is that while White Democrats have in many ways moved in line with the Democratic Party’s position on race and racial inequality, their White identity makes them vulnerable to racial identity threats. In this study, I test this potential for racial identity-driven backlash among White Democrats in the context of racial justice protest movements. To do this, I conduct a survey experiment in which respondents are exposed to an image from a racial justice protest, and I vary the messaging on the signs in the image as well as the race of the protesters. I find that when protesters use messaging that is critical of Whites and Whiteness, White Democrats’ support for the movement and the protesters declines. Additionally, such messaging causes respondents to distance themselves from the views of the protesters and raises concerns about violence erupting at the protests. These results underscore how racial identity threats can erode White Democrats’ support for political messages and political movements that their increasingly liberal racial attitudes should make them amenable to.
items.summary_ko: 백인 민주당원의 인종적 정체성 위협이 인종정의 시위에 대한 지지를 약화시키는지 설문 실험으로 검증했다. 백인과 백인성에 비판적인 메시지에 노출되면 이들의 운동 지지와 시위대 견해에 대한 동조가 감소하고, 시위 중 폭력 발생 우려가 높아졌다.
items.title: Democratic but Still White: The Impact of Racial Identity Threats on White Democrats’ Support for Racial Justice Protests

items.abstract: Abstract Most of the public supports welfare policies in the abstract, but many hold deep misgivings about the deservingness of welfare recipients, driving down support for specific policies. Welfare policies are often designed to mitigate these concerns by restricting access to benefits, but it is unclear to what effect. According to an influential strain of research drawing on social construction theory, these restrictions may backfire, instead increasing concerns about a free-riding public. In contrast -- drawing on psychological research on the deservingness heuristic -- I argue that policy features, such as work requirements, signal effort on behalf of recipients and thus deservingness. Using an experiment, I find that several policy features increase perceptions of deservingness and, in turn, increase policy support and generosity. However, some policy features are also perceived as overly burdensome, reducing the effects on policy support. Treatment effects on perceptions of beneficiary deservingness are largest among ambivalent respondents, but largely generalize across partisanship, ideology, and racial resentment. Overall, these findings help clarify the implications of the deservingness heuristic while challenging predictions from social construction theory and informing ongoing debates over public opinion and policy feedback.
items.summary_ko: 복지정책의 어떤 설계 특성이 수혜자에 대한 정당성 인식과 복지 지지를 높이는지 설문 실험으로 분석한 결과, 근로 요건 등 일부 특성은 수혜자의 노력과 정당성을 신호해 정책 지지와 관대성을 높였지만, 과도한 부담으로 인식된 특성은 그 효과를 약화시켰다. 이러한 정당성 효과는 양가적 응답자에서 가장 컸으나 정당 지지, 이념, 인종적 resentment 전반에 대체로 일반화되었다.
items.title: How Policy Design Affects Perceptions of Beneficiaries and Support for Welfare

items.abstract: Does racial difference contribute to anti-immigrant bias? A large literature has analyzed the impact of religious difference on negative assessments of immigrants in European countries, but less is known about the effects of racial difference. We explore mechanisms of racial bias as components of xenophobic attitudes in Greece – one of the most anti-immigrant countries in Europe. We present results from several experiments designed to identify effects of racial difference proxied by skin color. We find evidence of a complex pattern of _anti-Blackness_ that is a small part of xenophobic attitudes toward immigrant groups that are otherwise more racially proximate to the Greek population. _Anti-Blackness_ in Greece reflects a “taste” for discrimination and is not rooted in more negative stereotypes of darker immigrants.
items.summary_ko: 그리스에서 피부색으로 대리된 인종적 차이가 이민자에 대한 반이민 편견에 기여하는지 여러 실험으로 분석했다. 흑인에 대한 부정적 태도는 이민자 집단에 대한 외국인혐오의 일부를 구성하며, 더 어두운 피부의 이민자에 대한 부정적 고정관념보다는 차별 선호를 반영하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: O Xenos: Racial Difference, Colorism, and Attitudes Toward Immigrants in Greece

items.abstract: Abstract The American public largely favors “democracy,” yet many citizens tolerate undemocratic actions and candidates.
