This raises doubts about the relevance of abstract democracy support to actual democratic commitment. In contrast, we argue that abstract democracy support is a normatively significant dimension of attitude variation among Americans. Using nineteen surveys fielded between 1995 and 2024, we show that a sizable segment of the public expresses only tepid support for democracy, and that a nontrivial minority expresses opposition. Moreover, commonly used abstract democracy support items converge on a single latent construct which displays high rank-order stability, but also meaningful within-person variation, over a two-year period. Abstract democracy support negatively predicts openness to a wide range of electoral and liberal democratic violations and is associated with greater likelihood of electorally punishing anti-democratic candidates. In panel data, positive within-person deviations in abstract democracy support precede negative within-person deviations in openness to authoritarian governance, suggesting that individual-level shifts in abstract support predict later change in substantive democracy attitudes. Overall our findings suggest that the value of ‘democracy’ is contested among Americans, with potential implications for democratic erosion. We recommend that efforts to understand the American public’s role in democratic backsliding and restoration treat abstract support as a distinct attitude construct, measure it with multi-item scales, and explore whether or not it possesses causal significance.
items.summary_ko: 미국인의 추상적 민주주의 지지가 실제 민주주의 헌신과 어떤 관련이 있는지 검토하기 위해 1995~2024년 19개 설문과 패널 자료를 분석했다. 추상적 민주주의 지지는 단일 잠재구성개념으로 수렴하며, 민주주의에 대한 위반 수용 및 반민주적 후보 지지를 낮추고 이후 권위주의적 거버넌스 수용의 감소를 예측하는 등 실질적 민주주의 태도와 관련되는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Questionnaire Democrats? Reconsidering the Relevance of Abstract Democracy Support in the American Public

items.abstract: Abstract Politicians use populist rhetoric – arguments that portray politics as an enduring conflict between “the good people” and “the evil elites” – to generate support for attacks on constitutional safeguards, the media, and minorities. Yet, little is known about how to counteract such rhetoric. We utilize a pre-registered survey experiment in the UK (n $$\cong$$ 4000) to investigate the effects of counter-arguments put forward by fellow citizens. We hypothesize pluralist and democratic elitist counter-arguments to be promising antidotes to populist rhetoric and test to what extent such arguments can strengthen liberal democratic attitudes and weaken populist majoritarian ones. We find that populism can be challenged successfully but not with all types of counter-arguments. Pluralist appeals can decrease support for populist majoritarian democracy, while elitist counter-arguments have no effect on democratic attitudes. Additional analyses suggest that counter-arguments might also affect how voters evaluate candidates. These results contribute by demonstrating the potentials of counter-arguments in strengthening the resilience of liberal democracies vis-à-vis populist challenges.
items.summary_ko: 영국의 사전등록 설문실험(n≈4,000)을 통해 시민이 제시하는 다원주의적·민주적 엘리트주의적 반론이 포퓰리즘 수사에 어떻게 대응하는지 검토했다. 다원주의적 호소는 포퓰리즘적 다수결 민주주의 지지를 낮췄지만, 엘리트주의적 반론은 민주적 태도에 유의한 영향을 미치지 않았다.
items.title: What Works Against Populist Rhetoric? The Effects of Counter-Arguments on Democratic Attitudes

items.abstract: We evaluated disparities in exposure to partisan content among new, nonpartisan TikTok users. We performed a sock puppet audit using 118 automated users in Germany ahead of three regional elections in 2024 and the federal election in 2025 (N = 266.161 videos). The design allowed us to account for past individual user behavior, user networks, location, and time. Overall, general political content constitutes 5%–7% of nonpolitical user feeds in our sample. When nonpartisan users encounter unsolicited political content, it is more likely to feature videos mentioning and supporting the far-right populist Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) party relative to all other parties. Further descriptive analysis shows that content by the AfD is associated with a higher volume of accounts and a higher number of viral videos.
items.summary_ko: 독일의 비당파 신규 TikTok 이용자들이 정파적 정치 콘텐츠에 어떻게 노출되는지 알아보기 위해, 2024년 지방선거와 2025년 연방선거를 앞두고 118개 자동화 계정을 활용한 소크퍼펫 감사로 266,161개 영상을 분석했다. 비정치적 이용자 피드의 5~7%가 일반 정치 콘텐츠였으며, 비자발적으로 접한 정치 콘텐츠는 다른 정당보다 극우 포퓰리스트 AfD를 언급·지지하는 경우가 많았고, AfD 콘텐츠는 더 많은 계정 수와 바이럴 영상 수와 연관됐다.
items.title: Does the TikTok Feed Lean Right? Exposure to Political Content Among Non-Partisan Users in Germany

items.abstract: Whether women in office govern differently from men is well documented; whether they govern differently for women is not. The latter is the crux of active representation theory, which expects representatives to act for those they mirror: does electing women change what governments do for women? We investigate the relationship between electing female mayors and councilors and the existence of Pro-Women Institutions across all 5,565 cities of Brazil during four election cycles (2008, 2012, 2016 and 2020). Our results partially support the active representation relationship. While female mayors’ presence increases the likelihood of pro-women institutions, local councilors either do not or are negatively linked to them. Robustness checks through a regression discontinuity design corroborate these findings, and heterogeneous treatment effects on race paint a wider picture about intersectionality. Our findings highlight how female elected representatives might achieve substantial change for their female constituents in local government.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 5,565개 도시의 2008·2012·2016·2020년 선거 자료를 분석해 여성 시장·시의원 당선과 여성친화적 제도의 관계를 검토하고, 회귀불연속설계로 결과를 점검했다. 여성 시장의 존재는 여성친화적 제도의 가능성을 높였지만, 여성 시의원은 유의한 관련이 없거나 부정적으로 관련되었으며, 인종별 이질적 효과는 교차성을 시사했다.
items.title: When women lead: local political representation and pro-women institutions

items.abstract: As international conflicts escalate, states are increasingly turning to conscription and broader public participation in national defense. This article examines how acute external threats influence public attitudes toward military service. Leveraging original survey data from Iran, fielded before and after the unprecedented April 13, 2024 missile exchange with Israel, I use matching techniques to compare responses across the two periods. Individuals surveyed after the attack were significantly more likely to support mandatory male conscription and to support women’s military service. Importantly, support rose even though conscription is widely unpopular in peacetime and despite Iran’s gender hierarchies. These findings demonstrate that external threats can legitimize coercion in contexts of regime distrust and reconfigure gender boundaries around military participation. The study contributes to research on public perceptions of war, coercion, and militarization by highlighting how geopolitical shocks recalibrate the boundaries of both state authority and gendered citizenship.
items.summary_ko: 국제적 외부 위협이 권위주의 체제에서 군복무에 대한 대중의 태도, 특히 남성 의무징병과 여성의 군복무 지지를 어떻게 변화시키는지 분석했다. 이란에서 이스라엘과의 2024년 4월 13일 미사일 교환 전후에 실시한 원자료 설문을 매칭해 비교한 결과, 공격 이후 두 형태의 군복무 지지가 유의하게 증가했다.
items.title: External Threats and Support for Military Service under Authoritarian Rule

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Preregistration is increasingly used in policy research, but its value depends on whether preregistered commitments can be clearly linked to reported analyses. Policy studies often involve multiple outcomes, evolving administrative data, consequential design and analytic choices, and adaptive implementation, making it difficult to distinguish prespecified tests from subsequent adjustments. This research note proposes a modular, policy‐oriented companion framework for using existing preregistration infrastructure. The framework combines a shared core that defines the estimand, outcomes, and identification strategy with design‐specific modules for field experiments, administrative‐data quasi‐experiments, and behavioral policy trials. Together, the components serve two purposes: claim traceability, by linking reported results to the original plan, and governed adaptation, by providing a transparent record of changes made during the study. The aim is not to prevent adaptation, but to show which analyses were prespecified, which were revised through documented amendments, and which were developed later. This approach aims to improve the interpretability and transparency of policy research while remaining feasible in applied policy settings.

Tianhao Zhao: Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy National University of Singapore Singapore Singapore
Yiyun Xia: Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy National University of Singapore Singapore Singapore
Yuhao Ba: Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy National University of Singapore Singapore Singapore

items.summary_ko: 이 연구노트는 정책평가에서 사전등록된 약속과 실제 보고된 분석을 명확히 연결하려면 어떻게 해야 하는지를 묻고, 공통 핵심 요소와 연구설계별 모듈을 결합한 정책 지향적 사전등록 체계를 제안한다. 이 체계는 사전 명시된 분석, 문서화된 수정, 사후 개발된 분석을 구분해 결과의 추적 가능성과 적응 과정의 투명성을 높이는 것을 목표로 한다.
items.title: Making Policy Evidence Traceable: A Modular Preregistration Framework for Policy Evaluation

items.abstract: Abstract Survey researchers frequently employ measures of political engagement, yet social desirability pressures can lead to overreporting. Building upon existing literature, we adopt an iterative approach to determine how such overreporting can be reduced. Four preregistered survey experiments were conducted (total N=7,122). We first confirm that social desirability considerations can underlie some types of self-reported political engagement. Second, having tested a variety of interventions that were designed to reduce overreporting, we find that our most effective treatment ( Dampen Politics) was one that aimed to decrease the salience of politics. This treatment significantly reduced (1) the degree to which respondents perceived the survey as political, and (2) some types of self-reported political engagement, particularly political interest and voting. We tested alternative implementations of the Dampen Politics treatment, each time assessing its robustness and validity. Our findings suggest a simple adjustment in survey wording and organization can meaningfully decrease overreporting of political engagement.
items.summary_ko: 정치 참여 자기보고에서 사회적 바람직성에 따른 과대보고를 줄일 수 있는 방법을 탐색하기 위해, 총 7,122명을 대상으로 사전등록된 네 차례의 설문 실험을 실시했다. 정치의 현저성을 낮추는 ‘Dampen Politics’ 처치가 설문을 정치적으로 인식하는 정도와 일부 정치 참여 자기보고, 특히 정치적 관심과 투표 보고를 유의하게 감소시켜 과대보고를 줄이는 데 가장 효과적이었다.
items.title: Un-Priming Politics: A Method to Reduce Overreporting of Political Engagement

items.abstract: Abstract To examine the conceptualization and the measurement of global consciousness (GC) in cross‐national contexts, we conducted a secondary analysis on survey data collected from 16,241 individuals across 35 societies. Results demonstrate that GC is best conceptualized as a multidimensional construct by a bifactor ESEM model, in which GC captures an overarching and direct source of common variance across all manifest indicators, whereas domain‐specific residual variance is retained by three existing measures: Identification with All Humanity (IWAH), Cosmopolitan Orientation (COS), and a shortened version of Global Orientations (GOS). Metric invariance was successfully achieved across 30 out of 35 societies. At the individual level, GC was negatively associated with political conservatism, an effect that was amplified in societies with higher HDI, more robust rule of law, and a salient culture of individualism. In an exploratory societal‐level analysis, aggregated GC functioned as an informative ecological indicator, appearing more prominent in the Global South societies across the sample. This preliminary pattern is probably attributable to the open system where GC is measured, reflecting the hopes and aspirations of people in the making.

Jacky C. K. Ng: Department of Applied Social Sciences Hong Kong Polytechnic University Kowloon Hong Kong
Robert Jiqi Zhang: School of Psychology Nanjing Normal University Nanjing China
Sylvia Xiaohua Chen: Department of Applied Social Sciences Hong Kong Polytechnic University Kowloon Hong Kong

items.summary_ko: 35개 사회 16,241명의 설문자료를 대상으로 글로벌 의식(GC)의 개념과 측정구조를 검토한 결과, GC는 세 기존 척도의 공통분산을 포괄하는 다차원적 bifactor ESEM 구성개념으로 가장 잘 설명되었다. GC는 개인 수준에서 정치적 보수주의와 부(-)의 관계를 보였고, 사회 수준에서는 표본의 글로벌 사우스 사회에서 더 두드러지는 예비적 양상이 나타났다.
items.title: Conceptualizing and measuring global consciousness

items.abstract: This study examines how organizational goals, leadership styles, and organizational culture influence employee outcomes in the Korean public sector. Using Structural Equation Modelling, data from 6,170 public servants were analysed. Organizational goals positively influenced commitment and performance efforts. Transactional leadership positively affected organizational culture and commitment but negatively affected performance efforts, whereas visionary leadership showed positive effects across all three outcomes. Organizational culture enhanced commitment and performance efforts, while organizational commitment positively influenced performance efforts and perceived organizational performance. Performance efforts also enhanced perceived organizational performance. These findings highlight how goals, leadership, and collaborative culture jointly shape employee and organizational outcomes.

Hyeon Jo: Headquarters, HJ Institute of Technology and Management

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 한국 공공부문에서 조직 목표, 리더십 유형, 조직문화가 구성원의 몰입·성과 노력과 조직성과 인식에 미치는 영향을 구조방정식모형으로 분석했다. 조직 목표와 비전적 리더십, 협력적 조직문화는 대체로 긍정적 결과와 관련되었지만, 거래적 리더십은 성과 노력에 부정적 영향을 보였으며, 몰입과 성과 노력은 조직성과 인식을 높였다.
items.title: Impact of organizational goals, leadership styles, and organizational culture on employee outcomes in the Korean public sector

items.abstract: This study examines the contracting behavior of U.S. transit agencies during the COVID-19 pandemic to assess two competing predictions: (1) New Public Management expects increased contracting to achieve cost savings and shift risk, and (2) institutional inertia predicts stability due to structural barriers. Our findings demonstrate overwhelming support for institutional inertia. Despite confirming the pandemic was a major disruption, contracting behavior and perceptions remained stable. The mechanism for this inertia is that contracting is not associated with improved operational outcomes, suggesting the absence of economic incentives for change. The stability observed reflects externally insulated resilience of core public management structures.

Juita-Elena (Wie) Yusuf: Old Dominion University, Norfolk, VA, USA
Olga V. Smirnova: East Carolina University, Greenville, NC, USA
Suzanne M. Leland: University of North Carolina at Charlotte, Charlotte, NC, USA

items.summary_ko: 코로나19 팬데믹으로 시장이 disrupted된 상황에서 미국 대중교통기관의 계약 행태가 신공공관리의 계약 확대 예측과 제도적 관성의 안정성 예측 중 어느 쪽을 따르는지 분석했다. 계약 행태와 인식은 대체로 안정적이었으며, 계약이 운영성과 개선과 연계되지 않아 변화의 경제적 유인이 없었다는 점에서 제도적 관성을 지지한다.
items.title: Risk and Resilience: Managing Public Transit Contracting During a Disrupted Market

items.abstract: Abstract How does school history education emphasizing past grievances with other countries impact attitudes toward conflict and cooperation with the countries today? We examine this question using original data from 34 classrooms across 17 high schools in Seoul, South Korea. We first test whether exposure to anti‐Japanese content in school history education negatively impacts students' attitudes toward cooperation with Japan. We then compare how the attitudes of students educated with a more pro‐US textbook differ from those using a more anti‐US one. We find that school history education influenced what historical events students believed as “facts” and their evaluation of historical events. However, the effect on students' historical memories did not by itself automatically translate into corresponding attitudes toward present‐day Japan or the United States. Our findings offer various implications for studies on international rivalries and historical memories, as well as for debates on the political effects of school education.

Jeongmin Park: Postdoctoral Prize Fellow, Department of Politics Oxford University Nuffield College Oxford UK
Soyoung Lee: Assistant Professor, Department of Political Science Yale University New Haven Connecticut USA

items.summary_ko: 학교 역사교육에서 과거의 대외적 갈등을 강조하는 내용이 현재 해당 국가들과의 갈등 및 협력에 대한 태도에 미치는 영향을 서울의 17개 고등학교 34개 교실 자료로 분석했다. 교육은 학생들이 역사적 사건을 사실로 인식하고 평가하는 방식에는 영향을 주었지만, 그러한 역사적 기억의 변화가 오늘날 일본이나 미국에 대한 태도로 자동적으로 이어지지는 않았다.
items.title: Teaching the past, informing the present? School history education and attitudes toward foreign countries

items.abstract: This article argues that addressing the structural injustices of climate change requires rethinking collective action. Disruptive and prefigurative politics are often treated as separate collective action repertoires, but I argue that a just energy transition requires that they work in tandem. To capture this interaction, I propose the idea of “counter-structural” collective action, in which disruptive protest creates windows of opportunity that prefigurative alternatives can then fill. Through analysis of two UK climate movements, Transition Towns (TTs) and Camps for Climate Action (CCA), I show how activists reconfigure structural elements to build new, carbon-free social and political forms. The theory of counter-structural action provides a framework for assessing the empirical cases. The cases, in turn, illustrate a broader conception of collective action that better reflects the social theory grounding structural injustice. Together, the theory and cases support the dual aims of climate justice: challenging fossil-fuel path dependence and advancing egalitarianism.
items.summary_ko: 기후변화의 구조적 부정의에 대응하려면 파괴적 저항과 대안적 실천을 결합하는 집합행동이 어떻게 가능한지 묻고, 영국의 Transition Towns와 Camps for Climate Action을 분석한다. 파괴적 시위가 기회의 창을 만들고 대안적 실천이 이를 채우는 ‘반구조적’ 집합행동이 화석연료 경로의존성에 도전하면서 평등주의를 진전시킬 수 있음을 보인다.
items.title: The Idea of a Counter-Structure: Rethinking Collective Action against Climate Injustice

items.abstract: This article employs normative democratic theory to examine a counterintuitive suggestion raised repeatedly by empirical scholars of clientelism: namely, that practices of particularistic exchange might sometimes serve democratic ends. Certainly, most particularistic practices are widely agreed to undermine democracy, on both intrinsic and instrumental grounds. Yet some observers resist blanket condemnation—and in particular, many highlight the redeeming democratic virtues of certain practices that seem to facilitate collective organization among disempowered groups. Drawing on “realist” approaches to democratic theory, we vindicate this basic insight while clarifying its scope conditions. Countervailing power is a crucial democratic priority, and programmatic methods of promoting it sometimes face serious obstacles: as when clientelist practices are deeply entrenched, or incumbents capture the tools of programmatic competition. Under such conditions, we conclude, democracy-seeking leaders may justifiably employ particularistic practices to promote countervailing power—but only if they respect five constraints tethering them strictly to that goal.
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 특정주의적 교환인 클라이언텔리즘이 언제 민주적 목적에 기여할 수 있는지를 규범적 민주주의 이론, 특히 현실주의적 접근으로 검토한다. 클라이언텔리즘이 뿌리 깊거나 현직자가 프로그램 경쟁 수단을 장악한 상황에서는 민주주의를 추구하는 지도자가 대항권력을 강화하기 위해 이를 사용할 수 있지만, 그 목적에 엄격히 종속되는 다섯 가지 제약을 준수해야 한다고 주장한다.
items.title: When Can Clientelism Serve Democratic Ends? A Democratic Theory of Distributive Politics

items.abstract: ABSTRACT With commonly stabler and more flexible working environment, is public sector a better place for moms to work? Theorizing child penalties from sector difference perspective, we argue that childbirth may cause less gender gaps in unemployment and earnings but greater gender disparities in working time commitments in the public sector since job stability and family‐friendliness may form gender norms that depreciate women's work in the public sector. We test our hypotheses by employing event study designs using data from China Family Panel Studies (2010–2022). We found that women public employees experienced smaller child penalties in unemployment and earnings while greater child penalties in working hours than private counterparts, which can be explained by greater family responsibilities and spousal depreciation of women's jobs after childbirth. This paper advances theories of gender equity in public administration by proposing distinct child penalties in the public sector that challenges conventional beliefs.

Fangda Ding: Department of Politics and Public Administration The University of Hong Kong Hong Kong SAR China
Yifan Chen: School of International and Public Affairs The China Institute for Urban Governance The Shanghai Research Center for Innovation and Policy Evaluation Shanghai Jiao Tong University Shanghai China

items.summary_ko: 중국 가족패널조사(2010~2022) 자료에 사건연구 설계를 적용해 공공·민간 부문 여성의 출산 후 고용·소득·근로시간 격차를 비교한 결과, 공공부문 여성은 민간부문보다 실업과 소득의 자녀 불이익은 작았지만 근로시간의 불이익은 컸으며, 이는 출산 후 가족책임 증가와 배우자의 여성 일자리 평가절하로 설명되었다.
items.title: Is Public Sector a Better Place for Moms to Work? Exploring Sector Difference in Child Penalties on Women

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Public administration is at the center of the global democratic crisis. Meeting this challenge requires more than managerial and analytic competence—it requires a public philosophy grounded in the first principles of democratic ethos. We offer such a philosophy, drawing on four seminal thinkers whose concepts reflect the conditions public administrators face in times of democratic crisis. Judith Shklar's liberalism of fear establishes a negative obligation to refuse cruelty and resist its institutionalization. Alasdair MacIntyre's internal goods of practice create a positive obligation to cultivate virtue and protect the integrity of administrative practice. Isaiah Berlin's agony of choice obligates administrators to acknowledge irreducible value conflicts and their consequential impact on democratic life. Hannah Arendt's enlarged mentality provides a framework for thinking across perspectives so that judgment under conflict becomes democratically defensible. Together, these concepts form a public philosophy for public administration with practical significance for administrative judgment, organizational culture, and institutional courage.

Curtis Ventriss: University of Vermont Burlington Vermont USA
Tina Nabatchi: Syracuse University Syracuse New York USA

items.summary_ko: 민주주의 위기에 처한 행정이 요구하는 공공철학은 무엇이며, 이를 행정적 판단과 조직·제도 실천에 어떻게 적용할 수 있는지를 네 사상가의 개념을 통해 논의한다. 공포의 자유주의, 실천의 내재적 선, 선택의 고통, 확장된 정신을 결합해 잔혹함의 거부, 행정 실천의 덕성과 완전성 보호, 가치 충돌의 인정, 관점 간 사고를 행정가의 의무와 제도적 용기로 제시한다.
items.title: A Public Philosophy for Public Administration in Times of Democratic Crisis

items.abstract: ABSTRACT The accountability context for how public administrators operate has shifted markedly and has become much more volatile. This shift has placed new and some conflicting demands on public administrators to demonstrate their accountability to various competing governmental actors and has complicated policy and program implementation. The changed context, its causes, and the resultant challenges are analyzed and discussed. Questions are presented for public administration research to help public administrators deal with the challenges.

Charles Wise: School of Government and Public Policy University of Arizona Tucson Arizona USA

items.summary_ko: 공공행정가가 책임성을 입증해야 하는 정부 행위자들이 다양해지고 상호 경쟁하는 가운데 책임성의 맥락이 크게 변동하면서, 정책·프로그램 집행이 복잡해진 현상과 그 원인 및 도전 과제를 분석·논의한다. 이러한 도전에 대응하기 위해 공공행정 연구가 다뤄야 할 질문들을 제시한다.
items.title: Reply to Kettl: Public Administration and the Shifting Competing Forces of Accountability

items.abstract: How do street-level bureaucrats cope with acute, life-threatening experiences at work, and what are the consequences of such exposure? Based on 30 in-depth interviews with Israeli police officers who operated during the October 7 attack on Israel, we identify two coping mechanisms that enabled them to function under threat: auto-pilot mode, meaning relying on instinct and training, and detachment, meaning suppressing their emotions to complete their task. After the attack, officers reported less trust in state institutions, their organization, and the public. To cope, they relied mainly on peer support from colleagues who had undergone similar experiences. These experiences altered their professional behaviour, leading to cautiousness with citizens. The study contributes to public management by showing how exposure to acute, life-threatening experiences shapes street-level bureaucrats’ coping mechanisms and how these mechanisms may support organizational resilience during and after a crisis. Content warning: This article contains graphic descriptions of a warzone.
items.summary_ko: 이스라엘 10월 7일 공격 당시 활동한 경찰관 30명을 심층 인터뷰해, 거리수준 관료가 생명 위협 경험에 어떻게 대처하고 그 결과가 무엇인지 분석했다. 경찰관들은 본능과 훈련에 의존하는 ‘자동조종’과 감정 억제를 통해 위협 속에서 임무를 수행했으며, 이후 국가기관·조직·시민에 대한 신뢰가 낮아지고 동료 지원에 의존하면서 시민을 더 조심스럽게 대하는 행동 변화를 보였다.
items.title: Coping with life-threatening experiences at the street-level: the case of police officers in the October 7 attack in Israel

items.abstract: Do parties matter in the gender differences in candidate resiliency after electoral defeat? We argue that they do. Party can shape whether a loss sidelines a woman or positions her for another run. Left‐leaning parties—where gender inclusion is embedded in programmatic commitments—might also be more likely than their conservative counterparts to reinvest in defeated female candidates, increasing their likelihood of rerunning after loss. We present a cross‐national analysis on this question by applying a consistent within‐party regression‐discontinuity design to open‐list municipal elections in Chile and Brazil. The pattern is clear: a loss discourages women in right‐leaning parties significantly more than it discourages men, while left‐leaning parties exhibit a smaller gender gap. These results underscore the role of parties, rather than individual motivation or electoral rules alone, as a key gatekeeper in the female candidacy pipeline.
items.summary_ko: 정당 이념이 선거 패배 이후 여성 후보의 재출마 지속성에서 나타나는 성별 격차에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 분석했다. 칠레와 브라질의 개방형 명부 지방선거에 정당 내 회귀불연속 설계를 적용한 결과, 우파 정당에서는 패배가 남성보다 여성 후보의 재출마를 더 크게 억제했지만 좌파 정당에서는 그 격차가 더 작았다.
items.title: Left Behind or Left In? Party Ideology and the Gender Gap in Candidate Persistence

items.abstract: I construct a measure of candidate quality differentials using local newspaper endorsements. I argue that political endorsements made by newspapers can be used as expert opinions that reflect both a newspaper's partisan bias as well as quality differences between the candidates in an election. Using a dataset of 21,094 local newspaper endorsements, I simultaneously estimate the quality differences between candidates in 6,432 elections, along with a dynamic measure of the partisan bias of 368 local newspapers. After validating the endorsement-based measures of quality and bias, I use the candidate quality differential measure to reexamine the relationship between candidate quality, incumbency, and election results. I conclude with a discussion of how the new endorsement-based measures have a strong potential to help advance our understanding of the importance of candidate quality in electoral politics and governance in the United States.
items.summary_ko: 지역 신문 사설의 후보자 지지를 활용해 선거 후보자 간 자질 차이와 신문의 정파적 편향을 동시에 추정하고, 이를 검증한 뒤 후보자 자질·현직 프리미엄·선거 결과의 관계를 재검토한다. 분석 결과는 지지 자료에 기반한 후보자 자질 측정치가 미국 선거정치와 거버넌스에서 후보자 자질의 중요성을 연구하는 데 유용한 잠재력을 지님을 시사한다.
items.title: Editor’s Choice: Measuring Candidate Quality Using Local Newspaper Endorsements

items.abstract: How does the temporary absence of men from the household due to migration affect female political engagement? While studies on gender and politics have established the centrality of the household, they have largely overlooked how temporary changes in household composition shape political engagement. Using original data from a survey experiment (n=642) in Bihar, India, I show that the absence of male members, particularly a woman's husband can lift implicit restrictions on female political engagement. Drawing on a primary survey (n=1900), and a nationally representative panel (n=24000), I argue that male migration, a significant global phenomenon resulting in routine absence of men, is leading to the feminization of political engagement. Through an increase in exposure to the public sphere, women make meaningful claims on the state, participate in civic activities, and discuss politics. Unlike existing resource-based theories, I find that female political engagement can increase even in the absence of financial autonomy.
items.summary_ko: 인도 비하르에서 남성, 특히 남편의 일시적 이주로 인한 부재가 여성의 정치적 참여에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 설문실험(n=642), 1차 설문(n=1,900), 전국 대표 패널(n=24,000) 자료로 분석했다. 남성 부재는 여성의 공적 영역 노출을 늘려 국가에 대한 요구, 시민활동, 정치 대화를 촉진하며, 재정적 자율성이 없어도 여성의 정치 참여를 높이는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Left Behind or Left Ahead? Implications of Male Migration on Female Political Engagement

items.abstract: Abstract Politicians often face policy decisions where sacrificing some targets benefits others. As motivations behind such decisions can be ambiguous, partisans may ascribe nobler motives to politicians who make decisions they approve of and whose party they identify with. Consequently, evaluations of politicians can be shaped by the politician's decision, party affiliation, the domain of sacrifice, and the evaluator's political orientation. Across three studies, the US and South American participants ( N = 1595) evaluated liberal/left‐wing and conservative/right‐wing politicians who accepted or rejected educational and economic sacrifices. We examined how participants' political orientation influenced judgments of sacrificial decisions. Conservative/Right‐wing political orientation frequently (though not always) predicted higher ratings of conservative/right‐wing politicians and lower ratings of liberal/left‐wing politicians across decision acceptability, vote‐worthiness, warmth, and competence—even when both politicians made the same choice. Study 2 demonstrated that the direction of bias depends on the policy domain, with liberal‐leaning participants less accepting of educational sacrifices and more accepting of economic sacrifices than conservative‐leaning participants. Study 2 further suggested that inferences about politicians' underlying motivations partly drive partisan bias. These findings demonstrate that judgments of realistic sacrificial dilemmas are significantly influenced by the social context—specifically, who is evaluating whom and over which issues.

Matilde Tumino: Department of Psychology Alma Mater Studiorum ‐ University of Bologna Bologna Italy
Paul Conway: School of Psychology University of Southampton Southampton UK
Silvana D'Ottone: Royal Holloway University of London Egham UK
School of Psychology Pontificia Universidad Catolica de Chile Santiago Chile

items.summary_ko: 미국과 남미 참가자 1,595명을 대상으로 세 연구를 수행해, 정치인의 교육·경제적 희생 결정을 정당 성향과 평가자의 정치적 성향이 어떻게 평가하는지 조사했다. 보수·우파 성향 참가자는 같은 선택을 한 경우에도 대체로 우파 정치인을 더 높게 평가했으며, 편향의 방향은 정책 영역에 따라 달라지고 정치인의 동기에 대한 추론이 이를 부분적으로 매개했다.
items.title: The partisan dilemma: How people evaluate sacrificial dilemma decisions by politicians across the political divide

items.abstract: Abstract Climate change requires unprecedented international cooperation; yet growing protectionist sentiment poses a significant barrier to collective action. Global Consciousness (GC), a psychological orientation characterized by a connection to humanity and the world as a whole, has been theorized as a key driver of benevolent behaviors, including pro‐environmental attitudes. However, empirical evidence linking GC to environmentalism remains largely confined to specific contexts, leaving the generalizability of this relationship across diverse societies unclear. Leveraging data from the European Values Survey (EVS) and the World Values Survey (WVS), this study examines the link between GC and indicators of environmentalism: confidence, active membership in environmental organizations, and prioritizing environmental protection over economic growth. We further examine whether socioeconomic context moderates this relationship, hypothesizing that the effect of GC on environmental attitudes will be stronger in wealthier nations, as measured by the Human Development Index (HDI). Multilevel models revealed that, across 35 countries in Study 1 ( N = 40,259) and 86 countries in Study 2 ( N = 123,280), GC is consistently and positively associated with environmentalism. Crucially, this relationship is significantly moderated by HDI. These results indicate that the positive effect of GC on environmentalism is stronger in countries with higher socioeconomic progress, suggesting that GC more readily translates into actions when supported by macro‐level structural resources.

Ayu Okvitawanli: Faculty of Psychology Universitas Sebelas Maret Surakarta Indonesia
Moh. Abdul Hakim: Faculty of Psychology Universitas Sebelas Maret Surakarta Indonesia
Reginapta Nitya Prasetyani: Faculty of Psychology Universitas Sebelas Maret Surakarta Indonesia
Takeshi Hamamura: School of Population Health Curtin University Bentley Western Australia Australia

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 글로벌 의식과 환경주의의 관계가 국가의 사회경제적 맥락에 따라 달라지는지 검토했다. EVS와 WVS의 35개국 및 86개국 자료를 다층모형으로 분석한 결과, 글로벌 의식은 환경주의와 일관되게 정(+)의 관련을 보였으며, 이 관계는 HDI가 높은 국가에서 더 강했다.
items.title: The boundaries of global concern: How socioeconomic context shapes the link between global consciousness and environmental attitudes

items.abstract: ABSTRACT This article describes the conditions for creating and undermining public interest capacity, that is, the ability of the state to generate public goods with widely distributed benefits. The creation and elimination of Direct File, a free, online public tax reporting system in the United States, offers an instrumental case. The creation of Direct File depended upon political commitment sufficient to overcome private interests: both the traditional dependence on private contractors to produce digital products, and the opposition of the private tax preparation industry which saw Direct File as a competitor. Political will was not enough: creating internal capacity in the form of skilled government tech teams who could build a quality digital product was also necessary. But without this political commitment in the Trump administration, which instead pursued downsizing and was receptive to the tax preparation industry arguments, both Direct File and the team that built it were eliminated.

Donald Moynihan: Ford School of Public Policy University of Michigan Ann Arbor Michigan USA
Pam Herd: Ford School of Public Policy University of Michigan Ann Arbor Michigan USA
Xiaoyang Xu: Department of Political Science University of South Carolina Columbia South Carolina USA

items.summary_ko: 이 글은 국가가 광범위하게 분산된 편익을 지닌 공공재를 창출하는 ‘공익 역량’을 어떤 조건에서 형성하거나 약화시키는지, 미국의 무료 온라인 세금 신고 시스템 Direct File의 창설과 폐지를 통해 분석한다. Direct File에는 민간 이해관계를 극복할 정치적 의지와 양질의 디지털 제품을 개발할 숙련된 정부 기술팀이라는 내부 역량이 모두 필요했지만, 트럼프 행정부에서 정치적 지원이 사라지면서 시스템과 구축팀이 폐지되었다.
items.title: Public Interest Capacity: The Case of Direct File

items.abstract: This article examines how power dynamics are shaped and managed in day-to-day civil-military collaboration in Swedish total defence. Drawing on semi-structured interviews with key civilian and military actors involved in total defence planning, the article investigates the interplay of power asymmetries, the collaboration’s institutional and relational conditions and how collaborating actors perceive and manage asymmetries in practice. Using thematic analysis, we demonstrate that civil-military collaboration is characterized by imbalances in authority, resources and discursive legitimacy. The paper further sheds light on micro-level practices of power enactment and details how collaborating actors negotiate and manage power asymmetries. The main finding suggests that when the relatively more powerful actors engage in power moderating practices, which we conceptualize as Strategic Power Moderation (SPM), collaborations can perform productively despite asymmetrical relations. The results offer a nuanced understanding of how collaborations fare under conditions of power asymmetry and have implications for both research and practice.
items.summary_ko: 스웨덴 총방위 계획에 참여하는 민간·군사 행위자들의 반구조화 인터뷰와 주제분석을 통해, 권한·자원·담론적 정당성의 비대칭이 일상적 협업에서 어떻게 인식·관리되는지 탐색했다. 상대적으로 강한 행위자가 ‘전략적 권력 완화(Strategic Power Moderation, SPM)’를 실천할 때 비대칭적 관계에서도 협업이 생산적으로 수행될 수 있다는 점을 제시한다.
items.title: Achievements amidst asymmetries: power dynamics in Swedish civil-military collaboration - an exploratory conceptualization

items.abstract: //static.cambridge.org/content/id/urn%3Acambridge.org%3Aid%3Aarticle%3AS0003055426102032/resource/name/firstPage-pdf-S0003055426102032a.jpg
items.summary_ko: 제공된 자료는 「Presidential Investment in the Administrative State」의 정정본임을 나타내지만, 초록 내용이 확인되지 않아 연구 질문·접근법·주요 발견을 요약할 수 없다.
items.title: Presidential Investment in the Administrative State – ERRATUM

items.abstract: Recent literature has documented a growing entanglement between political processes and many nonpolitical entities. This calls into question the traditional presupposition of politics as a self-contained sphere, highlighting the need to clarify how the conceptual relationship between the political and the nonpolitical has been established. In line with a relational understanding of politics, we provide a boundary analysis by looking at the “non-political” labeling in 140 empirical studies published in political science and communication journals. Two major conceptual treatments are identified: categorical, treating the “non-political” as an inherent, exclusive feature; and contextual, viewing it as a temporary, transformative state. Intellectual traditions, theoretical orientations, methodological standards, and rhetorical norms in academic knowledge production may explain why this boundary has been constructed in such different ways. We call for a more active reconciliation between these treatments, and argue that the nonpolitical, as well as (de)politicization, should be recognized as a meaningful analytical lens. It signifies a relational stance against the explicit, institutionalized politics in political communication studies, offering an indirect yet heuristically productive response to the question of what the political is.

Yufan Guo: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

items.summary_ko: 정치와 비정치의 관계가 어떻게 개념화되어 왔는지 밝히기 위해 정치학·커뮤니케이션 학술지에 게재된 140개 실증연구의 ‘비정치적’ 라벨링을 경계 분석했다. 비정치를 본질적이고 배타적인 범주로 보는 범주적 접근과 일시적·변혁적 상태로 보는 맥락적 접근이 확인되었으며, 연구의 지적 전통·이론적 지향·방법론적 기준·수사적 규범이 이러한 차이를 형성한 요인으로 제시된다.
items.title: The Politics of the “Non-Political”: A Conceptual Review

items.abstract: This study investigates how revenue autonomy is associated with documented municipal corruption risk, distinguishing between own-source tax and non-tax revenues. Drawing on public administration theories of decentralization, it adopts a meso-level analysis of Italian medium-to-large municipalities and relies on an event-based indicator derived from legally mandated anticorruption reports. The empirical strategy combines dynamic correlated random-effects logit, dynamic random-effects probit, and fixed-effects logit models, complemented by sensitivity analyses simulating under-reporting scenarios. Results indicate that higher levels of both tax and non-tax revenue autonomy are negatively associated with documented corruption risk. Tax autonomy shows stronger associations where political competition is higher, whereas the non-tax revenue pattern is more consistent with a service-based responsiveness logic. These findings, observed in the Italian municipal context, suggest that revenue autonomy is not a uniform anticorruption safeguard but an institutional feature whose relevance depends on revenue composition, accountability conditions, municipal capacity, and reporting practices.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 이탈리아 중·대도시를 대상으로 세입 자율성(자체 세원인 세수와 비세수)이 법정 반부패 보고서에 기록된 지방정부 부패 위험과 어떻게 연관되는지 동태적 패널 모형과 민감도 분석으로 검토했다. 세수·비세수 자율성이 모두 기록된 부패 위험과 음의 연관성을 보였으며, 세수 자율성의 연관성은 정치적 경쟁이 높을 때 강했고 비세수 자율성은 서비스 기반 대응성 논리와 더 일관되게 나타났다.
items.title: Decentralization as an anticorruption strategy: does revenue autonomy make a difference?

items.abstract: Public-sector organizations (PSOs) are increasingly created to reduce inequities, yet we know little about how they operationalize ambitious mandates in complex systems. We study Aotearoa New Zealand’s Te Aka Whai Ora / Māori Health Authority (MHA), established in 2022 and disestablished within two years, using an interpretive analysis of 26 interviews with former staff along with available official documents and news reports. This paper conceptualizes operationalization as a dynamic achievement: an operating model must stabilize decision rights, routines, inter-organizational interfaces, and performance controls to translate policy intent into coordinated action. We identify six recurring misalignment patterns that pushed the MHA from visionary intent to operational marginality as system conditions disrupted authority–accountability congruence, interface specification, capacity stability, and performance control. This research introduces recursive system fit, showing how capabilities and system conditions co-shape viability of PSOs. Policymakers should specify operationalization inputs at planning stage rather than retrofit them during implementation.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 복잡한 체계에서 불평등 완화를 목표로 설립된 공공부문 조직이 야심찬 임무를 어떻게 운영화하는지, 뉴질랜드 테 아카 와이 오라(마오리 보건 당국) 사례를 통해 분석한다. 전직 직원 26명 인터뷰와 공식 문서·뉴스 보도의 해석적 분석 결과, 의사결정 권한, 업무 루틴, 조직 간 접점, 성과 통제가 체계 조건과 어긋나면서 조직의 실행 가능성이 약화되었으며, 운영화에 필요한 투입요소를 계획 단계에서 명확히 해야 한다고 제시한다.
items.title: Towards a theory of public-sector organizations with targeted mandates: a case study of New Zealand’s Māori Health Authority

items.abstract: Citizens play a crucial role in public-private partnerships (PPPs). Yet, such citizens often are poorly engaged and excluded from decision-making, leading to situations where their interests do not align with the public and private partners. Recognizing the importance of private sector behaviors in PPPs, we aim to identify how their behaviors play a role in aligning these interests to meet citizen expectations. We use the Economies of Worth framework and a comparative case study to identify behavioral mechanisms to support alignment, such as being available to citizens in person, adaptability, engaging in small goodwill gestures, and sustaining these behaviors over time.

Giovanni Esposito: HEC Liège—Management School of the University of Liège, Belgium
Jessica Clement: French Agricultural Research Centre for International Development (CIRAD), Montpellier, France
HEC Liège—Management School of the University of Liège, Belgium
Nathalie Crutzen: HEC Liège—Management School of the University of Liège, Belgium

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 민관협력에서 민간 부문의 행동이 시민의 기대와 공공·민간 파트너의 이해를 어떻게 조정하는지 탐색한다. ‘가치의 경제’(Economies of Worth) 틀에 기반한 비교 사례연구를 통해, 시민을 대면해 이용 가능하게 하고, 유연하게 대응하며, 작은 호의적 행동을 하고, 이를 지속하는 것이 이해관계 조정을 돕는 행동 메커니즘임을 제시한다.
items.title: The Citizen’s Seat at the Table: How Private Sector Behavior Fosters Alignment With Citizens in Public-Private Partnerships

items.abstract: ABSTRACT New governments frequently inherit issues from their predecessors, and as a result, various policy problems tend to remain on the agenda for many years. Previous research examining the role of policy inheritance has focused mainly on the agenda during a government's term in office. These studies find that because governments must first contend with the problems they inherit, there is considerably less room for new issues to emerge on the agenda. This study seeks to examine the idea of policy inheritance through the lens of coalition agreements. Coalition agreements, a feature of multiparty governments, are drafted shortly after elections and reflect the outcome of the political struggle. For this reason, one can expect that coalition agreements contain mostly issues that parties regard as important. By implication, changes in the coalition agreements' issue agenda would be a function of the political change produced by the electoral cycle, rather than of inheritance. Analyzing coalition agreements in three countries—Israel, the Netherlands, and Norway—across 42 elections, we find no evidence for this assumption. Agendas in coalition agreements do not vary with changes in the party composition of the coalition, changes in the ideological distance between parties, or changes in the party holding the office of Prime Minister. This indicates that even when new coalition governments are preparing for their term in office, inheritance remains the primary driver of agenda‐setting.

Amnon Cavari: Lauder School of Government, Diplomacy & Strategy Reichman University Herzliya Israel
Arco Timmermans: The Institute of Public Administration, Leiden University The Hague the Netherlands
Gerard Breeman: The Institute of Public Administration, Leiden University The Hague the Netherlands
Ilana Shpaizman: Department of Political Studies Bar Ilan University Ramat Gan Israel
Jens Jungblut: Department of Political Science University of Oslo Oslo Norway
Jon Bøe Valgermo: Department of Political Science University of Oslo Oslo Norway

items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 이스라엘·네덜란드·노르웨이의 42개 선거를 대상으로 연립정부 협약의 의제 변화가 정당 구성, 정당 간 이념적 거리, 총리직 보유 정당의 변화와 관련되는지 분석했다. 그 결과 이러한 정치적 변화보다 이전 정부에서 물려받은 정책 의제가 협약 의제 설정을 지속적으로 주도하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Policy Agendas in Coalition Agreements: The Enduring Influence of Policy Inheritance

items.abstract: This study examines how Factchecking AI tools and community-based credibility practices interacted during Tanzania’s 2025 presidential election. Using data from five regions, we analyzed 342 media materials, 87 interviews, field observations, and 22 distinct contested election events. The findings identify three forms of verification disjuncture. First, AI-assisted translation and transcription sometimes changed the meaning of politically important statements before journalists could verify them. Second, fact-checks and disputed claims often moved through different communication channels, which limited the chances that people would see the correction. Third, some communities trusted personal experience, familiar sources, and collective discussion more than professional fact-checkers. Participants judged credibility through relationships, lived experience, group discussion, humor and satire, and social accountability. These practices sometimes supported the same conclusions as institutional verification and sometimes produced different judgments. We argue that fact-checking becomes politically effective when the meaning of a claim is preserved, the correction reaches the people discussing it, and the source of the correction is recognized as credible. This explains why an accurate fact-check can still have limited public influence.

Gregory Gondwe: Harvard – Berkman Klein Centre for Internet & Society

items.summary_ko: 탄자니아 2025년 대선에서 AI 기반 팩트체킹과 지역사회 신뢰성 판단이 어떻게 상호작용하는지, 5개 지역의 미디어 자료 342건·인터뷰 87건·현장관찰·논쟁적 선거 사건 22건을 분석했다. AI 번역·전사로 의미가 변형되거나 정정이 관련 논의 채널에 도달하지 못하고, 공동체가 개인적 경험·익숙한 출처·집단 토론을 전문 팩트체커보다 신뢰하면서, 정확한 팩트체크도 의미 보존·도달성·출처 신뢰성이 확보되지 않으면 공적 영향력이 제한될 수 있음을 보였다.
items.title: Who Verifies the Verifiers? AI, Local Knowledge Production, and Credibility in Tanzania’s 2025 Election

items.abstract: ABSTRACT This Reply suggests the sub‐field of U.S.‐specific public administration is under‐prepared to address democratic deconsolidation given its multi‐decade distance from the disciplines of comparative politics and political economy and from the sub‐fields of comparative and development public administration. The narrowness of what is understand as “good” public administration by U.S.‐based scholars has largely excluded cross‐disciplinary and non‐U.S. intellectual histories which, if understood, would have deepened sub‐field intellectual depth and breadth but also, better prepared the sub‐field for America's current administrative state. This Reply suggests the value of drawing upon post‐WWII administration‐linked trends in other disciplines and upon links between administration and prior democratic deconsolidations (the U.S. is not unique). This includes the sub‐field's historical reluctance to research existential insecurity, intolerance (beyond social inequity), the role of democratic restraint, the role of crisis (or lack of) in democratic deconsolidation, and theories of democracy‐to‐autocracy and autocracy‐to‐democracy.

Kim Moloney: Australia New Zealand School of Government Carlton Australia

items.summary_ko: 미국 공공행정 하위분야가 비교정치·정치경제 및 비교·발전행정과 수십 년간 거리를 둔 탓에 민주주의 탈공고화에 대응할 준비가 부족했는지를 검토한다. 제2차 세계대전 이후 다른 학문 분야의 행정 관련 흐름과 과거 민주주의 탈공고화 사례를 참조할 것을 제안하며, 미국의 현재 상황에 대한 하위분야의 지적 준비 부족이 이러한 학문적 협소성과 관련된다고 주장한다.
items.title: Reply to Kettl: The Field of Public Administration in America and an Unpreparedness of Its Own Making?

items.abstract: In recent years, there has been a significant rise in the use of algorithmic decision-making systems (ADS) to assist or replace human decision-making in a wide range of policy areas as policing, criminal sentencing, and social welfare assistance. How do citizens view the incorporation of this technology in guiding high-stakes decisions? I introduce a new theory to explain the conditions under which citizens view ADS as legitimate, fair, and accurate, and test it using data from original experiments embedded in a national U.S. survey. I show that across a wide range of policy domains, citizens exhibit aversion to the use of ADS in decisions that are seen as designed to sanction rather than to assist, and when they are required to make inferences about individuals rather than collectives. Evidence from a second experiment suggests that the employment of ADS in such contexts can significantly undermine the legitimacy of the policy actions they inform. Together, the study offers a framework to identify where AI-based tools will be deemed appropriate and where they might trigger backlash, highlighting the importance of accounting for citizens’ values in AI development and implementation to maintain legitimacy and democratic accountability.
items.summary_ko: 시민이 공공정책의 고위험 의사결정에 알고리즘 의사결정 시스템(ADS)을 사용하는 것을 언제 정당하고 공정하며 정확하다고 보는지 규명하기 위해, 미국 전국 설문에 내재된 독창적 실험들을 실시했다. 시민들은 다양한 정책 영역에서 ADS가 지원보다 제재를 목적으로 하거나 개인에 대한 추론을 요구하는 결정에 사용될 때 이를 더 꺼렸으며, 이러한 맥락의 ADS 사용은 관련 정책 조치의 정당성을 크게 약화시켰다.
items.title: When Do Citizens Resist the Use of AI Algorithms in Public Policy? Theory and Evidence

items.abstract: Effective digital communication is a strategic imperative for government service delivery, yet the emerging information dissemination model emerging remains underexplored. Drawing on Chongqing’s digital-policing reform, this study develops an analytical framework centered on visibility-driven flexible re-hierarchization, based on interviews and observations. The analysis identifies three mechanisms: upward visibility and vertical bypass produce functional flattening without formal delayering; cross-boundary horizontal linkage dissolves departmental silos while preserving centralized coordination; and dual-mode switching shifts the information order between routine networked and mobilizational hierarchical communication. Digital technology does not flatten bureaucracy but endows it with an elastic capacity to switch between the two orders.

Di Zhu: Southwest Minzu University, Chengdu, Sichuan, China

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 정부 디지털 커뮤니케이션에서 정보 전달 질서가 어떻게 변화하는지 분석하기 위해 충칭 디지털 치안 개혁을 대상으로 인터뷰와 관찰을 실시했다. 분석 결과, 디지털 기술은 관료제를 평준화하기보다 상향적 가시성·수직적 우회, 부문 간 수평적 연계, 일상적 네트워크형과 동원적 위계형 간 전환을 통해 공식적 계층을 유지한 채 유연하게 재위계화하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Flattening Without Leveling: Visibility-Driven Flexible Re-Hierarchization in Government Digital Communication

items.abstract: Multifamily housing is common in urban areas, and neighbor noise is a frequent problem. In this study, a governance-based approach was designed for managing and preventing noise problems, marking an advance from conventional noise-reduction technologies. Using qualitative methods, including interviews with residents and professionals, the proposed framework categorizes five key sectors: individual, community, society, industry, and public. It highlights sector interactions, identifies key actors, and suggests sector-specific activities for resolution. Rather than offering a fixed solution, the proposed governance model is adaptable to various contexts, promoting sustainable and context-sensitive approaches to noise management.

Hye-Kyung Shin: Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology, Goyang-si, Gyeonggi, Republic of Korea
Kyoung-Woo Kim: Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology, Goyang-si, Gyeonggi, Republic of Korea
Sang Hee Park: Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology, Goyang-si, Gyeonggi, Republic of Korea
Seongwon Yoon: Hanyang University, Seoul, Republic of Korea

items.summary_ko: 다세대 주택의 이웃 소음 문제를 어떻게 관리·예방할 수 있는지 탐색하기 위해 주민과 전문가 인터뷰를 포함한 질적 연구를 수행했다. 연구는 개인·공동체·사회·산업·공공의 다섯 부문과 이들 간 상호작용 및 핵심 행위자를 제시하고, 상황에 맞게 조정 가능한 거버넌스 기반 해결 틀을 제안한다.
items.title: Neighbor Noise Problem in Multifamily Housing: An Integrative Framework for Resolution

items.abstract: The rise of populist right parties is well studied, but relatively little attention has been given to how public service performance influences voter support. Given that public services are often the primary means through which citizens interact with the state, we argue that declining public services can create grievances that increase the appeal of populist right parties. Focusing on England’s National Health Service, we combine administrative data on local health facility closures with panel data on public preferences and voting intentions. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design, we find that closures reduce satisfaction with public services and increase support for populist right parties. These effects are moderated by migrant registrations at local health practices, highlighting the interaction between public service performance and immigration concerns in fueling populist right support. Our findings underscore the role of public service decline as a driver of support for populist parties, especially in areas undergoing demographic change.

SARA B. HOBOLT: London School of Economics and Political Science
ZACHARY P. DICKSON: London School of Economics and Political Science

items.summary_ko: 영국 국민보건서비스의 지역 의료시설 폐쇄가 공공서비스 만족도와 포퓰리즘 우파 지지에 미치는 영향을 행정자료와 패널자료를 결합한 시차적 이중차분으로 분석했다. 시설 폐쇄는 공공서비스 만족도를 낮추고 포퓰리즘 우파 지지를 높였으며, 지역 의료기관의 이민자 등록 수준에 따라 그 효과가 달라졌다.
items.title: Public Service Decline and Support for the Populist Right: Evidence from England’s National Health Service

items.abstract: ABSTRACT A government's ability to generate surpluses and build reserves reflects prudent financial management, with the accumulation of reserves signaling sound budgeting practices. Reserves are essential for sound fiscal governance during economic downturns, and managerial discretion over these resources is crucial to minimizing disruptions in service delivery. While the counter‐cyclical benefits of formal reserves are well documented, less attention has been paid to the discretion managers retain over reserves. Using credit ratings as a proxy for creditworthiness, we find that managerial discretion over accumulated resources enhances fiscal flexibility and strengthens creditworthiness; however, the presence of formal reserves alone does not improve credit ratings. Our study contributes to an emerging literature exploring whether better financial reporting can help us understand the critical balance between management flexibility and accountability mechanisms in public‐sector organizations.

Sharon N. Kioko: Daniel J. Evans School of Public Policy and Governance University of Washington Seattle Washington USA
Temirlan T. Moldogaziev: Paul H. O'Neill School of Public and Environmental Affairs Indiana University Bloomington Indiana USA

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 정부의 축적된 재원에 대한 관리자의 재량이 신용도에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 신용등급을 대리변수로 분석한다. 분석 결과, 공식적 준비금의 존재만으로는 신용등급이 향상되지 않지만 축적 재원에 대한 관리자의 재량은 재정적 유연성과 신용도를 높이는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Governing Reserves: Managerial Discretion and Government Creditworthiness

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Public participation can enhance policy quality and democratic legitimacy but may threaten bureaucratic control. We hypothesize that bureaucratic support for participation is higher when policies are less complex and participants are broadly representative. Using a mixed‐methods design involving Indonesian local public servants, we pursue complementarity by combining a 2 × 2 vignette‐based survey experiment with a Gioia analysis of qualitative reflections to explain the experimental results and further illuminate how bureaucrats evaluate participation. The experiment shows that participant representativeness significantly increases support, whereas policy complexity has no statistically significant effect. Integrating the experimental and qualitative data through joint displays reveals that bureaucrats rejecting participation frequently cite participant‐related risks, whereas supporters emphasize instrumental, procedural, and implementation benefits. Normative values, such as citizens' rights and democratic principles, are acknowledged regardless of bureaucrats' overall support. We conclude that bureaucratic support for public participation reflects how officials balance its promises, threats, and normative foundations.

Jesse W. Campbell: Department of Public Administration Incheon National University Incheon South Korea
Oscar Radyan Danar: Department of Public Administration, Faculty of Administrative Sciences Brawijaya University Malang Indonesia
Sanjay K. Pandey: Trachtenberg School of Public Policy and Public Administration George Washington University Washington DC USA

items.summary_ko: 관료의 공공참여 지지가 정책 복잡성과 참여자 대표성에 따라 어떻게 달라지는지, 인도네시아 지방공무원을 대상으로 2×2 설문 실험과 질적 성찰의 Gioia 분석을 결합해 분석했다. 참여자 대표성은 지지를 유의하게 높였지만 정책 복잡성의 효과는 통계적으로 유의하지 않았으며, 반대자는 참여자 관련 위험을, 지지자는 도구적·절차적·집행상의 이점을 주로 언급했고 시민의 권리와 민주적 원칙은 지지 여부와 무관하게 인정했다.
items.title: Promises, Threats, and Norms: A Mixed Methods Study on Bureaucratic Support for Public Participation

items.abstract: This study examines how citizens respond to democratic transgressions by political opponents and whether they, in turn, support reciprocal transgressions by their own party. Drawing on psychological theories of negative reciprocity, we argue that commitment to democratic principles is relational, shaped by the (un)democratic behavior of other political actors. Through survey experiments in England (N = 4,040) and the United States (N = 4,084) we find that exposure to opponents’ transgressions doubles citizens’ likelihood of endorsing undemocratic actions by their own party. Moreover, we document that tendencies to reciprocate transgressions are independent of citizens’ affective polarization levels. Thematic analyses of open responses (N = 907) reveal that many justify reciprocal transgressions as morally necessary to restore fairness and protect democracy. As such, our findings highlight the need for an interactive approach that captures the dynamic and morally complex nature of citizens’ attitudes towards democratic violations.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 시민들이 정치적 상대의 민주주의 위반에 어떻게 반응하며, 그에 상응하는 자당의 비민주적 행동을 지지하는지를 영국과 미국의 설문 실험으로 분석했다. 상대의 위반에 노출된 시민은 자당의 비민주적 행동을 지지할 가능성이 약 두 배 높았고, 이러한 상호적 위반 지지는 정서적 양극화와 무관했으며, 일부 시민은 공정성 회복과 민주주의 보호를 위해 이를 도덕적으로 정당화했다.
items.title: “When they go low, we kick them”: The reciprocal nature of citizens’ support for democratic transgressions

items.abstract: While the causes and consequences of gender bias are well documented, it remains unclear whether existing theories explain gender dynamics in China's civil service. This study addresses this gap by leveraging original administrative data from the Chinese National Civil Service Examination. The findings show widespread gender bias, with an increased supply of qualified female applicants in prior years prompting hiring authorities, particularly at lower levels of government, to adopt recruitment practices favoring male candidates. These malepreferred practices significantly reshape the candidate pool, reducing its size by 40-45% and lowering candidate quality by 4-5%. These findings deepen our understanding of women's persistent underrepresentation in the Chinese bureaucracy and highlight the substantial costs associated with gendered recruitment practices.
items.summary_ko: 중국 국가공무원시험의 원자료를 활용해 중국 공무원 채용에서 성별 역학이 어떻게 나타나며 그 결과가 무엇인지 분석했다. 자격을 갖춘 여성 지원자 공급이 늘어난 이후 채용 당국, 특히 하위 정부 수준에서 남성을 선호하는 채용 관행을 강화했고, 이는 지원자 풀을 40~45% 줄이며 후보자 질을 4~5% 낮췄다.
items.title: Causes and Consequences of Gendered Bureaucratic Recruitment: A Study of China

items.abstract: Abstract Why do authorities demolish informal settlements in metropolises? The social sciences have a long tradition of addressing this issue through the lens of economic development or welfare provision. I instead propose a theory of political control. Autocrats adopt demolition as a preemptive and coercive tool to remove communities substantively and symbolically less legible to them, thereby ensuring societal compliance and restoring visual order. Empirically, I compile a unique dataset of 320 demolished and undemolished informal settlements in Beijing between 2017 and 2018, based on satellite imagery, digital street views, and fieldwork. The results indicate that the low legibility of informal settlements to authorities correlates with a greater likelihood of demolition. This paper contributes to the social science literature by connecting legibility politics with urban governance. It also introduces a spatial perspective and leverages novel data sources to deepen our understanding of preemptive coercion under authoritarianism.

Shiqi Ma: Department of Politics and International Studies SOAS University of London London United Kingdom

items.summary_ko: 권위주의 정권이 왜 대도시의 비공식 정착지를 철거하는지 설명하기 위해, 베이징의 2017~2018년 철거·미철거 정착지 320곳을 위성영상·디지털 거리뷰·현지조사로 분석했다. 당국이 실질적·상징적으로 파악하기 어려운 정착지일수록 철거될 가능성이 높아, 철거가 사회적 순응을 확보하고 시각적 질서를 회복하려는 선제적 강압 수단임을 보인다.
items.title: Spatiality of preemptive coercion: How autocrats demolish informal settlements for political control

items.abstract: Abstract Annotated text data are central to many empirical applications in political science, yet many annotation tasks involve categories that are sparsely populated. These low- N categories pose problems for both encoder-only and decoder-only (generative) Transformer large language models (LLMs), leading to low performance, biased evaluation and measurement error in downstream analyses. This article introduces the synthetic imputation approach, a targeted method for expanding sparse categories while remaining consistent with the category-defining content of the human-coded examples. The approach uses a generative LLM to produce additional texts for underrepresented categories by conditioning on small, rotating subsets of human-coded examples. Rather than paraphrasing or replacing the original data, synthetic imputation adds informative variation only where data are thin. I evaluate the approach using both encoder-only and decoder-only LLM classifiers across multiple political science applications. The results show that synthetic imputation substantially improves performance and evaluation stability in sparse settings, recovering full-sample performance once a modest number of true observations is available, with limited and predictable overfitting at very low levels of N .
items.summary_ko: 정치학의 지도학습 분류에서 표본이 부족한 범주의 성능과 평가 불안정을 개선할 수 있는지 검토하기 위해, 소수의 인간 코딩 사례를 순환적으로 조건화한 생성형 LLM으로 해당 범주의 합성 텍스트를 생성해 데이터를 확장하는 합성 대치 접근법을 제안하고 여러 응용에서 평가했다. 그 결과 실제 관측치가 적정 수준 확보되면 전체 표본 수준의 성능을 회복했고, 매우 낮은 표본 수에서는 제한적이고 예측 가능한 과적합이 나타났다.
items.title: The Synthetic Imputation Approach: Using LLMs to Generate Synthetic Texts for Underrepresented Categories in Supervised Classification Tasks

items.abstract: Abstract Although sexism may serve as a gateway into the men's rights movement, few studies have examined group processes in online environments that fuel this reactionary movement. We address this gap by examining whether interacting with like‐minded others fosters an emergent social identity as a “men's rights supporter” among sexist men; and whether identification predicts willingness to engage in reactionary actions undermining gender equality. Across two studies ( N s = 443, 755), men completed a hostile sexism measure and read about the perceived impacts of feminism on men. Participants then either discussed whether feminism negatively impacts men in an online chatroom (group deliberation) or reflected individually (individual deliberation). Hostile sexism predicted identification as a men's rights supporter, and this link was stronger in the group deliberation condition. In turn, identification predicted greater reactionary action intentions. Unexpectedly, these effects emerged only among men who indicated that their group was unsure about the impact of feminism after the discussion. A post‐hoc content analysis of the pooled chat logs revealed that these men engaged in discussions marked by conflict and disagreement, suggesting that identification with the movement emerged through dissent rather than consensus. These findings highlight complex social dynamics underpinning engagement with the men's rights movement.

Anna C. Barron: School of Public and International Affairs Princeton University Princeton New Jersey USA
Cassandra M. Quarisa: Flinders University Institute for Mental Health and Wellbeing, College of Human Sciences and Culture Flinders University Adelaide South Australia Australia
Danny Osborne: School of Psychology University of Auckland Auckland New Zealand
Emma F. Thomas: Flinders University Institute for Mental Health and Wellbeing, College of Human Sciences and Culture Flinders University Adelaide South Australia Australia
Morgana Lizzio‐Wilson: Department of Psychology University of Exeter Exeter UK
Flinders University Institute for Mental Health and Wellbeing, College of Human Sciences and Culture Flinders University Adelaide South Australia Australia

items.summary_ko: 적대적 성차별이 남성권리 지지자 정체성과 반동적 행동 의도에 미치는 영향을, 온라인 집단 토론과 개별 숙고를 비교하는 두 연구로 분석했다. 적대적 성차별은 남성권리 지지자 정체성을 예측했고 그 연관성은 집단 토론에서 더 강했으며, 정체성은 반동적 행동 의도를 예측했지만 이러한 효과는 토론 후 집단이 페미니즘의 남성 영향에 확신이 없다고 인식한 남성에게만 나타났다.
items.title: From misogyny to mobilization: Hostile sexism and conflictual online discussions indirectly predict men's rights activism via heightened identification as a men's rights supporter

items.abstract: ABSTRACT To compete in the “war for talent,” public sector employers must demonstrate advantages over private employers. While public service motivation (PSM) predicts sector preference, scholars disagree on whether public employers (can) effectively signal PSM in job advertisements. Consequently, this article examines how public and private job advertisements differ in language. We collected 5000 advertisements from both sectors and performed natural language processing (NLP) and qualitative content analysis. Both sectors use specialized language that can narrow the applicant pool. PSM signals appear more often in the public sector, but affective motives are rarely communicated; instead, self‐sacrifice is framed as a legal obligation. Public sector advertisements adopt a rational tone instead of explaining purpose and societal value. Legally mandated, saturated signals may be perceived as low‐cost and ineffective. The findings explain the mixed results concerning PSM signaling and underscore the gap between theory and practice in PSM‐related recruitment efforts.

Nico Gießmann: Institute of Human‐Centered Interactive Systems, University of Luebeck Lübeck Germany
Nicolas Drathschmidt: Chair of Public and Nonprofit Management University of Potsdam Potsdam Germany

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 공공·민간 부문 채용공고의 언어가 공공서비스동기(PSM)를 어떻게 신호하는지 비교하기 위해 양 부문 5,000건의 공고를 NLP와 질적 내용분석으로 분석했다. PSM 신호는 공공부문에서 더 자주 나타났지만 정서적 동기는 거의 전달되지 않고 자기희생이 법적 의무로 제시되며, 공공공고는 목적과 사회적 가치를 설명하기보다 합리적 어조와 법정 문구에 의존하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Between the Lines: Decoding Signaling Differences in Public and Private Sector Job Advertisements

items.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper evaluates the effects of a novel and large‐scale program in King County, Washington, that provides fare‐free public transportation to individuals with low incomes. Using both experimental and quasi‐experimental methods together with rich administrative and survey data, we find that providing free transit has very limited effects on mobility or downstream outcomes related to health and well‐being. We examine possible explanations for the modest effects, which contrast with findings from prior research. Our results suggest that changes in the external environment post‐COVID‐19 pandemic, including changes in norms around fare evasion, reduced the price elasticity of demand for travel by transit among individuals with low incomes.

Atheendar Venkataramani: University of Pennsylvania Philadelphia Pennsylvania USA
David Phillips: University of Notre Dame Notre Dame Indiana USA
Matthew Freedman: University of California, Irvine Irvine California USA
Seoyoon Ahn: University of Notre Dame Notre Dame Indiana USA

items.journal: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
items.summary_ko: 워싱턴주 킹카운티의 저소득층 무임 대중교통 보조가 이동성과 건강·웰빙 관련 후속 결과에 미친 효과를 실험 및 준실험 방법과 행정·설문 자료로 평가했다. 무임승차의 효과는 매우 제한적이었으며, 코로나19 이후 외부 환경과 요금 회피 규범의 변화가 저소득층의 대중교통 수요 가격탄력성을 낮춘 것이 가능한 설명으로 제시되었다.
items.title: Means‐Tested Public Transportation Subsidies: Causal Evidence and Implications

items.abstract: ABSTRACT We estimate the health and well‐being effects of subsidized access to long‐term care (LTC). Our analysis exploits the staggered implementation of Spain's 2007 System of Autonomy and Care for Dependent People (SAAD), which expanded publicly funded and universal LTC subsidies and supports, as well as its subsequent reform. Using two decades of administrative and survey data and leveraging exogenous regional and individual‐level variation in program exposure, we find that access to SAAD benefits reduces the care receiver's depressive symptoms by approximately 10 percentage points, increases its survival probability by 2.6–3 percentage points, and raises its life satisfaction by 0.24–0.50 scale points. Cost‐effectiveness estimates indicate that the implied cost per quality‐adjusted life year (QALY) gained lies below commonly accepted efficiency thresholds for public health spending in Europe. These findings document sizeable health returns and efficiency gains from publicly subsidized LTC provision.

Joan Costa‐Font: Department of Health Policy London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE) London UK
Sergi Jiménez‐Martín: Barcelona School of Economics (BSE) Barcelona Spain

items.journal: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
items.summary_ko: 스페인의 장기요양 보조금 제도(SAAD)에 대한 노출이 수급자의 건강과 웰빙에 미치는 효과를 추정하기 위해, 제도의 지역·개인별 단계적 도입과 개혁을 활용하고 20년간의 행정·설문 자료를 분석했다. SAAD 혜택은 우울 증상을 약 10%포인트 낮추고 생존확률을 2.6~3%포인트 높이며 삶의 만족도를 0.24~0.50점 높였고, 추가된 QALY당 비용은 유럽의 공공보건 지출에서 통용되는 효율성 기준보다 낮게 추정됐다.
items.title: Returns to Caring? Health and Well‐Being Effects of Subsidized Long‐Term Care

items.abstract: Partisans engage in “wishful thinking” ahead of elections, being more likely to expect their party to win than lose at the polls. This article asserts high expectations as endemic to the current polarized era in US politics. In today’s presidential races, 90% of voters expect their preferred candidate to triumph, a sharp increase from just two decades ago. Drawing on the American National Election Study’s 2016–2024 panel survey, I show that partisan animosity (or out-party hate) is robustly associated with high electoral hopes, and using surveys from 1980 to the present, I show that it corresponds with a sizable share of the increase in these expectations over time. Finally, I explore reciprocity in this relationship. An analysis of ANES data from presidential elections between 1996 and 2024 finds that high expectations associate with greater post-election animosity among an election’s losers, independently of their pre-election attitudes.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 미국의 양극화가 선거 전 정당 지지자의 승리 기대를 어떻게 높이는지, 그리고 이러한 기대가 선거 후 패배자의 적대감과 어떤 관련이 있는지를 ANES 2016~2024년 패널 및 1980년 이후 설문자료로 분석한다. 정당 간 적대감은 높은 승리 기대와 강하게 연관되고 기대 수준의 장기적 증가를 상당 부분 설명하며, 높은 기대는 사전 태도와 무관하게 패배 후 적대감 증가와도 관련된다.
items.title: Partisan Wishful Thinking in Polarized Times

items.abstract: Recent research on political persuasion suggests that narrative- and evidence-based messages can effectively change attitudes in settings such as canvassing, video presentations, and survey experiments. Yet less is known about how these persuasive strategies operate in free-flowing, two-way, cross-partisan political conversations. This study examines the relationship between persuasive message types, conversational reciprocity, and post-discussion attitudes using survey and text data from 966 U.S. participants engaged in anonymous one-on-one political discussions on DiscussIt, a mobile chat platform. I analyze how personal narratives and evidence-based arguments relate to conversational interaction outcomes and measurable attitude change. Participants exposed to more personal narratives were more likely to perceive their conversation partner as influential and report more positive conversational experiences, particularly when narrative exchanges were mutually reciprocated. In contrast, evidence-based exchanges were associated with lower perceived interpersonal influence, lower conversational enjoyment, and greater perceptions of relative knowledge. Despite these differences, neither strategy was associated with significant changes in immediate or delayed political attitudes. Unlike studies of unidirectional persuasive messages, this research examines spontaneous peer-to-peer political conversations. Results suggest that persuasive strategies relate to relational and experiential outcomes more than political attitudes.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 익명 모바일 채팅 플랫폼에서 이루어진 966명의 양당 간 정치 대화를 대상으로, 개인적 서사와 근거 기반 논증 및 상호 호혜성이 대화 경험과 정치적 태도 변화와 어떤 관련이 있는지 설문·텍스트 자료로 분석했다. 개인적 서사는 상대방의 영향력 인식과 긍정적 대화 경험을 높였고, 근거 기반 교환은 이를 낮췄지만 두 전략 모두 즉각적·지연된 정치적 태도 변화와는 유의한 관련이 없었다.
items.title: Conversation Without Conversion: Evidence from Cross-Partisan Interactions on a Mobile Chat Platform

items.abstract: Abstract Research shows that providing information on incumbent programmatic performance often has limited impact on citizen attitudes towards incumbents, even if citizens tend to care strongly about corruption and service delivery. We use a survey experiment in South Africa and Tunisia to study if relational clientelism, a type of clientelism often valued by clients, plays a role in this puzzle. We present respondents with a radiocast that varies the profile of the politician (clientelistic vs. neutral) and his performance in service delivery and corruption (good vs. bad). We find that, when clientelistic politicians are valued, performance information on them matters less than for neutral politicians. The effect appears to operate via motivated reasoning: Respondents are less likely to process negative performance information when exposed to the clientelistic profile. Our findings suggest that, in certain contexts, relational clientelism is a valued candidate characteristic that can offset bad programmatic performance akin to co-partisanship or co-ethnicity.
items.summary_ko: 남아프리카공화국과 튀니지에서 정치인의 고객주의적 또는 중립적 특성과 공공서비스·부패 성과 정보를 제시하는 설문실험을 통해, 관계적 고객주의가 성과 정보에 대한 시민의 반응을 약화시키는지 분석했다. 고객주의적 정치인을 가치 있게 여기는 응답자들은 중립적 정치인보다 그에 관한 부정적 성과 정보를 덜 처리했으며, 이는 동기화된 추론을 통해 나타나는 것으로 보였다.
items.title: Relational Clientelism, Information Processing, and Accountability

items.abstract: Abstract Citizens around the world have migrated under the shadow of authoritarianism, and many are increasingly acquiring political and voting rights in their host countries. Yet we know little about the content of their foreign-policy preferences or the salience with which they prioritize homeland-facing issues relative to domestic concerns. We argue that experiences of authoritarian rule prior to migration generate anti-regime sentiments among diasporas, inclining them toward hawkish foreign-policy positions toward the homeland regime. These preferences heighten the salience of homeland-facing foreign policy, even relative to highly consequential domestic issues. We test this argument with harmonized candidate-choice experiments administered to an original sample of Hong Kong diasporas in four host countries (Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the United States). We find that respondents strongly preferred candidates advocating hawkish economic and geopolitical policies against China. These foreign-policy positions were consistently prioritized over salient domestic issues such as healthcare and the economy, and this structure of preferences held across subgroups with varying degrees of host-country integration and homeland ties. Our findings provide novel experimental evidence that diasporas continue to care intensely about and voice on behalf of their homeland even after exit.
items.summary_ko: 홍콩 디아스포라가 본국의 권위주의 경험에 기반해 중국을 겨냥한 강경한 외교정책을 국내 현안보다 우선시하는지, 네 개최국의 홍콩 디아스포라를 대상으로 한 후보 선택 실험으로 검증했다. 응답자들은 대중국 강경 경제·지정학 정책을 지지했으며, 이러한 선호는 의료·경제 같은 국내 쟁점보다 일관되게 우선되었고 개최국 통합도와 본국 유대 수준에 따라 크게 달라지지 않았다.
items.title: Voice After Exit: the Prioritization of Homeland-Facing Foreign Policy Among the Hong Kong Diaspora

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Advances in digital technologies are expected to fundamentally change how organizations operate and create value. Empirical studies show that public organizations face difficulties organizing and sustaining this digital transformation. To better understand these challenges, this study examines the organizational mechanisms underlying digital transformation in a public organization over the past 20 years. Our findings show that this transformation was primarily enabled by an emergent change approach, with influential planned changes occurring only occasionally. We identify the organizational mechanisms underlying both types of change and analyze their interdependence. Our findings suggest that both emergent and planned change approaches may be needed to enable digital transformation in public organizations effectively, but that combining them is complex in practice.

Bram Klievink: Institute of Public Administration, Leiden University The Hague the Netherlands
Dorus van Loo: Institute of Public Administration, Leiden University The Hague the Netherlands
Friso Selten: Institute of Public Administration, Leiden University The Hague the Netherlands

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 한 공공조직의 20년에 걸친 디지털 전환에서 계획된 변화와 창발적 변화가 어떻게 작동하고 상호 의존하는지를 사례연구로 분석했다. 디지털 전환은 주로 창발적 변화에 의해 촉진되었고 계획된 변화는 간헐적으로 중요한 역할을 했으며, 두 접근의 결합이 필요하지만 실제로는 복잡하다는 점을 밝혔다.
items.title: Steering and Setting Free: Insights From a 20‐Year Retrospective Case Study of a Security and Justice Organization's Digital Transformation
