items.abstract: This paper assesses the practical validity of a balanced scorecard-based performance measurement system in a UAE law enforcement agency by examining how well strategic priorities translate into departmental and individual measures. Drawing on pragmatic constructivism, we conduct a single-case qualitative study using manager interviews and archival documents. We find weak translation of strategy into operational indicators and appraisal criteria, uneven awareness of performance indicators, and limited integration of facts, logic, values, and communication, which undermines system validity and strategic alignment. Effective alignment requires clearer cascades from strategy maps to operational indicators and appraisal criteria, role-appropriate access to KPIs, and cross-unit forums connecting planning and appraisal owners. The study’s primary contribution is empirical: it provides evidence of how misalignment emerges between strategy, measures, rewards, and appraisal in a public law enforcement organization. It also elaborates ‘practical validity’ as a criterion for examining how performance measurement systems function in practice.
items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 UAE 법집행기관의 균형성과표 기반 성과측정시스템이 전략적 우선순위를 부서·개인 수준의 지표와 평가기준으로 얼마나 타당하게 전환하는지 실무적 타당성 관점에서 분석했다. 관리자 인터뷰와 기록자료를 활용한 단일사례 질적 연구 결과, 전략과 운영지표·평가기준의 연계, 지표 인식, 사실·논리·가치·소통의 통합이 미흡해 시스템의 타당성과 전략적 정렬이 약화된 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Evaluating the validity of performance measurement systems in law enforcement: a pragmatic constructivism approach

items.abstract: While research highlights women leaders’ influence in traditionally feminine domains such as health, education, and welfare, less is known about their impact in traditionally masculine fields such as policing and crime reduction. Using a Regression Discontinuity design and data from Brazilian municipalities, this study shows that, compared with male mayors, women mayors are more likely to adopt municipal police forces. Municipal policing, in turn, reduces youth homicide rates under women leadership, with this effect amplified by investments in socially oriented infrastructure. These findings demonstrate that women leaders can generate broader community-wide benefits beyond direct representation of women’s interests. The study extends scholarship on gender-responsive governance and women leadership by showing how elected women can shape policy choices and their effectiveness in traditionally male-dominated domains such as policing.

Meghna Sabharwal: The University of Texas at Dallas
Sandro Cabral: Insper Institute of Education and Research, São Paulo, Brazil

items.summary_ko: 브라질 지방자치단체 자료와 회귀불연속설계를 활용해 여성 시장이 남성 시장보다 지방경찰을 도입할 가능성이 높은지, 그리고 이것이 살인 감소에 미치는 효과를 분석했다. 여성 시장 아래에서 지방경찰은 청년 살인률을 낮췄으며, 사회지향적 기반시설 투자가 클수록 그 효과가 강화되었다.
items.title: When women lead: women mayors and municipal police effectiveness in reducing homicide in Brazil

items.abstract: Across the world, elected governments are dismantling the liberal democracies they inherited. Can these democratic backsliding episodes inoculate citizens into liberal democrats vigilant against future relapses? Because scholars have yet to resolve this puzzle, we lack crucial information to gauge the prospects of democratic resilience. We develop this "democratic inoculation thesis" into a testable theory and assess its validity in the critical case of Slovakia – a backsliding democracy that previously experienced democratic erosion and is often cited as a likely case of democratic inoculation. Through a survey experiment prompting Slovak citizens to reflect on democratic backsliding in the 1990s, we assess whether these reflections heighten their vigilance over their current government and bolster their support for liberal democratic norms. We also evaluate whether factors like affective polarization and education condition democratic inoculation.
items.summary_ko: 과거의 민주주의 후퇴 경험이 시민의 향후 민주주의 후퇴에 대한 경계심과 자유민주주의 규범 지지를 높이는지, 그리고 정서적 양극화와 교육이 이를 조절하는지를 검증한다. 슬로바키아 시민을 대상으로 1990년대 민주주의 후퇴를 회상하게 하는 설문실험을 실시했으나, 초록은 주요 결과를 제시하지 않는다.
items.title: Are Citizens Inoculated by Past Democratic Backsliding?

items.abstract: In the face of property rights violation, why are some groups of people more likely to take collective actions than others? In this paper, we propose that culture is an important but not fully investigated factor accounting for this question. We examine the effect of Confucian clan culture, one of the most far-reaching traditional cultures inherited from ancient China, on collective struggle against land expropriation. We build a unique dataset combining the prefecture-level clan culture intensity and nationwide administrative litigations related to land expropriation between 2014 and 2019. Using the large cross-regional variation in the patterns of administrative litigation and a novel instrumental variable approach, this paper finds that prefectures with stronger clan culture have a significantly larger number of plaintiffs appearing in administrative lawsuit cases, implying that clan culture promotes more pervasive collective actions in confronting state power. Analysis based on individual-level survey data shows that the higher levels of trust between relatives and neighbors and stronger willingness for self-interest-related participation accompanied by stronger Confucian clan culture are the main mechanisms. Our findings underscore the pivotal role of cultural factors in shaping social stability and influencing local governance.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 중국의 토지수용에 대한 집단행동에서 유교적 종족문화가 어떤 영향을 미치는지 분석하기 위해, 지역별 종족문화 강도와 2014~2019년 토지수용 관련 행정소송 자료를 결합하고 도구변수 접근을 활용했다. 종족문화가 강한 지역일수록 행정소송 원고 수가 유의하게 많았으며, 친족·이웃 간 신뢰와 자기이익 관련 참여 의향이 주요 기제로 제시되었다.
items.title: Culture Holds us Together: Confucian Clan Culture and Collective Actions in China’s Land Expropriation

items.abstract: Abstract Important studies have suggested that politicians become more liberal by having daughters, but more recent work has been unable to replicate this result. It is therefore essential to further clarify how politicians’ family situations affect their policy making in different contexts, and in particular when it comes to gender-related policies. We provide a unique test based on prospective data collection on Swedish politicians based on a pre-analysis plan strictly followed in all analyses and tests. Data is collected in two surveys implemented after the 2022 general parliamentary election in Sweden on members of parliament and candidates in the parliamentary election (n=1,147 complete responders are included in our analyses). In our primary hypotheses, we test whether having daughters is associated with more left-leaning political preferences, a stronger preference for female-favoring policies, and a weaker preference for male-favoring policies. We find no evidence of an effect on left-leaning political preferences or female-favoring policies. These results do not support the original work on this topic but are in line with the more recent null results. We also find suggestive evidence (p<0.05) that having daughters is associated with a weaker preference for male-favoring policies. As the effects of having daughters on male-favoring policies have not been explored earlier, this opens up an interesting avenue to investigate in future studies.
items.summary_ko: 스웨덴 정치인과 총선 후보자를 대상으로, 딸의 유무가 정치적 성향과 성별 관련 정책 선호에 영향을 미치는지 사전등록 설문으로 검증했다. 딸이 있는 경우 좌파 성향이나 여성 우대 정책 선호가 더 강하다는 증거는 없었지만, 남성 우대 정책 선호가 약할 가능성은 시사되었다.
items.title: Daughters and Political Preferences of Politicians: A Preregistered Prospective Study on Swedish Politicians

items.abstract: Abstract Due to the growing importance of diasporas in contemporary geopolitics, many states seek to cultivate diasporic attachment and encourage diaspora mobilization using strategic narratives. Are such appeals effective? We report results from a pre-registered two-wave survey experiment conducted among Jewish Americans before and during the Israel-Hamas war. Our intervention assesses the impact of three common appeals identified by prior work: threats to the homeland, shared historical memory, and discrimination in the diaspora’s country of residence. We find that none of these appeals influenced Jewish-Americans’ attachment to, support for, or intent to mobilize for Israel, even during a war in the “homeland.” Instead, baseline differences in these outcomes reflect deep-seated generational, denominational, and partisan cleavages within the Jewish American community. These findings suggest that intra-diaspora fragmentation and long-standing views of the “homeland” might dominate short-term rhetorical interventions. Consequently, strategic frames deployed by kin states and political animators may be less effective on diaspora audiences than intended.
items.summary_ko: 이스라엘을 조국으로 여기는 유대계 미국인을 대상으로, 조국에 대한 위협·공유된 역사 기억·거주국 내 차별을 강조하는 호소가 조국 애착과 이스라엘 지지 및 동원 의향에 미치는 영향을 전쟁 전후 사전등록 2파 패널 설문실험으로 검증했다. 세 호소 모두 해당 태도에 유의한 영향을 미치지 않았으며, 결과의 기저에는 세대·교파·정당 성향에 따른 공동체 내부의 장기적 분열이 반영되었다.
items.title: Do Appeals to the Diaspora Affect their Attachment to the Homeland? Findings from Jewish-Americans before and during the Israel-Hamas War

items.abstract: Abstract Although negativity bias is widely documented in political psychology, evidence is far more mixed when it comes to voters' preferences for social policy reform, particularly when they are confronted with trade‐offs between personal and societal outcomes. Building on existing theories of political communication, this article examines how voters evaluate policy reforms when considering realistic information about potential losses and gains. Empirically, we analyze a simu‐survey experiment examining how voters update their reform preferences in response to information derived from microsimulation modeling about the predicted effects of policy reform on their pocketbook and on the poverty level. The results show that negative information weighs more heavily than positive information in shaping reform preferences at both the egotropic and sociotropic levels. In the case of competing information, the effects are asymmetric: Positive pocketbook information tends to be neutralized by negative poverty information, whereas negative pocketbook information outweighs positive poverty information. However, egotropic negativity bias is most pronounced for smaller pocketbook losses, which are more likely to violate voters' prior expectations than larger losses. Consistent with this pattern, expectation violations—rather than differences in recall of, or trust in, information—seems the primary mechanism underlying negativity bias in policy preferences.

Elise Aerts: Centre for Social Policy University of Antwerp Antwerp Belgium
Tijs Laenen: Centre for Social Policy University of Antwerp Antwerp Belgium
Media, Movements & Politics University of Antwerp Antwerp Belgium

items.summary_ko: 유권자가 개인적 손익과 사회적 빈곤 수준에 관한 모의실험 정보를 바탕으로 사회정책 개혁 선호를 어떻게 갱신하는지 설문 실험으로 분석했다. 부정적 정보가 긍정적 정보보다 개혁 선호에 더 큰 영향을 미쳤으며, 상충하는 정보에서는 개인적 손실이 사회적 개선보다, 사회적 악화가 개인적 이익보다 강하게 작용했고, 주요 기제는 정보 회상이나 신뢰보다 기대 위반으로 나타났다.
items.title: Egotropic and sociotropic negativity bias in social policy reform preferences

items.abstract: Democratic accountability assumes that the citizens who bear the costs of government decisions can sanction the officials who make them. We identify a structural break in this assumption. When a city funds itself through taxes that fall partly on nonresidents (highway travelers, commuters, and regional shoppers who cannot vote in local elections) the electoral link between bearing costs and imposing sanctions weakens. Analyzing two decades of Texas municipal data (2000–2019) with two-way fixed effects and generalized synthetic control methods, we find that cities better positioned to shift costs onto nonvoters raise resident fiscal exposure more, after they adopt dedicated local sales taxes. This pattern is strongest for cities on or near major metropolitan areas and highways, whereas geographically isolated cities, where residents bear nearly all costs, show little change. It reverses the relief that classical tax-exportation theory predicts and reveals an accountability gap that funds discretionary fiscal expansion. The gap proves temporary: fiscal outcomes across contexts converge within six to thirteen years. Geography, we conclude, shapes democratic accountability as powerfully as electoral rules.
items.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
items.summary_ko: 비거주자에게 일부 세금을 전가할 수 있는 지리적 조건이 지방정부의 재정 의사결정에 대한 주민의 선거적 제재를 약화시키는지, 텍사스 지방정부 자료(2000~2019)의 이원 고정효과와 일반화 합성통제 분석으로 검토했다. 전용 지방판매세 도입 후 비용을 비유권자에게 전가하기 쉬운 도시는 주민의 재정 부담을 더 크게 늘렸으며, 이 격차는 6~13년 내 수렴했다.
items.title: When Geography Dilutes Accountability: Managerial Discretion and Fiscal Expansion in Local Government

items.abstract: This study aims to address a core theoretical and practical question: Under the dual constraints of institutional limitations and resource scarcity, how does the Communist Youth League, as a mass organization, actively produce service spaces to fulfill its service functions? To explore this question, our analysis integrates Lefebvre’s theory of space production with the institutional logics perspective to construct an analytical framework of “institutional logics–empowerment structure–organizational space production.” Through a case analysis of the “Youth Homeland” project in City G, this study finds that the Communist Youth League is not passively constrained by institutional environments and resource limitations. Instead, it proactively leverages its “structural hole” advantage at the intersection of multiple institutional logics—political, social, and professional—by employing a combined strategy of administrative empowerment, social empowerment, and technological empowerment to secure critical resources for the production of service spaces. Among these, administrative empowerment defines the core boundaries and legitimacy of service spaces, social empowerment expands their peripheral boundaries and resource networks, and technological empowerment reshapes the processes and effectiveness of service delivery. The investigation further reveals that institutional logics determine the empowerment structure, the integration of institutional factors opens windows of opportunity for space production, and institutional changes drive the transformation and restructuring of service spaces. The article’s theoretical contribution lies in expanding the study of organizational space production from an internal material analysis to an external social field perspective. It introduces “institution,” “agency,” and “co-production” into organizational space research, uncovering the micro-mechanisms through which mass organizations strategically employ empowerment to expand their action spaces by leveraging institutional logics in an authoritarian context. This offers a new analytical perspective for understanding the service functions and transformation of mass organizations and similar institutions in contemporary China.

Shuchao Yang: Guangdong University of Finance and Economics, China
Ziyi Yang: Finance School of Renmin University of China, Beijing, China

items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 제도적 제약과 자원 부족 속에서 공산주의청년단이 어떻게 서비스 공간을 적극적으로 생산하는지 밝히기 위해 르페브르의 공간생산론과 제도 논리 관점을 결합해 중국 G시 ‘청년의 집’ 프로젝트를 사례 분석했다. 분석 결과, 청년단은 정치·사회·전문 제도가 교차하는 구조적 공백을 활용하고 행정적·사회적·기술적 권한부여를 결합해 서비스 공간의 경계와 자원 네트워크, 전달 과정과 효과를 형성했으며, 제도 논리가 권한부여 구조를 규정하고 제도 변화가 공간의 전환과 재구성을 이끌었다.
items.title: Institutional Logics, Empowerment Structures, and the Service Space Production of the Communist Youth League—A Case Study of the “Youth Homeland” Project in City G

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Our paper builds a bridge between the emerging strand of research on public administration under populist rule and the established literature on delegation to independent regulatory authorities (IRAs). We focus on Italy, a critical case in Western Europe, which between 2001 and 2025 experienced six coalition governments dominated or strongly influenced by populist parties of different ideological orientations. Findings highlight that delegation to IRAs is remarkably resilient once institutionalized, even under sustained political contestation. Despite repeated populist participation in government since the early 2000s, Italian IRAs have not been subject to systematic de‐delegation or statutory retrenchment. However, the preservation of formal independence has not implied the absence of means for political control. Our analysis shows that populist governments have systematically relied on political appointments. Interestingly, political appointments have not been driven by partisan loyalty or overt politicization. Instead, the intervention of populist parties has operated along a different dimension of political control that has received less attention in delegation theory: the specialization of appointees. Populist governments have displayed a preference for appointing IRAs' board members with lower levels of domain‐specific specialization, privileging generalist profiles over specialists.

Alessandro Natalini: LUMSA University of Rome Rome Italy
Giulio Francisci: LUMSA University of Rome Rome Italy

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 이탈리아에서 포퓰리즘 정당이 정부에 참여한 시기에도 독립규제기관에 대한 위임이 유지되었는지, 그리고 정치적 통제가 어떻게 이루어졌는지를 분석한다. 2001~2025년의 사례 분석 결과, 공식적 독립성이나 법적 위임의 체계적 축소는 없었지만 포퓰리즘 정부는 전문성보다 일반ist적 성향을 지닌 이사회 인사를 임명하는 방식으로 정치적 통제를 행사했다.
items.title: Regulatory Agencies Under Mutating Populism in Office: Insights From Italy (1990–2025)

items.abstract: Abstract Predictive algorithms are increasingly used to support frontline decision-making in public administration, but evidence remains limited on how they affect bureaucratic capacity. This study examines county-level adoption of predictive screening tools in U.S. Child Protective Services using NCANDS data (2010–2023) and a stacked difference-in-differences design. Leveraging staggered adoption, I find no change in the total number of investigations opened and a sizable decline (about 15%) in the share of investigations that are substantiated. These results are inconsistent with operational capacity gains and more consistent with misclassification that erodes analytical capacity. These findings are consistent with a mechanism of routinized deference: under workload and accountability pressures, algorithmic recommendations can become procedurally defensible defaults. Overall, this study argues that predictive screening is not capacity-enhancing by default, as routinized deference can undermine the professional judgment central to bureaucratic work.

Jiaen Wu: Indiana University-Bloomington O’Neill School of Public and Environmental Affairs, , 1315 East Tenth Street, Bloomington, IN 47405,

items.journal: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
items.summary_ko: 미국 아동보호서비스에서 예측적 선별 도구의 도입이 관료적 역량에 미치는 영향을 NCANDS 자료(2010~2023년)와 시차적 도입을 활용한 누적 이중차분으로 분석했다. 조사 개시 건수는 변하지 않았지만 조사 중 substantiated 비율이 약 15% 감소해, 역량 향상보다는 업무·책임성 압박 속 ‘절차화된 순응’과 분류 오류가 전문적 판단을 약화시키는 결과와 일치했다.
items.title: Routinized Deference: Predictive Screening and Bureaucratic Capacity in Child Protective Services

items.abstract: Do people believe that others in their community prefer male to female political candidates? To what extent is that perceived bias actually misperceived , and who do people view as the most biased? Perceived gender norms often diverge from actual levels of support for gender equality globally, particularly among men. These (mis)perceptions, often stemming from pluralistic ignorance, may undermine women’s political ambition and access to political power. In a nationally representative survey of Moroccans, we embed a conjoint experiment that asks respondents to identify not only the candidates they personally prefer but also the candidates they perceive male and female voters as preferring. We find no evidence of pro-male bias in respondents’ own preferences. We do find that respondents perceive that men are biased in favor of men and that women are biased in favor of women. We also find that men express greater personal bias against female candidates when they are primed to think first about others’ preferences.
items.summary_ko: 모로코 전국 대표 설문에 후보자 선호와 남녀 유권자의 선호에 대한 인식을 묻는 컨조인트 실험을 결합해, 사람들이 여성 후보에 대한 타인의 성 편향을 어떻게 인식하는지 분석했다. 응답자의 개인적 선호에서는 남성 편향이 나타나지 않았지만, 남성은 남성 후보를, 여성은 여성 후보를 선호한다고 인식했으며, 타인의 선호를 먼저 생각하게 한 남성은 여성 후보에 대한 개인적 편향을 더 크게 드러냈다.
items.title: Misperceptions of Male Bias Against Female Candidates: An Obstacle to Women’s Political Representation?

items.abstract: Abstract This article examines the relationship between peacemaking, reconciliation, and brutalization in violent conflicts. It argues that these processes are deeply interconnected: effective peacemaking and reconciliation can interrupt or reverse brutalization, whereas unsuccessful or incomplete peacemaking may allow brutalization to persist, deepen, and become normalized, even alongside formal reconciliation initiatives. This article is organized into two parts. The first one reviews the scholarly literature on peacemaking, reconciliation, and brutalization. It examines each process separately. Then proposes an analytical model that explains the emergence, escalation, and persistence of brutalization. Finally, it conceptualizes its relationship with peacemaking and reconciliation. The second part applies this model to the Israeli–Palestinian conflict, focusing on Israeli Jewish society in its confrontation with Palestinians in the Gaza Strip. This case study serves to illustrate the model and assess its explanatory value. Beyond examining peacemaking and reconciliation, the article's primary objective is to develop a comprehensive conceptualization of brutalization by defining its nature, identifying its underlying psychological and social mechanisms, and analyzing its antecedents and consequences for collective cognition, emotions, behavior, and norms.

Daniel Bar‐Tal: School of Education Tel Aviv University Tel Aviv Israel

items.summary_ko: 이 글은 폭력적 갈등에서 평화조성·화해와 잔혹화가 어떻게 상호연결되는지, 그리고 잔혹화의 심리적·사회적 기제와 결과가 무엇인지 검토한다. 문헌 검토를 바탕으로 개념적 모형을 제시하고 이스라엘–팔레스타인 갈등, 특히 가자지구 팔레스타인과 대립하는 이스라엘 유대 사회에 적용한 결과, 효과적인 평화조성과 화해는 잔혹화를 중단·역전시킬 수 있지만 불완전한 과정은 잔혹화의 지속·심화·정상화를 허용할 수 있다고 주장한다.
items.title: Between reconciliation and peace making and brutalization: The Israeli case

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Data from 115 interviews conducted with officials in the Westminster systems of Australia, New Zealand, and the United Kingdom is used to substantiate a corrosive relationship between institutional amnesia and the ability of public servants to make sense of their organizational context. A process in which public servants question why the policies, procedures, and organizational frameworks that surround them is proposed as one medium through which this relationship operates. Four problematic effects produced by this relationship and process are subsequently analyzed: (1) public servants following but not understanding procedures, (2) inexplicable organizational aspects getting abandoned, (3) the layering of new organizational features on top of old ones, creating complexity, and (4) public service inefficiencies and associated public servant frustration. The article concludes with the implications of this important relationship for public administration scholars and practitioners.

Alastair Stark: School of Political Science and International Studies University of Queensland, St Lucia Campus Brisbane Australia
Dennis C. Grube: Department of Politics and International Relations University of Cambridge Cambridge UK
Heather Lovell: University of Tasmania School of Geography, Planning, and Spatial Sciences, Sandy Bay Campus Tasmania Australia
Hridesh Gajural: School of Regulation and Global Governance Australian National University Canberra Australia
Jack Corbett: School of Social Sciences Monash University Victoria Australia
Rodney J. Scott: School of Law RMIT Melbourne Australia

items.summary_ko: 호주·뉴질랜드·영국의 웨스트민스터 체제 공무원 115명 인터뷰를 통해, 제도적 기억상실이 조직 맥락을 이해하는 능력을 약화시키는 과정을 분석했다. 공무원들이 정책·절차·조직 틀의 이유를 묻는 과정과 관련해 절차의 무이해적 준수, 조직 요소의 폐기, 복잡성 누적, 비효율과 좌절이 나타난다는 점을 밝혔다.
items.title: Institutional Amnesia and the Loss of “The Why Rationale” in Central Government Agencies

items.abstract: In disaster information services, citizen- and volunteer-generated information arrives as dispersed, uncertain reports rather than usable response information. This qualitative case study examines how Organization Z, a Chinese NGO functioning as an Information Coordination Organization (ICO), makes such information usable for response through sub-micro infrastructures. Data comprise 43 volunteer and 11 coordinator interviews, longitudinal participant observation, and multi-source materials. Four mechanisms emerged: emotional activation makes participation visible; epistemic calibration supports report credibility through traceability and comparability; cross-sector translation makes verified information interpretable and acceptable as a basis for response action; and reflexive learning makes response experience partially reusable. We conceptualize staging as a conditional account of public value formation organized around the four thresholds of visibility, credibility, legitimate actionability, and partial reusability. The study contributes to public value co-creation research by explaining how ICO information work conditions whether information-related participation contributes to disaster response and public value formation.
items.summary_ko: 중국 재난정보 서비스에서 정보조정조직(ICO)인 NGO가 시민·자원봉사자 생성 정보를 대응에 활용 가능한 정보로 전환하는 과정을 질적 사례연구로 분석했다. 정서적 활성화, 인식론적 보정, 부문 간 번역, 성찰적 학습이라는 네 메커니즘이 각각 가시성·신뢰성·정당한 실행가능성·부분적 재사용성의 문턱을 형성하며 공공가치 공동창출을 조건화하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Staging the invisible: tracing public value co-creation through sub-micro infrastructures configured by information coordination organizations in China’s disaster information services

items.abstract: This study examines the causal conditions shaping collaborative effectiveness in the regeneration of marginalized urban communities. Using fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis of 22 Chinese cases, it identifies facilitative leadership as a necessary condition for achieving high collaborative effectiveness and weak institutionalization as a necessary condition for low effectiveness. The sufficiency analysis reveals three distinct pathways to effective collaboration and three to ineffective collaboration. The findings show that collaborative effectiveness depends on context-specific configurations of resource support, institutionalization, governance structure, and facilitative leadership. No single condition is sufficient in isolation; rather, effectiveness emerges through complementarity, functional equivalence, and asymmetric substitutability among conditions. The study contributes to a more context-sensitive and configurational understanding of collaborative governance.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 도시 취약社区 재생에서 협력 효과성을 형성하는 조건과 그 결합을 규명하기 위해 중국 22개 사례에 퍼지셋 질적비교분석을 적용했다. 촉진적 리더십은 높은 효과성의 필요조건이고 약한 제도화는 낮은 효과성의 필요조건이며, 자원 지원·제도화·거버넌스 구조·촉진적 리더십의 맥락별 구성에 따라 효과적·비효과적 협력의 여러 경로가 나타났다.
items.title: Unpacking the causal complexity of collaborative effectiveness in urban marginalized community regeneration: a fuzzy-set configurational analysis

items.abstract: As public service delivery increasingly involves non-governmental actors, public administration theory needs to examine how its core frameworks operate beyond traditional bureaucracies. This study extends representative bureaucracy theory to private philanthropy, an increasingly crucial actor in local public service delivery, by testing whether racial representation in leadership corresponds with equitable grantmaking outcomes. Analyzing longitudinal data from 912 U.S. community foundations between 2012 and 2016, this study finds that racial representation in foundation leadership corresponds with increased grantmaking to organizations serving communities of color when leadership retains sufficient discretion, but that this relationship weakens as donor control rises, particularly through donor advised funds. These patterns are consistent with representative bureaucracy theory's emphasis on discretion as a key mechanism linking passive and active representation. These findings advance theoretical understanding by illuminating the interplay between representation and discretion within private philanthropy, while carrying implications for equitable resource distribution as public services increasingly involve non-governmental actors.
items.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
items.summary_ko: 민간 자선 영역에서 재단 리더십의 인종적 대표성이 재량 및 기부자 통제와 결합해 지역사회 색채가 강한 조직에 대한 보조금 배분에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 검토했다. 2012~2016년 미국 지역사회재단 912곳의 종단자료를 분석한 결과, 리더십의 인종적 대표성은 재단의 재량이 충분할 때 유색인종 지역사회 지원 조직에 대한 보조금 증가와 관련되지만, 특히 기부자 조언 기금 등을 통한 기부자 통제가 강해질수록 이 관계가 약화됐다.
items.title: Representative Bureaucracy in Private Philanthropy: Testing Discretion and Racial Representation in Community Foundation Grantmaking

items.abstract: Public sector organizations face persistent challenges in retaining a diverse workforce, as systemic barriers continue to shape the experiences of female and minority employees. This study examines how workplace practices – specifically, organizational justice, management support, and leadership representation – are associated with turnover intention in public sector agencies. Using survey data from 1,572 procurement professionals in the United States, we assess both overall effects and subgroup differences. Results show that management support is associated with turnover intention across all groups, and organizational justice is associated with lower turnover intention among female and minority employees. In contrast, diversity and representation alone do not reduce turnover intention and, in some cases, are associated with higher turnover intention among minority employees. These findings suggest that representation without fair and supportive organizational systems is insufficient for retention. The study offers practical recommendations for public managers and contributes to ongoing theoretical discourse in public administration and human resource management.
items.summary_ko: 미국 공공부문 조달 전문가 1,572명의 설문자료를 활용해 조직공정성, 관리지원, 리더십 대표성이 이직의도와 전체 및 집단별로 어떻게 관련되는지 분석했다. 관리지원은 모든 집단에서 이직의도와 관련되었고, 조직공정성은 여성 및 소수집단 직원의 이직의도 감소와 관련되었지만, 다양성과 대표성만으로는 이직의도를 낮추지 못했으며 일부 소수집단에서는 오히려 높은 이직의도와 관련되었다.
items.title: One size does not fit all: management strategies to reduce turnover intention among public sector employees

items.abstract: This article reconsiders the relationship between the globalization of political liberalism and the globalization of political equality. Departing from interpretations of liberal theories of rights and representation as egalitarian or democratic, the article reconstructs an elitist paradigm of liberal representative government from the colonial world. It does so by offering a new reading of the thought of Indian political leader Dadabhai Naoroji. It recovers Naoroji’s overlooked commentary on political representation and imperial reform. I show that Naoroji drew upon analyses made by the first generation of Indian liberal thinkers about imperial political economy and mass-elite relations and used these arguments to formulate a distinctive model of electoral politics as a form of hierarchical tutelage. The recovery of Naoroji’s theory illustrates the deep tensions between representation and mass politics that marked liberalism’s global circulation.
items.summary_ko: 이 글은 정치적 자유주의의 세계화와 정치적 평등의 관계를 어떻게 이해해야 하는지 묻고, 인도 정치 지도자 다다바이 나오로지의 사상과 제국 개혁·정치대표에 관한 간과된 논평을 재구성한다. 나오로지가 선대 인도 자유주의자들의 제국 정치경제 및 대중-엘리트 관계 분석을 바탕으로 선거정치를 위계적 후견의 형태로 구상했음을 보이며, 자유주의의 세계적 확산에 대표와 대중정치 사이의 긴장이 내재했음을 논증한다.
items.title: On Liberalism’s Global Career: Dadabhai Naoroji and Representative Government

items.abstract: The article replies to Nicholas Vrousalis’s attempt to rescue radical republicanism from my critique that it fails on three counts: its non-contingency, domination, and structural injustice theses. Central to my response are the claims that (i) capitalist power cannot be reduced to legal ownership of the means of production, as the process of capitalization is constitutive of capital; (ii) neither neo-republican nor Kantian notions of domination adequately capture what is inherently wrong with capitalism, and (iii) the concept of “class domination” remains theoretically puzzling. I then defend an alienation-centered critique: capitalism’s mode of investment subjects citizens to an impersonal and anarchical form of governance, which, by being necessarily alienating, contradicts democratic self-determination. Overall, this critique forms the core of a “political, political theory of capitalism” and grounds the case for a specific kind of democratic socialism—socialism as reconciliation—which is more demanding than both republican and liberal socialisms.
items.summary_ko: 이 글은 자본주의에 대한 급진적 공화주의의 구제 시도에 응답하며, 자본주의 권력을 법적 소유만으로 환원할 수 없고 공화주의·칸트주의의 지배 개념과 ‘계급 지배’가 자본주의의 본질적 문제를 충분히 포착하지 못한다고 주장한다. 대신 자본주의적 투자의 방식이 시민을 비인격적·무정부적 통치에 종속시켜 민주적 자기결정과 충돌한다는 소외 중심 비판을 제시하고, 이를 ‘화해로서의 사회주의’라는 민주적 사회주의의 근거로 옹호한다.
items.title: The Ambiguities of Ownership and Class: A Reply to Nicholas Vrousalis

items.abstract: Abstract Effective administration of public organizations requires timely responses to emerging risks, yet communicating those risks up the hierarchy can expose operational managers to blame in politicized accountability environments. This study examines how public managers navigated that tension in an analysis of 130 risk reports filed over a seven-year period associated with two major procurement and maintenance projects in the Danish Defence. Using an abductive qualitative approach, we develop a dynamic model of risk management with four phases: (1) risk as an operational concern, (2) turning risk into an organizational problem, (3) assigning blame and accountability, and (4) initiating mitigation and response. We find that risk and accountability communication are interdependent processes rather than independent sequential processes. Operational managers attempt to raise awareness of emerging risks while simultaneously deflecting potential blame and catering to higher-level concerns about public scrutiny. This tension generates pressure to only report when it is absolutely necessary, while higher-level managers often postpone action to avoid political exposure. These practices contribute to delays, projects not meeting specifications, and significant budget overruns. The study advances a dynamic theory of public sector risk management and explains how hierarchical communication practices influence whether, when, and how emerging risks are addressed.

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 정치화된 책무성 환경에서 공공관리자가 위험을 상급자에게 보고하면서 비난과 정치적 노출을 어떻게 회피하는지 분석했다. 덴마크 국방의 두 주요 조달·유지보수 사업에서 7년간 제출된 위험보고서 130건을 귀납적으로 분석한 결과, 위험 커뮤니케이션과 책무성 커뮤니케이션은 독립적인 순차 과정이 아니라 상호의존적이며, 보고와 대응의 지연이 사업의 사양 미충족과 예산 초과로 이어지는 동태적 위험관리 모형을 제시했다.
items.title: Balancing risk communication and accountability concerns in risk management: A study of major public project investments

items.abstract: Abstract Compensatory control theory suggests that threats to personal control increase the desire for external control. Yet, despite the growing salience of global economic instability—amplified by trade conflicts, protectionist policies, and heightened geopolitical tensions—empirical research has rarely examined this dynamic in the context of economic threats. Moreover, the direct psychological consequences of endorsing external control—whether it ultimately enhances or diminishes personal control—remain largely unexplored. Addressing both gaps, the present research focuses on the socio‐political context of China to investigate whether individuals facing economic threats and diminished personal control show increased preference for government control, a particularly powerful and salient external source of control in Chinese society. Across studies, the results showed a positive relationship between perceived economic threats and preference for government control, mediated by a reduction in personal control (Studies 1–3). Furthermore, we found that endorsement of government control helped enhance, rather than undermine, personal control (Studies 4 and 5). These findings suggest that government control serves as a compensatory source of control in response to economic threats.

items.summary_ko: 중국의 경제적 위협과 개인 통제감 저하가 정부 통제 선호를 높이는지, 그리고 이러한 선호가 개인 통제감을 어떻게 변화시키는지를 여러 연구로 검증했다. 경제적 위협은 개인 통제감 감소를 매개로 정부 통제 선호를 높였으며, 정부 통제의 수용은 개인 통제감을 약화시키기보다 강화했다.
items.title: A secondary bond: Why economic threats boost compensatory preference for government control in China

items.abstract: Empathy is an underexplored phenomenon in policymaking that can shape how policies are designed and implemented. This study investigates the role of empathy in policy work through interviews with 22 Australian public servants occupying diverse policy-focused roles. Using an abductive approach, this study identifies three primary areas of empathy application by public servants: understanding citizens’ lived experiences to inform policy design; navigating interpersonal dynamics within and across agencies; and challenging assumptions and embedded worldviews. Findings suggest that empathy functions as a sensemaking resource, helping public servants interpret information in complex and ambiguous policy contexts.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 공무원들이 정책 업무에서 공감이 어떻게 이해되고 활용되는지를 호주 공무원 22명과의 인터뷰 및 귀납적 추론을 통해 탐색했다. 공감은 시민의 삶의 경험을 정책 설계에 반영하고, 기관 내·기관 간 관계를 조정하며, 가정과 고착된 세계관에 도전하게 하는 감각형성 자원으로 나타났다.
items.title: Mapping empathy in policy work: how public servants understand and use it

items.abstract: This paper examines how public service motivation (PSM) shapes public value creation (PVC) within publicly funded entrepreneurial support organizations (ESOs). As public service ecosystems, ESOs play a pivotal role in entrepreneurial ecosystems (EEs), yet how they create public value remains underexplored. While existing research emphasizes PSM at the individual level, less is known about how PSM translates into intentional PVC in boundary-spanning ecosystem contexts. Drawing on an empirical qualitative multi-case study, we show that although ESO staff exhibit a strong commitment to enhancing the public interest, regional-level PVC is constrained by unclear and narrow organizational goals, inconsistent practices, and limited leadership support. Our findings highlight the need for leadership grounded in transformative, supportive, and human-centred practices, as well as leadership collaboration spanning organizational boundaries. This paper clarifies the organizational conditions under which PSM contributes to PVC in hybrid governance settings.

items.title: Lack of public service motivation as a value-constraining mechanism in entrepreneurial ecosystems

items.abstract: Local police officers are among the most prominent frontline public servants, interacting daily with people, communities, and other agencies and stakeholders. They are, in the most literal sense, street-level bureaucrats. These interactions were greatly tested in the summer of 2020. Police managed – or in some cases refused to manage – enforcement orders for a global pandemic while at the same time policing in the aftermath of the murder of George Floyd. This article explores how officers in three local jurisdictions navigated these dual, compounding crises – which we can certainly expect many more of in the future – and the implications for police interactions, discretion (including de-policing) and job satisfaction. The article concludes with a discussion of how police leaders, local officials and community advocates can better support law enforcement professionals during times of crises.

items.title: 'We are no longer Allowed to be Human': Officers’ Experiences Policing the Compounding Crises of the COVID-19 Pandemic and Civil Unrest in the United States

items.abstract: Government workers often take shortcuts when making decisions about delivering public services. When these shortcuts are influenced by stereotypes or bias, citizens may receive unequal treatment. This research examines whether bureaucrats in U.S. housing authorities and parks departments discriminate based on citizen political ideology. Using a pre-registered 2 × 3 email audit experiment ( n = 974), we test whether responsiveness varies when citizens signal conservative views, liberal views, or no political views. The results show that street-level bureaucrats are more likely to respond to citizens signaling conservative views than to citizens with no stated political views. Responsiveness does not differ between citizens signaling liberal views and citizens with no stated political views. However, when a reply is provided, citizens signaling liberal views receive more helpful responses. Interaction models suggest that responsiveness to citizens signaling liberal views differs across public housing authorities and parks departments. These findings suggest that political ideology may shape bureaucratic responsiveness in ways that have implications for fairness in public service delivery.

items.summary_ko: 미국 주택당국과 공원 부서의 관료가 시민이 보수·진보 성향을 표시했는지에 따라 다르게 응답하는지 사전등록된 2×3 이메일 감사실험(n=974)으로 검증했다. 보수 성향을 표시한 시민은 정치적 견해를 밝히지 않은 시민보다 응답을 받을 가능성이 높았고, 진보 성향 시민은 응답 가능성은 차이가 없었지만 응답을 받으면 더 유용한 답변을 받았으며, 진보 성향에 대한 반응성은 기관 유형에 따라 달랐다.
items.title: Does Citizen Political Ideology Shape Bureaucratic Responsiveness? Evidence From an Audit Experiment

items.abstract: Public participation is widely recognized as an important component of democratic governance, yet empirical studies often evaluate participation by the methods employed rather than the institutional structures through which participation is organized within administrative processes. Drawing on an analysis of 289 local jurisdictions receiving federal block grants, this study examines participation as structured administrative practice rather than simply a collection of engagement methods. Using inductive analysis of Consolidated Plans, the study develops a typology of four participation structures: Minimal Compliance, Structured Consultation, Institutionalized Consultation, and Embedded Participation.

items.title: Public Participation as Administrative Practice: Evidence from Federal Entitlement Communities

items.abstract: Why do formally mandated anti-corruption institutions fail in contexts of entrenched political patronage? This study addresses that question through an embedded case study of the Anti-Corruption Establishment of Sindh, Pakistan, combining the document analysis, case-file examination, enforcement statistics from 2015 to 2023, and interviews with twelve retired officials. Three contributions emerge: process-level evidence of how subnational institutions are operationally hollowed out rather than merely underperforming on aggregate indices; demonstration of how political interference, capacity deficits, legal loopholes, and neglect of preventive functions interact as a compounding failure ecosystem; and extension of institutional theory to subnational governance in federal developing states, offering transferable lessons where elite capture constraints accountability reform. The findings confirm that patronage networks convert formally mandated anti-corruption institutions into ritualistic procedure rather than substantive restraint, with accountability outcomes systematically conditioned by political affiliation rather than evidentiary merit.
items.summary_ko: 파키스탄 신드주의 반부패기구가 정치적 후견주의가 고착된 환경에서 왜 실질적 책임성을 확보하지 못하는지를 문서·사건기록 분석, 2015~2023년 집행 통계, 퇴직 공무원 12명 인터뷰를 결합한 내재적 사례연구로 분석했다. 정치적 개입, 역량 부족, 법적 loophole, 예방 기능의 방치가 상호 증폭되어 기구를 형식적 절차로 전락시키고, 책임성 결과가 증거보다 정치적 소속에 좌우된다는 점을 보였다.
items.title: Building Integrity in the Global South: Lessons from Pakistan’s Struggle Against Public Sector Corruption

items.abstract: Abstract Does rapid and large-scale migration fuel nationalism? Using administrative and panel survey data from Chile, we show that sudden, large-scale migration inflows increase identity-based nationalistic attitudes, such as national pride, among native-born citizens. These “immigration shocks” appear to activate perceptions of identity threat, leading to stronger expressions of national pride and belonging. Supplementary evidence from surveys, media reports, social media, and crime records suggests that this nationalism is predominantly exclusionary: areas most affected by migration also experienced spikes in anti-migrant rhetoric, hate crimes, and support for a newly formed far-right party. These findings underscore how rapid demographic changes can reshape political attitudes and contribute to the rise of exclusionary forms of national identity.
items.summary_ko: 칠레의 행정자료와 패널 설문자료를 활용해 급격하고 대규모인 이민 유입이 내국인의 정체성 기반 민족주의 태도에 미치는 영향을 분석했다. 이민 충격은 국가적 자부심과 소속감, 반이민 수사·증오범죄·극우 정당 지지의 증가와 연관되어, 배제적 민족주의를 강화하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Immigration and Nationalistic Attitudes: Panel Evidence from Chile

items.abstract: Abstract The success of dominance‐oriented leaders often evokes surprise and dismay. We offer a psychological explanation beyond partisan reasoning, positing a systematic tendency among liberals to underestimate the appeal and efficacy of such leaders compared with conservatives. Drawing on moral foundations theory, we propose that liberals' heightened emphasis on harm avoidance and fairness explains their reduced liking for dominance‐oriented leaders, and that this reduced likability helps explain why they underestimate these leaders' prospects of success more than conservatives do. We test our predictions across multiple studies, including both political and organizational contexts, demonstrating that political liberals consistently perceive dominance‐oriented leaders as less likely to succeed than conservatives do—even when the leader's political affiliation is irrelevant, unknown, or aligned with their own. We conclude our investigation by suggesting that these diminished expectations from liberals might paradoxically enhance the success trajectories of dominant leaders.

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 자유주의자들이 지배지향적 지도자의 매력과 성공 가능성을 보수주의자들보다 과소평가하는지, 그리고 도덕적 기반과 호감도가 이를 설명하는지를 정치·조직 맥락의 여러 연구로 검증했다. 자유주의자들은 지도자의 정치적 소속이 무관하거나 알려지지 않았거나 자신들과 일치할 때에도 지배지향적 지도자의 성공 가능성을 일관되게 낮게 인식했으며, 낮은 호감도가 이러한 차이를 설명했다.
items.title: A blind spot for dominance? Why liberals underestimate dominant leaders more than conservatives

items.abstract: Abstract In this review, we synthesize evidence to argue that climate change and conflict are mutually reinforcing. We first examine conflict as a barrier to mitigation, focusing on four faultlines that slow climate action: (a) ideological polarization, (b) “elite versus ordinary people” narratives, (c) intranational, place‐based conflicts, and (d) international disputes. The consequence of these conflicts is worsening climate change, which in turn increases the prevalence of factors known to be conflict amplifiers: heat stress, economic stress, widening inequality, and forced displacement. Our analysis points to the potential for recursive “climate–conflict loops”, fuelled in part by erosion of institutional trust, shrinking moral circles, political polarization, and de‐prioritization of long‐term climate goals. In a spirit of optimism, however, we identify three buffers capable of breaking these vicious cycles: maintenance of procedural and distributive justice, enhancing information integrity, and scaffolding institutional cooperation. We conclude by proposing a research agenda that integrates psychological mechanisms into dynamic, multi‐level accounts of how climate impacts and political conflict coevolve.
