items.summary_ko: 이 리뷰는 기후변화와 갈등이 서로를 강화하는 악순환이 어떻게 형성되는지, 그리고 이를 끊을 수 있는 조건이 무엇인지 검토한다. 이념적 양극화, 엘리트 대 서민 서사, 국내 지역 갈등, 국제 분쟁이 기후행동을 저해하고, 기후변화는 열·경제적 스트레스, 불평등, 강제이주를 통해 갈등을 증폭시키지만, 절차적·분배적 정의, 정보 무결성, 제도적 협력이 이러한 순환을 완화할 수 있다고 제시한다.
items.title: Climate change and conflict: The vicious cycles undermining climate action, and what can be done to break them

items.abstract: Voter opposition to development contributes to America’s housing shortage. Prevailing explanations emphasize NIMBYism (opposition to housing nearby) and homeowners’ self-interest. However, homeownership often fails to predict housing policy views, while NIMBYism offers little insight into support for policies that do not concern specific proposed housing projects—the focus of much recent policymaking. Drawing on symbolic politics theory, we argue that voters’ affect toward groups that housing policies make salient powerfully shapes their judgments about housing policies. We present evidence supporting this theory. Experiments show that affect toward developers and investors who build housing, government actors who approve it, and residents who move into it explain anti-development preferences when policies make these groups salient. Providing further causal evidence, short-form videos that manipulate affect toward developers have meaningful downstream effects on support for new development and permitting reforms. Ironically, voter dislike of the very actors who could ameliorate the housing shortage further exacerbates it.
items.summary_ko: 주택정책이 부각하는 개발업자·투자자, 승인 정부 행위자, 이주 주민에 대한 유권자의 정서가 개발 반대와 허가 개혁 지지를 어떻게 형성하는지 상징정치 이론과 실험으로 분석한다. 개발업자 등에 대한 부정적 정서가 해당 집단이 부각된 정책에 대한 반개발 선호를 설명하며, 개발업자에 대한 정서를 조작한 짧은 동영상도 신규 개발 및 허가 개혁 지지에 영향을 미쳤다.
items.title: The Symbolic Politics of Housing

items.abstract: What happens when the very populations whose sacrifice drives policy success are erased from the governance systems that profit from them? We theorize “policy orphan status” as a condition where populations are (a) essential to a celebrated policy outcome, (b) structurally excluded from related governance frameworks, and (c) locked into invisibility by the logic that produces that success. Unlike underserved groups, policy orphans do not fall through cracks in existing institutions—they exist outside the architecture of governance altogether. Through qualitative comparative fieldwork across three East Javanese districts, drawing on 12 in-depth interviews and three focus group discussions with 45 participants, we examine how street-level bureaucrats invent governance from nothing when Indonesia’s labor migration system creates millions of children no framework can see. We find officials building institutions without blueprints, extending theory beyond street-level bureaucracy and policy entrepreneurship into institutional genesis within cross-jurisdictional, post-territorial governance voids.
items.summary_ko: 인도네시아 이주 거버넌스에서 정책 성과에 필수적이지만 관련 제도에서 구조적으로 배제된 ‘정책 고아’ 아동을 공무원들이 어떻게 다루는지, 동부 자바 3개 지역의 질적 비교 현장연구(심층 인터뷰 12건, 초점집단 3회)를 통해 분석했다. 공무원들은 기존 설계도 없이 제도를 창출했으며, 이는 가로지르는 관할과 탈영토적 거버넌스 공백에서의 제도적 기원을 보여준다.
items.title: Who Governs the Ungovernable? Policy Orphans and Public Service Innovation in the Voids of Indonesia’s Migration Governance

items.abstract: Abstract Where can we expect support for populist parties and initiatives to be weakest, and why? We argue support will be weakest in places that have experienced strong growth of employment in high-quality jobs, because such growth has positive spillover effects that shape wider perceptions of the economic status quo and the prevailing ideological climate. We test this proposition in relation to Brexit support at the time of the 2016 EU referendum and in the present day, using Census data to proxy the rate at which highly paid jobs replaced low- and mid-paid jobs in English and Welsh Local Authority Districts 1991–2016, and substantiate it at both the area and the individual-level. High-quality employment growth is a more powerful predictor of Brexit support than alternative local economic indicators and individual-level effects are sizeable. All else being equal, analysis of Understanding Society data shows the probability of Brexit support is only 30% among respondents in places that experienced very strong high-quality employment growth, compared to 55% among those in places with negative growth. These findings have important implications for how left behind places should be defined and for strategies that seek to address political discontent.
items.summary_ko: 고품질 일자리의 성장이 강한 지역에서 경제적 현상 유지와 지배적 이념 환경에 대한 인식이 긍정적으로 형성되어 브렉시트 지지가 약해지는지를, 1991~2016년 잉글랜드·웨일스 지방정부구역의 고임금 일자리 증가 자료와 개인 수준 자료로 분석했다. 지역 및 개인 수준 모두에서 고품질 고용 증가는 다른 지역경제 지표보다 강한 예측변수였으며, 성장률이 매우 높은 지역의 브렉시트 지지 확률은 30%, 감소한 지역은 55%였다.
items.title: The Labour Market Link: An explanation of Brexit support

items.abstract: Abstract Voters increasingly inhabit personalized information environments, where content, algorithms, and social cues vary across people. Yet popular approaches to studying and addressing features of information environments such as misinformation exposure often flatten this heterogeneity: Measures and interventions are developed for populations rather than individuals. Using misinformation as an illustrative case, I argue that population‐based methods for measuring and intervening on beliefs can obscure why some beliefs matter politically while others do not. I advocate for tailored approaches that adapt research designs to groups and individuals. Tailoring can increase relevance, facilitate persuasion, and create fruitful conditions for testing influential theories of opinion formation and change. I conclude by discussing the promise of a personalized political psychology that aligns measures and interventions with the idiosyncratic ways voters form and express opinions.

Yamil Ricardo Velez: Department of Political Science Columbia University New York New York USA

items.summary_ko: 개인화된 정보환경에서 오정보 신념을 집단 평균에 기반해 측정·개입하는 접근이 유권자별 정치적 중요성과 의견 형성의 차이를 가릴 수 있는지 검토하고, 개인과 집단에 맞춘 연구설계를 제안한다. 맞춤형 접근은 연구의 관련성과 설득 가능성을 높이고 의견 형성·변화 이론을 검증할 조건을 마련할 수 있다고 주장한다.
items.title: Political psychology in an era of personalization: Misinformation research, generative AI, and the promise of tailored experiments

items.abstract: Abstract As politicians with authoritarian tendencies win elections globally, it becomes urgent to understand the social psychological mechanisms underlying support for such candidates. Prior research identifies authoritarianism as a likely predictor of vote choice. Contrary to views of authoritarian parenting as a stable, exogenous disposition, however, we argue that such attitudes can also evolve during campaigns, as voters take cues from elites. Analyzing AmericasBarometer data and a five‐wave panel study, this paper assesses authoritarian parenting values over Brazil's 2018 presidential campaign. Consistent with prior literature, authoritarian parenting attitudes early in the campaign predict who supported and opposed the authoritarian candidate Bolsonaro. However, these attitudes change over the campaign. This polarization is asymmetric, limited to Bolsonaro's opponents, who become increasingly anti‐authoritarian. The results illuminate how polities can resist authoritarian leaders and call for a reconsideration of authoritarianism in the public.

Amy Erica Smith: Department of Political Science Iowa State University Ames Iowa USA
Mason W. Moseley: Department of Political Science University of Kentucky Lexington Kentucky USA
Matthew L. Layton: Political Science Department Ohio University Athens Ohio USA
Mollie J. Cohen: Department of Political Science Purdue University West Lafayette Indiana USA

items.summary_ko: 브라질의 2018년 대선 캠페인에서 유권자의 권위주의적 양육 가치가 엘리트의 신호에 따라 변화하는지, 그리고 이것이 보우소나루 지지·반대와 어떻게 관련되는지를 분석했다. AmericasBarometer 자료와 5차 패널 연구 결과, 캠페인 초기에 권위주의적 양육 태도가 지지·반대를 예측했으며, 이후 보우소나루 반대자들 사이에서만 반권위주의적 태도가 강화되는 비대칭적 양극화가 나타났다.
items.title: Rejecting authoritarianism: When threats to democracy shape values

items.abstract: ABSTRACT The field of public administration stands amid genuine crisis. Americans don't trust government or its administrators. Elected officials have attacked the career service as agents of the “deep state” and, though it might be hard to admit, many of public administration's critics have a point. Government's performance too often falls short of what people expect, practitioners too often seem too unresponsive to elected officials, and researchers too often seem to have only fuzzy guidance for practitioners. However, public administration undoubtedly is more important now than ever in translating public goals into effective action, and in bringing to life the democratic aspirations Madison and his colleagues wished for the country at its founding. The field urgently needs new strategies and tactics for solving the new generation of puzzles the country faces. In coming together, practitioners and researchers build on these puzzles to chart an exciting road forward.

Donald F. Kettl: University of Maryland School of Public Policy College Park Maryland USA

items.summary_ko: 미국 민주주의의 위기 속에서 행정에 대한 불신, 선출직 공직자와 경력관료 간 긴장, 행정성과의 미흡, 연구의 실천 지침 부족을 진단하고, 행정가와 연구자가 새로운 문제를 함께 해결하는 전략이 필요하다고 주장한다. 공공행정은 민주적 목표를 효과적 행동으로 전환하는 데 더욱 중요해졌다는 것이 핵심 결론이다.
items.title: Public Administration and the Crisis of American Democracy

items.abstract: Abstract Research on attitudes toward transgender and gender-diverse (TGD) individuals lags behind research on opinion on the lesbian, gay, and bisexual (LGB) population, leaving open questions about public opinion on these two LGBTQ+ subgroups, in general and in particular in the Global South. While a sizeable gap exists in US public opinion toward TGD and LGB rights, we do not know whether that finding is generalizable to other contexts. With a focus on Latin America, we draw on a range of scholarship to identify factors that could result in a similar divergence of attitudes toward these subgroups or, instead, relative convergence. Our analyses focus primarily on novel survey data from representative surveys across thirteen Latin American countries. Our results demonstrate a fair amount of convergence in mean levels, item nonresponse rates, and predictors of views on LGB versus TGD rights. We present some notable differences across countries and issues, with results for the former (countries) varying by socio-political context and the latter (issues) varying across political and nonpolitical domains. We identify these patterns as constituting a future agenda for researchers of opinion on LGBTQ+ topics. We conclude that, in the contemporary period, the Latin American public holds fairly similar mental schemas toward LGB and TGD groups.

Eli G Rau: , Political Science, Tecnologico de Monterrey Assistant Professor , Monterrey, NL, ; and Visiting Fellow, , New Haven, CT,
Institution for Social and Policy Studies, Yale University Assistant Professor , Monterrey, NL, ; and Visiting Fellow, , New Haven, CT,
Elizabeth J Zechmeister: Department of Political Science, Vanderbilt University Cornelius Vanderbilt Professor of Political Science, , Nashville, TN,
Valerie Schweizer-Robinson: Student Success Science, National University Research Analyst, , San Diego, CA,

items.summary_ko: 라틴아메리카 13개국의 대표성 설문자료를 활용해 LGB와 트랜스젠더·성별다양성(TGD) 권리에 대한 태도가 얼마나 수렴하거나 분화되는지 분석했다. 평균 수준, 무응답률, 태도 예측요인에서 두 집단에 대한 견해가 대체로 수렴했으며, 국가와 쟁점에 따른 일부 차이는 사회정치적 맥락 및 정치·비정치적 영역에 따라 달랐다.
items.title: Attitudes Toward LGB and TGD Rights in Latin America

items.abstract: Abstract How do ordinary citizens make sense of gender politics? While research has examined public support for feminism and gender equality either separately or as interchangeable concepts, far less is known about the meanings citizens attach to these labels and whether they evoke distinct political meanings. This article compares the textual, emotional, and symbolic associations of three related but distinct framings of gender politics: feminism, gender equality, and equality between men and women. Drawing on an original pre-registered survey experiment in Spain, respondents were randomly assigned to define and evaluate one of the three labels, allowing us to analyze their meanings across textual, emotional, and visual dimensions. We find that while most respondents express sympathy toward all three labels, feminism stands as the most contested. Feminism also has the sharpest sociopolitical profile, eliciting greater support from young, highly educated, progressive women. Text analyses reveal that the public frames feminism in terms of collective action, conflict, and women’s identity, drawing heavily on political language, while the other two labels emphasize policy and material concerns. Emotionally, gender politics elicits more positive than negative responses across all three labels, though men report slightly higher negative emotions toward feminism. Feminism is also the only label consistently associated with images of women’s mobilization and protest, reinforcing its distinctively political resonance. These findings show that feminism and gender equality tap related but meaningfully distinct constructs in the public mind, with implications for how scholars measure attitudes toward gender politics and interpret public support for equality-related policies.

Marta Fraile: Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas Full Professor, Institute of Public Goods and Policies (IPP), , Madrid,
Nerea Gándara-Guerra: Department of Social Sciences, Universidad Carlos III of Madrid Postdoctoral Researcher, , Madrid,
Paula Zuluaga-Borrero: Department of Political Science, Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona (UAB) Postdoctoral Researcher, , Barcelona,

items.summary_ko: 시민들이 페미니즘, 성평등, 남녀 간 평등이라는 성정치 프레임을 어떻게 이해하고 서로 다른 의미를 부여하는지 스페인의 사전등록 설문실험으로 비교했다. 세 프레임 모두 대체로 긍정적으로 평가되었지만, 페미니즘은 집단행동·갈등·여성 정체성과 연결된 가장 논쟁적이고 정치적인 개념으로 나타났으며, 다른 두 프레임은 정책·물질적 관심을 더 강조했다.
items.title: How the Public Makes Sense of Gender Politics: Textual, Emotional, and Symbolic Dimensions

items.abstract: Public organizations face growing pressure to integrate data science and AI into their work, yet empirical insight into how such integration unfolds in practice remains limited. This article examines data science integration through a multiple embedded case study of intelligence agencies in the Netherlands and the United States, drawing on 28 semi-structured interviews with personnel in managerial, analytic, and data science roles. Using a strategy-as-practice perspective and a micro-level Ability-Motivation-Opportunity (AMO) lens, the study analyzes how public servants encounter and respond to organizational, technical, and legal challenges in everyday work. Interviewees linked integration to leadership literacy, data culture and expertise, opportunities for experimentation, technical and acquisition conditions, and legal and accountability requirements. The analysis identifies different patterns of integration, including fragmented and ad hoc use, incorporation into specific workflows, and more routinized use. The article contributes to public management research on digital governance by conceptualizing integration as a practice-based organizational process in which data-driven tools have to become useful and justifiable within everyday work. It also shows how the AMO framework can help explain the micro-level conditions under which personnel engage with such tools and identifies implications for strategic prioritization, validation, cross-role collaboration, and sustained integration.

Roy Lindelauf: Faculty of Military Sciences, Netherlands Defence Academy
Tilburg School of Humanities and Digital Sciences, Tilburg University
Sebastiaan Rietjens: Faculty of Military Sciences, Netherlands Defence Academy
Institute of Security and Global Affairs, Leiden University
Tess Horlings: Faculty of Military Sciences, Netherlands Defence Academy
Institute of Security and Global Affairs, Leiden University
V.S. Subrahmanian: Department of Computer Science, Northwestern University

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 네덜란드와 미국 정보기관의 자료과학·AI 통합이 일상 업무에서 어떻게 이루어지는지를 28명의 관리자·분석가·자료과학자 반구조화 인터뷰를 통한 다중 내재 사례연구로 분석했다. 통합은 조직·기술·법적 제약 속에서 리더십의 이해, 데이터 문화와 전문성, 실험 기회 등에 따라 단편적·임시적 활용에서 특정 업무흐름의 통합과 일상화된 활용까지 다양한 양상으로 나타났으며, AMO 관점은 이러한 미시적 조건을 설명하는 데 활용될 수 있다.
items.title: Data Science Integration as Practice: Micro-Level Dynamics from Intelligence Agencies

items.abstract: Abstract The National Labor Convention of 1869, the first of its kind for African American workers, yielded a grand strategy for achieving full emancipation, in which those long subjected to domination might attain durable independence. Drawing upon decades of Black republican thought, this agenda combined macro‐level reforms targeting agrarian and industrial monopolies with micro‐level interventions into the habits of the working class. While the project fell short, its multivalent approach nevertheless offers republican theorists today a framework for better understanding the structural dynamics of domination and how to overcome them.

Benjamin T. Lynerd: Department of Political Science Christopher Newport University 1 Avenue of the Arts Newport News Virginia USA

items.summary_ko: 1869년 최초의 아프리카계 미국인 노동자 전국노동대회가 지배받던 이들의 지속 가능한 독립을 위해 어떤 해방 전략을 제시했는지를 분석한다. 흑인 공화주의 사상에 기반해 농업·산업 독점을 겨냥한 거시적 개혁과 노동계급의 습관을 바꾸려는 미시적 개입을 결합했으며, 이 다층적 접근은 지배의 구조적 동학과 극복 방식을 이해하는 틀을 제공하지만 실제로는 목표에 미치지 못했다.
items.title: Structure and agency in emancipatory reform: A blueprint from a Black union

items.abstract: Abstract When constituents are uncertain about whether leaders' policy preferences align with their interests, policy choices generate a trade‐off between payoffs and information. Leaders can experiment with their preferred policy, but if the outcome is bad, constituents learn this and threaten office removal. I use a repeated model of political agency to analyze how this trade‐off shapes long‐lived, term‐unlimited leaders' policy choices. When there is uncertainty about the optimal policy for constituents, leaders implement “learning traps”: spatially intermediate policies that halt learning about what the best policy is. They experiment only when their preferences are very likely to be aligned with constituents, a contrast to the “gambling for resurrection” logic ubiquitous in the literature. I provide a case study that examines how the 1861 reforms ending Serfdom in Imperial Russia represented the logic of a “learning trap” and illustrate additional applications of the model to political contagion and economic policymaking.

Hassan Sayed: Market Shaping Accelerator Center for Global Development, Washington DC USA

items.summary_ko: 정책 선호가 시민의 이해관계와 일치하는지 불확실한 상황에서, 장기 재임 지도자의 정책 선택이 보상과 정보 획득 사이의 상충에 어떻게 영향을 받는지 반복적 정치적 대리인 모형으로 분석한다. 시민에게 최적 정책에 대한 불확실성이 있을 때 지도자는 학습을 중단시키는 ‘학습 함정’을 택하며, 시민과 선호가 일치할 가능성이 매우 높을 때만 실험한다는 결과를 제시하고, 농노해방 개혁 사례를 통해 이를 설명한다.
items.title: Learning traps

items.abstract: Results-based performance management assumes that organizational performance can be evaluated by defining and measuring desired results. Yet frontline workers, who translate performance goals into service delivery, may interpret results through their knowledge of how services are produced. We examine whether production attributes enter frontline evaluations of formal results. Drawing on theories of sensemaking and cognitive judgement, we argue that task difficulty and effort provide salient cues through which frontline workers contextualize performance information. We test these expectations using a conjoint survey experiment with 1,371 Danish high school teachers, randomly varying production attributes alongside formal results. Teachers rate schools serving more disadvantaged students more favourably and increase ratings when schools demonstrate greater effort. Both effects exhibit clear dose-response patterns, with effort effects comparable to those of formal results. The findings show that frontline evaluations systematically incorporate production information, revealing how performance management can generate divergent understandings of organizational performance.

Paw Hansen: VIVE—The Danish National Center for Social Science Research, Copenhagen, Denmark

items.summary_ko: 전선(frontline) 노동자가 공식 성과를 평가할 때 서비스 생산의 과업 난이도와 노력을 함께 고려하는지, 덴마크 고등학교 교사 1,371명을 대상으로 생산 속성과 공식 성과를 무작위로 변화시킨 컨조인트 설문실험으로 검증했다. 교사들은 불리한 학생을 더 많이 담당하는 학교를 더 긍정적으로 평가했고, 노력 수준이 높을수록 평가를 높였으며, 노력의 효과는 공식 성과의 효과와 비슷했다.
items.title: The blurred line between ends and means: how frontline workers factor production attributes into results in performance evaluations

items.abstract: This article examines the uneven development of environmental policy capacities among Chilean municipalities. Drawing on the policy capacities framework, we distinguish operative, analytical, and political capacities and measure them through the first nationwide survey exclusively focused on municipal environmental management (84.6% response rate). We construct composite indicators for each capacity and an integrated index to map territorial patterns and internal imbalances. Regression models combining survey and administrative data assess variation in municipal policy capacity. Results reveal substantial subnational inequality: the size of the municipal administration is the most robust predictor, whereas general fiscal resources show no consistent effect. Civic density is positively associated with capacity, particularly its political dimension, while extractive industry presence is negatively associated with operative capacity. Environmental and economic pressures do not automatically generate capacity; their effects are conditional on municipal resources and context. Environmental policy capacity thus depends on organizational endowments and state–society relations across territories.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 지방정부의 환경정책 역량이 지역별·조직 내에서 어떻게 불균등하게 형성되는지 분석하기 위해, 전국 지방정부 대상 설문과 행정자료를 결합하고 운영적·분석적·정치적 역량 지표 및 회귀모형을 구축했다. 지방정부 행정조직 규모가 역량의 가장 일관된 예측요인이었으며, 시민사회 밀도는 특히 정치적 역량과 정(+)의 관계를, 채굴산업의 존재는 운영적 역량과 부(-)의 관계를 보였고, 일반 재정자원의 효과는 일관되지 않았다.
items.title: Environmental Policy Capacities in Local Governments. The Case of Chilean Municipalities

items.abstract: Decentralization is widely promoted to improve local service delivery, yet evidence on frontline officials’ behavioral role remains limited. We study Honduras’ health-sector reform using lab-in-the-field experiments with 240 officials across 31 matched municipalities and administrative data on maternal health services, examining four behavioral mechanisms—motivation, cooperation, coordination, and trust—via linear regression and fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis. Decentralized settings show higher motivation and cooperation, and greater provision of prenatal, follow-up, and postpartum services. Decentralization acts as a necessary enabling condition across maternal-care stages, though mechanisms vary by outcome: early uptake aligns with motivation, later stages with multiple configurations, demonstrating equifinality. Decentralization thus operates less as a single causal lever than as a modifier of the institutional environment enabling behavioral pathways. Motivational gains stem primarily from new-hire selection, while cooperation benefits both new and existing staff. Institutional trust appears unaffected, suggesting it responds to longer time horizons than other mechanisms.
items.summary_ko: 온두라스 보건 부문의 분권화가 일선 공무원의 동기, 협력, 조정, 신뢰를 통해 모성보건 서비스 제공에 어떤 영향을 미치는지, 31개 대응 지방자치단체의 공무원 240명을 대상으로 한 현장실험과 행정자료를 선형회귀 및 퍼지셋 질적비교분석으로 검토했다. 분권화는 동기와 협력을 높이고 산전·추적·산후 서비스 제공을 확대하는 필요조건으로 작용했지만, 신뢰에는 영향이 없었으며 결과별 행동 경로와 조합은 달랐다.
items.title: Social and Behavioral Effects of Decentralization on Health Services Delivery: Evidence from the Honduran Health Sector

items.abstract: Abstract While the mediating role of third-party actors in shaping administrative burdens has gained growing recognition, their theoretical conceptualization remains underdeveloped. Through a two-stage deductive-inductive process combining conceptual synthesis from the administrative burden literature with an illustrative case study of the Israeli disability benefits system, this article proposes a multidimensional analytical framework for understanding third-party actors in administrative burden contexts. The article identifies three core dimensions characterizing third-party actors: their functional role (agents, service providers, verifiers, and reformers); their level of formality (formal, semi-formal, and informal); and their institutional position (state, non-state, and hybrid). Together, these dimensions provide a systematic understanding of the varied mechanisms through which third parties shape burdensome citizens’ encounters, extending administrative burden beyond the citizen-state dyad and widening the definition of who counts as a third party.

Avishai Benish: The Paul Baerwald School of Social Work and Social Welfare, The Hebrew University of Jerusalem , Mount Scopus , Jerusalem, 9190500,
John Gal: The Paul Baerwald School of Social Work and Social Welfare, The Hebrew University of Jerusalem , Mount Scopus , Jerusalem, 9190500,
Noam Tarshish: Faculty of Social Welfare and Health Sciences, School of Social Work, The University of Haifa , Mt. Carmel , Haifa, 3103301,
Roni Holler: The Paul Baerwald School of Social Work and Social Welfare, The Hebrew University of Jerusalem , Mount Scopus , Jerusalem, 9190500,

items.journal: Perspectives on Public Management and Governance
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 행정 부담 상황에서 제3자 행위자의 역할을 어떻게 개념화할 것인지 묻고, 행정 부담 문헌의 개념 종합과 이스라엘 장애급여 제도의 사례를 결합한 2단계 연역-귀납적 접근을 사용한다. 제3자 행위자는 기능적 역할(대리인·서비스 제공자·검증자·개혁자), 공식성 수준(공식·준공식·비공식), 제도적 위치(국가·비국가·혼합)라는 세 차원으로 분석할 수 있으며, 이를 통해 행정 부담을 시민-국가 관계를 넘어 확장한다.
items.title: “A bridge over troubled water?”: conceptualizing third parties’ involvement in administrative burden

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Extensive research highlights public apprehension toward immigrants and robots, but few studies examine how demographic challenges, particularly population aging, influence these perceptions. The public may not naturally consider population aging when evaluating immigration or automation policies, as these issues are often discussed in silos. We thus hypothesize that priming the public to consider population aging will lead them to view automation and immigration more favorably. Using pre‐registered survey experiments in three countries—Japan, South Korea, and France—we investigate whether providing factual information about population aging alters attitudes toward immigration and automation. We find that in Japan, the world's most aged country, such information generates more favorable attitudes toward both immigration and automation. In Korea, the fastest‐aging country, it improves only immigration attitudes. In France, where the elderly population is average for the EU, we find no significant effect. We find, however, that these positive effects in Japan and Korea do not persist when respondents consider automation and immigration policies alongside other options like adjusting the retirement age. These findings suggest that the public's policy preferences in response to population aging are subject to country‐specific contexts, as well as to different issue linkages activated in policy discussions.

Seiki Tanaka: University of Groningen Groningen the Netherlands

items.summary_ko: 인구 고령화 정보를 제시하면 자동화와 이민에 대한 태도가 국가별로 어떻게 달라지는지, 일본·한국·프랑스에서 사전등록 설문실험으로 검증했다. 고령화가 매우 심각한 일본에서는 두 정책에 대한 선호가 모두 높아졌고 한국에서는 이민 선호만 높아졌지만, 은퇴연령 조정 등 다른 선택지와 함께 제시하면 이러한 효과가 지속되지 않았으며 프랑스에서는 유의한 효과가 없었다.
items.title: Population Aging and Citizen Preferences for Automation and Immigration: A Cautionary Tale for Advanced Aging Economies?

items.abstract: Abstract Democratic legitimacy is typically thought to depend on whether political decisions reflect public opinion, or majority preferences. Do citizens share this standard? And what if citizens are wrong about public opinion? We study how beliefs about public support for controversial policy proposals are associated with the perceived legitimacy of adopting them, and whether accurate polling information changes these judgments. In a representative survey experiment in Germany, respondents reported their own position on four such proposals, estimated public support, and rated the legitimacy of adopting each one. For a random subset of proposals, respondents received accurate polling information showing that the proposal lacked majority support. We find that perceived public support predicts legitimacy judgments even after accounting for respondents’ own policy preferences. Yet these perceptions are often inaccurate and shaped by respondents’ own views. Corrective polling information modestly lowers perceived legitimacy, especially among those who initially overestimated public support. The findings suggest that misperceptions of public opinion can distort, but accurate information can also partly correct, citizens’ assessments of democratic legitimacy.
items.summary_ko: 독일 대표 표본 설문실험을 통해, 논쟁적 정책 제안에 대한 시민의 공공 지지도 인식이 자신의 정책 선호와 별개로 정책 결정의 정당성 판단과 어떤 관련이 있는지, 정확한 여론 정보가 이를 변화시키는지 분석했다. 공공 지지도 인식은 정당성 판단을 예측했지만 자주 부정확했고, 다수 지지가 없다는 정확한 여론 정보는 특히 지지도를 과대평가한 응답자에게서 정당성을 소폭 낮췄다.
items.title: Beliefs About Public Opinion and the Perceived Legitimacy of Policy Decisions

items.abstract: Abstract Religious and ethnic minorities remain underrepresented in political office, but its reasons are debated. Using administrative data from Norwegian local elections, we show that candidates with Muslim names receive fewer personal votes, and propose that this is (partly) due to political beliefs about Muslims as politicians.To examine this claim, we identify salient political beliefs and implement a conjoint experiment that estimates anti-Muslim bias with and without information on these beliefs.In a low-information setting, respondents exhibit a substantial anti-Muslim bias, but providing belief-relevant information reduces this anti-Muslim bias by 2–5 percentage points. The largest reduction occurs when respondents learn candidates’ positions on minority-rights issues. This reduction is driven by right-wing voters and is large enough to eliminate the left-right gap in anti-Muslim bias. These findings show a strong political component in the anti-Muslim bias.
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이 지방선거 행정자료와 컨조인트 실험을 활용해, 무슬림 이름을 가진 후보에 대한 개인득표 불이익과 이를 유발하는 정치적 신념의 역할을 분석했다. 정보가 적을 때 상당한 반무슬림 편향이 나타났지만, 특히 소수자 권리 이슈에 대한 입장 정보를 제공하면 편향이 2~5%포인트 감소했으며, 이러한 감소는 우파 유권자에게서 나타났다.
items.title: What Drives Voter Bias Against Muslim Politicians? An Experimental Examination

items.abstract: Political communication research in general – and research on political online discussions in particular – has previously focused on the exercise of democratic voice and thus largely neglected the complementary practice of democratic listening. Against the backdrop of a wide-spread perception that democratic listening is lacking in online discussions, we investigate whether listening can be strengthened through novel platform affordances. We developed an experimental online written discussion platform with listening-oriented reaction buttons and both human and AI moderation (based on GPT-4). We then conducted an experiment involving n = 740 respondents in 40 discussion groups (N = 4,355 comments), each lasting 30 minutes, covering three experimental conditions and a control condition. We compare the effect of (1) listening-oriented reaction buttons versus (2) a combination of these buttons and listening-oriented human discussion moderation versus (3) a combination of buttons and AI moderation on the level of democratic listening demonstrated in discussants’ textual contributions. We find that listening-oriented buttons alone do not enhance democratic listening. However, when combined with listening-oriented AI moderation, they are associated with a democratic listening rate of 27% within discussions, compared to 21% in the condition without either feature. Our findings lay the basis for the implementation of a combination of listening-oriented buttons and discussion moderation on news media websites, social media apps or dedicated discussion spaces using LLM-based chatbots.
items.summary_ko: 온라인 토론에서 듣기 지향 반응 버튼과 인간·AI 조정이 민주적 경청을 강화하는지 실험적으로 검토했다. 740명을 40개 토론 그룹에 배정한 결과, 반응 버튼만으로는 효과가 없었지만 버튼과 AI 조정을 결합한 조건에서는 민주적 경청 비율이 27%로, 두 기능이 없는 조건의 21%보다 높았다.
items.title: Enhancing Democratic Listening in Online Discussions: The Role of Reaction Buttons, Discussion Moderation, and Large Language Models

items.abstract: Abstract Do nationalist expressions reflect a willingness to pay costs or are they cheap talk? This is important because theories expect nationalism affects a wide range of outcomes that pose costs to participants, including international conflict and participation in boycotts. However, past research has either relied on self‐reports that cannot rule out cheap talk or outcome measures at higher levels of analysis, such as international trade flows, that do not directly link individual‐level nationalist sentiment to behavior. In contrast, we measure both nationalist sentiments and costly behavior on an individual level using the content of millions of Chinese social media posts and the nationality of the brand of users' devices, for example type of cellphone, as a costly behavioral measure. We find that nationalist sentiment makes citizens less likely to use US and Japanese brands with an instrumental variable analysis.

Charles Chang: Duke Kunshan University Kunshan Jiangsu China
Michael Masterson: Missouri State University Springfield Missouri USA

items.summary_ko: 중국인의 민족주의 표현이 비용을 감수하려는 의지를 반영하는지 검토하기 위해, 중국 소셜미디어 게시물 수백만 건의 민족주의 정서와 이용자 기기 브랜드의 국적을 개인 수준에서 분석했다. 도구변수 분석 결과, 민족주의 정서는 미국 및 일본 브랜드 사용 가능성을 낮추는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Putting your money where your mouth is: Expressions of Chinese nationalist sentiments are not just cheap talk

items.abstract: Governments are increasingly adopting chatbots to reduce administrative burdens and improve service quality, yet citizens’ willingness to use them remains limited. Drawing on nudge theory, this study examines how information framing and default options influence citizens’ willingness to use chatbots in public services. Using a survey experiment in China, the results show that participants exposed to a loss frame were more willing to use chatbots than those exposed to a gain frame. The default option alone did not significantly affect willingness. However, the interaction between information framing and default settings was significant. Specifically, the positive effect of loss-framed information on citizens’ willingness to use chatbots was stronger when a default option was presented, suggesting that defaults amplify the effect of loss framing. Overall, the study offers practical insights into designing strategies to promote chatbot adoption in public services.

Haoting Chang: The Education University of Hong Kong
Lei Tao: The Education University of Hong Kong

items.summary_ko: 중국에서 설문실험을 통해 정보 프레이밍과 기본값이 시민의 공공서비스 챗봇 이용 의향에 미치는 영향을 분석했다. 손실 프레임은 이득 프레임보다 이용 의향을 높였고, 기본값 자체의 효과는 유의하지 않았지만 기본값이 제시될 때 손실 프레임의 긍정적 효과가 강화됐다.
items.title: Nudging citizens to use chatbots: an information and default option approach

items.abstract: Traditional research on policy change offers valuable but fragmented accounts of policy evolution. Gradualist approaches identify types and mechanisms of incremental change, while other strands of scholarship propose processes associated with abrupt or punctuated shifts. These perspectives, however, tend to privilege one mode of change and do not address well how lower level mechanisms scale into system level patterns. The structure-in-evolution model overcomes the fragmentation by bringing together structure and different dynamics of change into an integrated, patterns-based approach to policy and institutional change. Despite its unifying potential, the model currently lacks a specification of the mechanisms that correspond to its patterned forms of change. This paper extends the model by identifying and systematically mapping such mechanisms. The resulting integration links causal processes across levels of analysis and enhances the model’s capacity to explain long term policy system evolution.
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 정책·제도 변화의 다양한 양식을 통합하는 구조-진화 접근법에서 하위 수준의 변화 메커니즘이 체계 수준의 패턴으로 어떻게 연결되는지, 그리고 각 변화 패턴에 대응하는 메커니즘이 무엇인지 규명한다. 이론적·개념적 통합과 체계적 매핑을 통해 메커니즘과 변화 패턴을 연결하고, 장기적인 정책체계 진화를 설명하는 모형의 역량을 확장한다.
items.title: Extending the Structure-In-Evolution Approach: Mechanisms and Patterns of Institutional Evolution

items.abstract: Governments face growing pressure to innovate in response to complex societal demands, yet little is known about how bureaucratic features shape public employees’ perceptions about innovation. This study examines how bureaucratic capacity and autonomy influence public employees’ perceptions of innovation climate. We argue that capacity, understood as organizational resources and capabilities, and autonomy, or insulation from political influence, foster conditions conducive to innovation. We analyze over 30,000 survey responses from public employees across the 32 Colombian intermediate governments between 2015 and 2023, combined with administrative data. Findings show that autonomy is consistently and positively associated with a stronger innovation climate. Capacity also matters, but only when measured through employees’ perceptions of sufficient resources, not through fiscal performance indicators. These results contribute to understanding organizational drivers of individual innovation antecedents. Specifically, the study underscores the role of bureaucratic features in fostering innovation climates in politically complex subnational contexts.
items.summary_ko: 콜롬비아 32개 중간정부의 공무원 3만 명 이상 설문응답과 행정자료를 분석해 관료적 역량과 자율성이 공무원의 혁신 분위기 인식에 미치는 영향을 검토했다. 정치적 영향으로부터의 자율성은 일관되게 더 강한 혁신 분위기와 관련되며, 역량은 재정성과 지표가 아니라 충분한 자원에 대한 직원 인식으로 측정할 때만 유의미했다.
items.title: Bureaucratic Capacity and Autonomy as Drivers of Innovation Climate

items.abstract: Do public sector jobs foster civic engagement beyond the workplace? Using national survey data from the 2021 CGSS, this study examines whether Chinese public sector employees are more willing to engage in environmental co-production. The study disaggregates co-production into production, capturing routine pro-environmental behaviors, and cooperation, capturing multi-actor deliberation. The results show that public sector employment is significantly correlated with environmental cooperation but not production. Specifically, employees in public institutions and state-owned enterprises are more inclined toward neighborhood cooperation, whereas government agency employment is marginally positively correlated with stakeholder cooperation. Exploratory mediation analyses suggest that these associations are consistent with a pathway through institutionally embedded self-efficacy, rather than altruism or informational advantages. Managerial positions weaken the association between public sector employment and neighborhood cooperation. The findings suggest that promoting environmental sustainability requires not only moral mobilization and information provision, but also the cultivation of citizens’ civic efficacy and procedural confidence.

Hua Qin: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Jin Zhu: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

items.summary_ko: 2021년 중국사회종합조사(CGSS) 자료를 활용해 공공부문 고용이 환경 공동생산 참여와 관련되는지 분석한 결과, 공공부문 고용은 일상적 친환경 행동인 생산보다 다중 행위자 숙의를 포함하는 협력과 유의하게 관련되었다. 탐색적 매개분석은 이러한 연관성이 이타성이나 정보 우위보다 제도적으로 형성된 자기효능감을 통한 경로와 부합하며, 관리자 직위는 이 관계를 약화시킴을 시사한다.
items.title: When Public Employment Spills Over into Civic Action: Environmental Co-Production in China

items.abstract: This study explains why criminal justice and prosecutorial reform often proceeds through gradual institutional adjustment rather than radical replacement despite severe politicization and legitimacy crises. Drawing on historical institutionalism, comparative judicial politics, legitimacy research, and prosecutorial-governance scholarship, it develops the concept of “constitutionally bounded sequential incrementalism,” in which constitutional constraints, bureaucratic embeddedness, and professional authority channel reform pressure into sequential layering and conversion. South Korea is the primary case, examined through comparative historical analysis and process tracing, with the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Japan, the United States, and Italy as structured reference cases. A brief Latin American comparison clarifies the concept’s scope conditions. The analysis shows that politicization increases reform pressure, but institutional constraints and implementation capacity shape reform outcomes. The study contributes by explaining when and why criminal justice reform follows recurring patterns of constrained institutional adaptation.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 정치화와 정당성 위기에도 형사사법·검찰 개혁이 급진적 대체보다 점진적 제도 조정으로 진행되는 이유와 조건을 묻는다. 한국을 중심 사례로 비교역사분석과 과정추적을 수행하고 여러 국가를 비교 준거로 삼아, 헌법적 제약·관료제적 내재성·전문직 권위가 개혁 압력을 순차적 제도 층화와 전환으로 유도하며 제도적 제약과 집행역량이 결과를 형성한다고 주장한다.
items.title: Constitutionally Bounded Sequential Incrementalism: Criminal Justice Reform and Prosecutorial Governance in Comparative Perspective

items.abstract: Although research on administrative burdens has mainly focused on clients’ experiences, burdens also matter to employees in public bureaucracies. In this study, we examine how burdens shape public workers’ experiences, focusing on how they perceive the relationship between administrative burdens and performance. Using a choice experiment with 21,301 public healthcare professionals, this study estimates the relative causal impact of different costs embedded in job procedures on the perceived performance of a given work situation. Psychological costs exert the strongest causal impact on perceived performance, with stressful procedures having the largest negative effect, followed by procedures that diminish autonomy. Learning costs (stemming from complex or confusing procedures) and compliance costs (arising from time-consuming or effortful tasks) also lead to lower perceived performance, though to a lesser extent. Heterogeneous effects show that the negative impact of administrative burdens on performance is larger for medical doctors and less so for nurses, for those under-fifty, and for male professionals.

Donald P. Moynihan: Ford School of Public Policy, University of Michigan

items.summary_ko: 공공의료 종사자들이 행정적 부담의 여러 비용(심리적·학습·준수 비용)을 업무성과와 어떻게 연결해 인식하는지 알아보기 위해 21,301명을 대상으로 선택실험을 실시했다. 심리적 비용, 특히 스트레스를 유발하거나 자율성을 줄이는 절차가 인식된 성과에 가장 큰 부정적 영향을 미쳤으며, 이러한 영향은 의사와 50세 미만·남성 종사자에게 더 크게 나타났다.
items.title: Which costs loom largest? How public employees view the relationship between administrative burdens and performance

items.abstract: Coalition politics presents a major challenge for citizens. Not only do they need to know the parties’ policy profiles, but also who the parties are willing to collaborate with. This task is becoming increasingly difficult as new coalition patterns emerge across Western Europe. Coalition politics may therefore be a major source of frustration for citizens, leading to a sense that politics is too complex to understand, that is, a sense of limited internal political efficacy. Surprisingly, we know little about whether this is actually the case. We analyze this question using a four-wave panel survey during and after the Danish 2022 general election, an unusually complex election where several parties defied traditional coalition structures. Despite this complexity, we demonstrate that Danish citizens gained more internal efficacy during this episode because they learned about the relevant facts. Yet, we find no evidence that people who learned similar facts in the post-government formation period felt more efficacious in response. This suggests that knowledge of coalition politics is critical for citizens’ internal efficacy, but only when complex coalition dynamics are on the agenda.
items.summary_ko: 덴마크 2022년 총선 전후 4개 시점의 패널 설문을 통해, 복잡한 연립정치가 시민의 내적 정치적 효능감에 미치는 영향을 분석했다. 시민들은 관련 사실을 학습하면서 효능감이 높아졌지만, 정부 구성 이후 같은 사실을 학습한 경우에는 그러한 효과가 나타나지 않아 연립정치 지식의 효과가 복잡한 연립 동학이 의제일 때에 한정됨을 보였다.
items.title: Learning from Coalition Politics: How Episodes of Increased Complexity Can Enhance Citizens’ Political Efficacy

items.abstract: Abstract Power‐sharing deals can potentially solve the autocrat's commitment problem, yet often fail to prevent conflict. This article develops a dynamic model to examine a largely overlooked friction: Sharing power within an authoritarian regime bolsters the opposition's coercive capabilities. The resultant threat‐enhancing effect creates two distinct commitment problems for the opposition, which determine if and when power sharing occurs. First, the opposition cannot commit to refrain from leveraging its enhanced threat. The ruler prefers to incur a revolt than peacefully share power if the threat‐enhancing effect is large. Second, the threat‐enhancing effect tempts the opposition to wait for a future power‐sharing deal, which undercuts the opposition's commitment to revolt today. New dynamic implications arise: delayed power sharing, conflict, or an increased willingness for the ruler to share power are all possible. Scrutinizing the opposition's limited commitment ability contrasts with the predominant existing focus on the autocrat's commitment problem.

Jack Paine: Associate Professor, Department of Political Science Emory University Atlanta Georgia USA

items.summary_ko: 권위주의 정권 내 권력분점이 반대파의 강압 역량을 강화하는 효과가 권력분점의 시기와 성패에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지 동태적 모형으로 분석한다. 이 효과는 반대파의 두 가지 추가적 공약 문제를 낳아, 권력분점 지연·분쟁·또는 통치자의 권력분점 의향 증가를 초래할 수 있음을 보인다.
items.title: The threat‐enhancing effect of authoritarian power sharing

items.abstract: Abstract Far-right political shifts have been linked to increased racism, raising concerns about their impact on minority access to public services. This study investigates whether far-right electoral victories encourage discrimination by street-level bureaucrats, who are expected to act impartially. We conducted a nested research design in Italy, combining a field-experimental audit with a regression discontinuity design focused on municipalities near the electoral threshold for far-right mayors. Research assistants with native-Italian and West-African accents contacted municipal healthcare offices to request registration with a general medical practitioner. Compared to native-Italian callers, those with West-African accents faced significantly higher rates of scrutiny and dismissive responses. Leveraging close elections, we find that this disparity was exacerbated in municipalities where far-right candidates narrowly won. These findings demonstrate that far-right electoral success can undermine impartiality and equal access to essential services.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 극우 후보의 선거 승리가 일선 관료의 의료서비스 접근 차별을 심화하는지 이탈리아에서 검토했다. 현장감사 실험과 극우 시장의 근소한 당선에 초점을 둔 회귀불연속설계를 결합한 결과, 서아프리카 억양의 전화 신청자는 이탈리아 원어민 신청자보다 더 많은 조사와 무시하는 응답을 받았으며, 이러한 격차는 극우 후보가 근소하게 승리한 지방자치단체에서 확대됐다.
items.title: When Politics Enters the Waiting Room: Far-Right Electoral Victories Exacerbate Discrimination in Access to Healthcare

items.abstract: This study examines how innovative work behavior is associated with organizational performance, focusing on the mediating role of public service motivation and the moderating role of innovative organizational culture in public organizations. Based on responses of 4,133 Korean central and local government employees, the findings indicated that innovative work behavior is positively associated with organizational performance. The results also show that public service motivation partially mediates this relationship and that innovative organizational culture moderates the association between innovative work behavior and organizational performance. These findings advance understanding of the relationship between innovative work behavior and organizational performance by highlighting the motivational role of public service motivation and the contextual role of innovative organizational culture in public organizations.

Meghna Sabharwal: The University of Texas at Dallas

items.summary_ko: 한국 중앙·지방정부 공무원 4,133명의 설문자료를 바탕으로 혁신적 업무행동이 조직성과와 어떤 관련이 있는지, 공공봉사동기의 매개효과와 혁신적 조직문화의 조절효과를 분석했다. 혁신적 업무행동은 조직성과와 긍정적으로 관련되었고, 공공봉사동기는 이 관계를 부분적으로 매개했으며 혁신적 조직문화는 그 관계를 조절했다.
items.title: Fostering Innovative Work Behavior to Improve Organizational Performance: The Roles of Public Service Motivation and Innovative Organizational Culture

items.abstract: European Union (EU) enlargement represents an ambitious institutional transformation. Our analysis explores whether recent EU accessions have resulted in governance quality convergence. Using the World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators, we examine the progression of governance quality across both EU and non-EU countries and assess whether it has converged toward EU Core member states’ performance level. We apply panel regression and dispersion trend analysis to measure beta and sigma convergence, within and in-between pre-specified country groups. Results are of strong beta and mixed sigma convergence. We find that NonEU_East former communist countries and recently EU‑integrated, predominantly former communist countries, experience convergence regardless of EU membership, with consistently stronger convergence among the latter, suggesting EU accession may play an important role in governance convergence. Importantly, our findings support an interpretation of governance performance deterioration within EU Core member states as a possible contributing factor to the observed convergence outcomes.
items.summary_ko: EU 가입이 거버넌스 질의 EU 핵심국 수준 수렴과 관련되는지를 세계은행 Worldwide Governance Indicators로 EU·비EU 국가를 비교해 패널회귀와 분산 추세 분석으로 검토했다. 강한 베타 수렴과 혼합된 시그마 수렴이 나타났으며, 수렴은 EU 가입 여부와 무관하게 관찰되지만 최근 가입국에서 더 강해 EU 가입의 역할 가능성과 EU 핵심국의 거버넌스 성과 저하 가능성을 함께 시사한다.
items.title: Governance Convergence in the EU—A Matter for Interpretation

items.summary_ko: 2025년 뉴욕시장 선거를 앞두고 후보가 코니아일랜드의 겨울 바다에 뛰어든 뒤 한 문장으로 정책을 전달한 사례를 바탕으로, 알고리즘적 주목이 정책의 대중적 커뮤니케이션을 어떻게 형성하는지 탐구한다. 초록에 제시된 내용만으로는 구체적 연구 접근과 주요 발견을 확인할 수 없다.
items.title: Policy as Punchline: Algorithmic Attention and the Public Communication of Policy

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Interest groups are key actors in shaping political agendas. Yet, we know surprisingly little about how they determine their lobbying priorities at the earliest stage of the policy process. This study advances a novel conceptual framework for studying interest groups' issue prioritization in the agenda setting stage along three complementary dimensions: agenda breadth, agenda direction, and agenda responsiveness. Drawing on original survey data from 630 EU level interest groups, our results show that issue prioritization is driven primarily by the type of constituents a group represents. Economic interest groups tend to pursue broader lobbying agendas, focus on defending the policy status quo, and are more responsive to internal member pressures when prioritizing undesired issues. Citizen groups, by contrast, typically adopt narrower agendas, prioritize challenging the status quo, and respond more strongly to external issue salience when determining their lobbying priorities. Overall, the study advances our understanding of how interest groups navigate competition for political attention and contributes to broader debates on agenda‐setting in contemporary democracies.

Darren Halpin: School of Politics & International Relations Australian National University Canberra Australia
Frederik Stevens: Department of Political Science University of Antwerp Antwerp Belgium

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 이익집단이 의제설정 초기 단계에서 로비 우선순위를 어떻게 정하는지 알아보기 위해 EU 수준 이익집단 630곳의 설문자료를 분석했다. 경제적 이익집단은 더 폭넓은 의제를 추구하고 현상 유지를 방어하는 경향이 있으며 내부 구성원 압력에 더 반응하는 반면, 시민집단은 더 좁은 의제와 현상 변경을 우선시하고 외부의 쟁점 현저성에 더 강하게 반응했다.
items.title: Lobbying Priorities in Agenda‐Setting: Agenda Breadth, Direction, and Responsiveness Across Economic and Citizen Groups

items.abstract: Performance measurement for collaborative governance presents significant challenges both practically and theoretically. With the goal of refining theory grounded in empirical application, we use Emerson and Nabatchi’s Productivity Performance Matrix and their Integrative Framework for Collaborative Governance, to examine data from a five-year longitudinal comparative case study of collaborative governance regimes (CGRs) in three European cities.Our research showed that the indicators of the Productivity Performance Matrix (PPM) had significant relevance to actual performance outcomes observed in the CGRs studied, albeit with some modifications. Proposed modifications include removing the ‘participant organization’ as a distinct level of analysis in network-centred evaluations, reconceptualization of equity as ‘perceived equity’, distinguishing between internal and external legitimacy, and shifting from ‘sustainability’ to ‘systemic change’ as a performance indicator for adaptation. The refinement of performance indicators and the improved conceptual coherence between the PPM and the Integrative Framework are the primary contributions of this work.
items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 Emerson와 Nabatchi의 Productivity Performance Matrix(PPM) 및 Integrative Framework for Collaborative Governance를 적용해 유럽 3개 도시의 협력적 거버넌스 체제를 5년간 비교·종단적으로 분석하고, PPM 지표가 실제 성과를 얼마나 설명하는지 검토했다. 분석 결과 PPM 지표는 대체로 유의미했지만, 조직 수준의 재구성, 형평성의 ‘인지된 형평성’화, 내부·외부 정당성의 구분, 적응 지표를 지속가능성에서 체계적 변화로 전환하는 수정이 제안되었다.
items.title: Assessing performance in collaborative governance networks: testing the Productivity Performance Matrix

items.abstract: Building on the literature on citizen coproduction, this study examines how threat perception and issue knowledge influence individual citizens’ coproduction preferences in the issue domain of environmental health. Drawing on prior research, we propose a conceptual framework and derive theoretical expectations about the relationships between threat perception, issue knowledge, and citizens’ willingness to engage in coproduction. Empirically, we use data from a nationally representative public survey (N = 1,207) to test our hypotheses. Across multiple model specifications and robustness checks, the regression results consistently support our expectations: holding other factors constant, individuals who perceive greater threats and those who possess more issue knowledge tend to express stronger willingness to participate in co-planning and co-investment activities with public entities. In conclusion, we discuss the study’s key contributions, directions for future research, and practical implications for environmental health policy and management.
items.summary_ko: 환경보건 영역에서 위협 인식과 이슈 지식이 시민의 공동생산 참여 의향에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 검토하기 위해 전국 대표 표본 설문자료(N=1,207)를 활용해 여러 회귀모형과 강건성 검정을 실시했다. 다른 요인을 통제할 때 위협을 크게 인식하고 이슈 지식이 많은 개인일수록 공공기관과의 공동기획 및 공동투자에 참여하려는 의향이 강한 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Threat perception, issue knowledge, and citizen coproduction preferences: evidence from a national public survey on environmental health

items.abstract: This study examines how sustainable human resource management (SHRM) has been incorporated into public sector HRM policy in Aotearoa/New Zealand before and after the introduction of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Drawing on a longitudinal qualitative analysis of HRM policies from 10 local councils between 2010 and 2021, it explores how sustainability concerns across social, economic, and environmental domains were integrated into public HRM. The findings show that sustainability entered public HRM primarily through incremental layering onto existing HRM frameworks rather than transformational change. Following the SDGs, policy attention to equity, diversity, and wellbeing increased; however, broader social justice commitments remained uneven, while environmental sustainability received limited attention. By examining HRM policies as organizational signals, the study contributes to public HRM and SHRM scholarship by showing how sustainability priorities are communicated before implementation and may remain constrained by institutional logics of compliance, efficiency, risk management, and organizational performance.

Andrea Clark: University of Otago, Dunedin, New Zealand
Fiona Edgar: University of Otago, Dunedin, New Zealand
Nataliya Podgorodnichenko: University of Otago, Dunedin, New Zealand

items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 2010~2021년 아오테아로아·뉴질랜드의 지방의회 10곳 HRM 정책을 종단적으로 질적 분석해, 유엔 SDGs 도입 전후 지속가능성이 공공부문 HRM 정책에 어떻게 통합되었는지 검토했다. 지속가능성은 기존 HRM 체계에 점진적으로 덧붙는 방식으로 도입되었고, SDGs 이후 형평성·다양성·웰빙에 대한 관심은 커졌지만 사회정의는 고르지 않았으며 환경적 지속가능성은 제한적으로 다뤄졌다.
items.title: From Policy to Sustainability: The Evolution of Sustainability in Public HRM in Aotearoa/New Zealand in the SDG Era

items.abstract: Teacher turnover poses a significant challenge to educational quality worldwide, with turnover intention serving as a critical precursor to actual turnover. This study explores how people management—defined as the integration of the implementation of human resource management practices and leadership behavior—affects teachers’ intentions to leave their positions. Grounded in conservation of resources theory, we examine how people management can serve as a crucial resource in reducing turnover intentions by alleviating role ambiguity and emotional exhaustion, two key issues in the teaching profession. Role ambiguity arises from the increasing demands placed on teachers, while emotional exhaustion exacerbates intentions to leave. Our results show support for the (serial) mediating role of role ambiguity and emotional exhaustion, providing new insights into how people management impacts teacher retention. The findings contribute to the understanding of how people management activities can effectively support teachers, reducing turnover intentions and ultimately enhancing overall education quality.
items.summary_ko: 교사 이직의도에 대한 인사관리의 영향을 분석하고, 역할 모호성과 정서적 소진의 매개역할을 검토했다. 분석 결과, 인사관리는 역할 모호성과 정서적 소진을 연쇄적으로 완화해 이직의도를 낮추는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Turning the Tide. Studying the Impact of People Management on Teacher Turnover Intentions: The Mediating Roles of Role Ambiguity and Emotional Exhaustion

items.abstract: Abstract Standard approaches in generalizability often focus on generalizing the intent-to-treat effect. However, in practice, a more policy-relevant quantity is the generalized impact of an intervention across compliers. While instrumental variable methods are commonly used to estimate the complier average causal effect (CACE) within samples, standard approaches cannot be applied to a target population with a different distribution from the study sample. This article makes several key contributions. First, we introduce a new set of identifying assumptions in the form of a population-level exclusion restriction that allows for identification of the target CACE (T-CACE) in both randomized experiments and observational studies. This allows researchers to identify the T-CACE without relying on standard principal ignorability assumptions. Second, we propose a class of inverse-weighted estimators for the T-CACE and derive their asymptotic properties. We provide extensions for settings in which researchers have access to auxiliary compliance information across the target population. Finally, we introduce a sensitivity analysis for researchers to evaluate the robustness of the estimators in the presence of unmeasured confounding and extend existing tests to evaluate instrument validity in this context. We illustrate our proposed method through extensive simulations and a study evaluating the impact of deep canvassing on reducing exclusionary attitudes.
items.summary_ko: 표본과 목표집단의 순응자 분포가 다를 때 정책 개입의 목표집단 순응자 평균 인과효과(T-CACE)를 식별·추정하는 방법을 제시한다. 모집단 수준의 배제제약에 기반한 역가중 추정량과 민감도 분석·도구변수 타당성 검정을 개발하고, 심층 캔버싱 실험 사례와 시뮬레이션으로 적용 가능성을 보인다.
items.title: Generalizing Causal Effects with Noncompliance: Application to Deep Canvassing Experiments

items.abstract: Recruitment is critical for equipping public service organizations with the competencies required to advance the sustainable development goals (SDGs). This is particularly salient for public utilities, hybrid organizations mandated to contribute to the SDGs through essential services in water, waste, and energy management. This study examines employer attractiveness for profiles considered critical to SDG implementation in Italian utilities. Drawing on self-determination theory, we combine semi-structured interviews with HR and Employer Branding managers from 16 utilities with two discrete-choice experiments involving STEM and vocational-technical students and professionals. Salary and competence-related opportunities are consistently important across both groups. Remote work does not significantly affect STEM respondents’ choices, whereas workplace proximity is the strongest driver for vocational-technical respondents. Relatedness, operationalized as environmental and community impact, is not a significant differentiating attribute, suggesting that in organizations whose public value mission is already highly visible, social and environmental impact may function as a baseline expectation.

Francesco Vidè: SDA Bocconi School of Management, Milan, Italy
Lavinia Lenzi: SDA Bocconi School of Management, Milan, Italy

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 이탈리아 공공서비스 유틸리티에서 SDG 이행에 필요한 인재의 고용주 매력도를 결정하는 요인을 분석하기 위해 HR·고용주브랜딩 관리자 16개 기관의 반구조화 면접과 STEM·직업기술 분야 학생 및 전문가 대상 이산선택실험을 결합했다. 두 집단 모두 급여와 역량개발 기회를 중요하게 평가했으며, STEM 응답자에게 원격근무는 유의한 영향을 주지 않았고 직업기술 응답자에게는 직장과의 근접성이 가장 강한 요인이었으며, 환경·지역사회 영향은 유의한 차별 요인이 아니었다.
items.title: Recruiting for SDGs-Oriented Profiles: Unpacking Drivers of Employer Attractiveness in Hybrid Organizations

items.abstract: A formidable corpus of scholarship explores the role of economic self-interest in shaping public support for redistribution. One striking feature of this literature is its near-exclusive reliance on reported preferences in surveys, with little-to-no research analyzing revealed preferences in the form of actual voting on redistribution. Leveraging eight redistributive ballot initiatives across six American states and a total of 73,053 observations of revealed support for redistribution, we uncover consistent evidence that the economic standing of precinct voters is systematically related to their support for redistribution. We find that lower- to upper-middle-income precincts are each significantly more supportive of redistribution than upper-income precincts, with pronounced decreases in support associated with the increasing prevalence of high-income households subject to proposed tax increases. Finally, we observe the largest class differential in support for redistribution in more heavily Republican precincts.
items.summary_ko: 재분배에 대한 경제적 자기이익이 실제 투표행동과 어떻게 관련되는지 분석하기 위해, 미국 6개 주의 재분배 관련 주민투표 발의안 8건과 73,053개 선거구 관측치를 활용했다. 하위소득 및 중상위소득 선거구는 고소득 선거구보다 재분배를 더 지지했으며, 증세 대상 고소득 가구가 많을수록 지지는 크게 감소했고, 공화당 성향이 강한 선거구에서 계급 간 지지 격차가 가장 컸다.
items.title: Economic Self-Interest and Support for Redistribution: New Evidence Using Election Results Data

items.abstract: Abstract The expansion of mixed-provider welfare systems has intensified debates about the consequences of public, nonprofit, and for-profit provision. Existing research focuses primarily on efficiency, service quality, and citizens' outcomes, while less is known about ownership conversions’ consequences for employees. We depart from research suggesting that ownership conversions can disrupt employee-organization value congruence as well as change the incentive structures. Leveraging population-wide administrative data from Norwegian childcare services (2015-2019), we examine whether ownership conversions are associated with changes in employee sickness absence. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design, we find that sickness absence increases following nonprofit-to-for-profit conversions. At the same time, public-to-for-profit transitions show little consistent relationship with sickness absence. These findings suggest that employee responses to ownership change are shaped less by the public-private divide than by differences in organizational missions and values. More broadly, the study highlights organizational value congruence as a potential mechanism linking ownership arrangements to employee well-being, and suggests that the nonprofit-for-profit boundary may be more consequential for employees than the conventional public-private divide.
items.journal: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이 유아교육기관의 소유권 전환이 직원의 병가에 미치는 영향을 전국 행정자료와 시차적 이중차분 설계로 분석했다. 비영리에서 영리로 전환한 기관에서는 병가가 증가했지만, 공공에서 영리로 전환한 경우에는 일관된 관계가 거의 나타나지 않았다.
items.title: Sick of change? Sickness absence following ownership conversions in Norwegian kindergartens

items.abstract: Abstract Addressing the climate crisis is going to require behavioral change in many aspects of daily life. A growing literature suggests the promise of “warm glow” messaging that features the pleasure and satisfaction one experiences from acting sustainably. Yet previous research has relied almost exclusively on self‐reported behavioral intentions, leaving open whether such appeals meaningfully affect real‐world, costly choices. We partnered with a local organization to conduct a field experiment on energy choices in Hanover, New Hampshire. Using a randomized roll‐out design in early 2025, we systematically varied the timing of postcard mailers that contain a warm glow message encouraging customers to increase the renewable content of their energy option. Analyses of administrative data on consumer energy choices reveal that warm glow messages delivered in a field setting have a null effect on adoption of higher‐renewable power choices, with a small number of customers changing to the greener but more costly option. Our study provides novel behavioral evidence on the real‐world impact of intrinsic motivation appeals in the climate domain.

Hwayong Shin: Weidenbaum Center on the Economy, Government, and Public Policy Washington University in St. Louis St. Louis Missouri USA
Jason Barabas: Department of Government Dartmouth College Hanover New Hampshire USA
Rockefeller Center for Public Policy Dartmouth College Hanover New Hampshire USA
Jennifer Jerit: Department of Government Dartmouth College Hanover New Hampshire USA
Molly Gahagen: Department of Politics Princeton University Princeton New Jersey USA
Scott May: Community Power Coalition of New Hampshire Concord New Hampshire USA

items.summary_ko: 실제 비용이 드는 소비자 에너지 선택에서 ‘따뜻한 감정(warm glow)’ 메시지가 재생에너지 비중이 높은 전력 상품의 선택에 영향을 미치는지 검토하기 위해, 뉴햄프셔주 하노버에서 엽서 발송 시점을 무작위로 배정하고 행정자료를 분석했다. 메시지는 더 친환경적이지만 비용이 높은 선택의 채택에 유의미한 영향을 미치지 않았으며, 소수의 고객만 해당 상품으로 변경했다.
items.title: Do “warm glow” feelings affect climate mitigation behaviors? A field experiment on consumer electric energy choices

items.abstract: Abstract Politics can substantially harm physical and mental health, especially in polarized contexts, making political polarization a major non‐medical cause of disease and suffering. We examined whether citizens can protect their health without undermining civic engagement. Across three studies with over 2000 participants during the 2022 U.S. midterms and 2024 presidential election, we show that interoceptive sensibility, that is, the ability to perceive and trust one's internal bodily signals, protects against politics' adverse health effects. Higher interoceptive sensibility consistently predicted lower emotional, physical, behavioral, and social health costs, controlling for political identity, demographics, and emotion regulation. During the charged 2024 election, it further predicted fewer negative emotions, more hope for the future, and less fear, particularly when their candidate lost. Interoceptive sensibility also correlated with political engagement and efficacy, suggesting it enhances rather than inhibits participation. Our findings highlight it as a promising trait for mitigating political stress without reducing civic involvement.

items.summary_ko: 2022년 미국 중간선거와 2024년 대통령선거 기간에 2,000명 이상을 대상으로 세 연구를 실시해, 내수용감각이 정치적 스트레스의 건강상 비용과 부정적 정서를 줄이는지 검토했다. 내수용감각이 높을수록 정서적·신체적·행동적·사회적 건강 비용이 낮았고, 정치적 참여와 효능감은 높았으며, 특히 지지 후보가 패배했을 때 미래에 대한 희망이 더 크고 두려움이 적었다.
items.title: Feeling the body politic: Interoception as a mechanism of political stress resilience
